༄r+sā/ /sgrol ma'i smru sbyong springazhe misna dzopak+ta snashā rtsed pa'i lo rgyus gser ༄༄rgya/ /yo swa sti/ na mo gu ru/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun gdod nas spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen spros dngos kun khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'tha' dag 'gro ba mchog tu zhol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur sgol ma ṣ+ṭha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir sprol ma'i rgyud gsung ba'i thog mar lo rgyus gsung ba dag bsnyad na/ sngon thog ma med pa'i dus shig na/ 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs pa'i 'od ces bya bar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra zhes bya ba byung ste/de'i bstan pa la mchog tu gus pa'i rgyal yi bu mo ye shes zla ba zhes bya ba zhig go do/des sangs rgyas de 'khor nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun grangs med pa dang bcas pa la lo bye ba brgya stong gi bar du mgo par byas te/ 3 ma re re bzhin du phyogs bcur dpag tshad bcu gnyis thams cad rin spro ches go mtshams med par bkang ba'i rin thang gi tshad dang mnyam pa'i mchod rdzas dag bshams so/ /de'i mthar byang chub tu sems bskyed de sems dang bo bskyed pa yin no/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis khyed dge ba'i rtsab 'di nyid kyis lus 'di nyid la skyes par gyur te/ bstan pa la bya ba byed par sh+ka lam btab na de bzhin du lhar ba'i phyir de ltar rigs so shes bskul ba las/ dri lan mang du go skad pa la/ mthar rgyal yi bu mos smras pa/ 'di na skyes pa med cing bud med med/ /bdag med gang zag med cing rnam rig med/ /pho mor btags pa 'di ni ya ma brla/ /'jig rten slo ngan rnam par 'khrul par gyur/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa bapo de/ skyes pa'i rten la byang chub 'go pa ni mngo gi /bud med kyi lus kyis 'gyo ba'i don go pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /de bas na 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bud med kyi gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don bya'o shes dam bcas so/ /de nas lo
bye ba brgya stong gi bar du/ de rgyal yi pho brang du gnas shing / 'gu pa'i yon tan lnga la thabs mkhas pas oṃ bzhin du ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ mi skye ba'i chos la bgo pa thob cing / 'gro ba thams cad sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrubs so/ /ting nge 'dzin grub pa de'i nus pas/ de nas nyin re bzhin du snga dre'i dus kyi tshe/ sems can bye ba brgya stong re 'jig rten pa'i sems las bsgral te/ bgo pa la ma bkod kyi bar du zas za bar mi byed do/ /3 ma lho r+sā yang de tsam re 'god par byed do/ /de nas sngar gyi ming de 'gyur nas/ sgrol ma zhes bya bar gyur rto/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgras kyang / ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon duXbyas pa de srid du/ ming lha mo slol mas mtshan pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur bar lung bstan rto/ //de nas bskal pa spabud+dha snam par rgyas pa zhes bya ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa'i drung du/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams thams cad kyi sems can rnams la nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bsrung zhing skyob par dam bcas/ bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pas bskal pa dgu bcu'i rtsalnga'i bar du nyin re bzhin du 'gro ba'i ga༄yo r+bhe ba brgya stong 'bumaXphrag re bsam gtan la yang dag par bawo/ nub re bzhin gzhan 'phrul bdag 1— ste bdud bye ba brgya stong re btul bas sgrol ma/ gdung ma/ myur ma/ dpa' mo/ zhes mtshan du btags so/ //de nas bskal pa thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba la/ dge slong ṇ+ḍi ma med pa'i go kyi snang ba zhes bye ba phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis snying rje chen pa'i go zer gyis mngon par dbang bskur bas/ de nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gyur la/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ slar yang mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ca༄ ngar gyur pa go zer chen yi dbang bskur bas/ 'od zer snga phyi gnyis yab yum du gyur pa 'dres pa las lha mo
sgrol mar gyur te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs ka nas byung nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa bskang ba dang / sems can rnams 'jigs pa chen bo brgyad dang / bcu drug las tsho par mdzad do/ //de nas bskal pa bzang 1— 5na 5do nas bya ba mi g.yo dbugs dbyung gi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bstan ko/ /de nas bskal pa a saska zhes pa la/ phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum du gyur to/ de dag ni sngon thog ma med pa'i dus so/ /de nas bskal pa 'di nyid la/ ri spro ta lar sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa grangs med cing tshadaXmed pa'i dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sgrol ma'i gas rgyud 'bum phrag brgya gsungs so/ /rdzogs ldan gyi dus su rigs drug gi sems can gyi don de das byed skad/ gsum ldan gyi tshe de nub nas 'bum phrag drug pa byung ngo / /gnyis ldan gyi dus na de yang nub nas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa byung ngo / /de nas oṃ ldan gyi dus na sgrol ma 'dus pa thoka stong yod pa 'di byung ngo / /'dir bla ma'i zhal nas/ rdzogs ldan la sogs pa de rnams su rgyud kyi sgrugs bam ni yod pa ma yin mod/ lha dang rig 'dzin rnams kyi sar rgya cher spyod pas 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyi yang don chen bor gyur pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /ces gsung / 'on kyang sngags kyi gdul bya dus de dag tu yang 'byung ba mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ sgyugs bam yang 'byung du rung la/ mtha' gcig tu de 'dra'i nges gzung mi dgos par mngon no/ /khyad par rgyud 'di rnams slar yang 'o skol gyi ston pas bzlos te gsungs pa'ang yin lte/ 'di nyid kyi bshad pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro ma gsung ba'i thig le las/ gyu 'dzin ri yi rtsemor ni/ /shākya seng ges gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /'di'i gtam rgyud zhal snga nas 'byung ba ni 'di yin te/ de yang ston pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa sems can la ston par bzhed
nas/ byang chub kyi sang bo la bzhugs be+e/ smin mtshams kyi 'ode zer gyis bdud kyi gnas thams cad khyab par mdzad pa na/ bdud kyi dmag rnams lhags pa'i tshe/ grol mas bzhad pa brgyad kyis bzhad pas de thams cad sa la 'gyel zhing brgyal bar gyur skad/ de nas ston pa nyid kho ro mi g.yo bar gyur te/ bdud thams cad 'thag par byed pa'iXting nge 'dzin gyis bdud bcom ste/ slar yang byang chub kyi snying bo la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la/lha mo sgrol mas mchod par byas te/ de'i sngags rgyud rgyas par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rgyal ba rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan nas/ ji skad bshad pa'i rgyud rnams mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can la ston par bzhed de/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas nas ri bo ta lar gshegs te/ lha klu gago sbyin dri za la sogs pa grangs med cing tshad med pa'i 'gro ba la dbang bskur te/ sngags kyi theg pa bshad nas dngos grub la bkod do/ /mthar phyag na ko ྅ la rgyud rnams gtad de/ lcang lo can la sogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas rnams su go cing / mi'i 'jig rten du rgyud thams cad mi nub par bya ba'i nyir/ lag na do rje rgyal dra.in+d+ra 93 zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyud mtha' dag sgyugs bam la bris nas chos kyi mdzod ces bya bar sngas nas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis nyams su len pa yin skad/ nyir sngags kyi theg pa dbugs dbyung drug gi bstan pa la/ da lta he ru lha'i bstan pa yin par gsungs so/ /dbugasadabyung drug gi rnam gzhag rgyud nyid na gsal /khyad par bstan pa 'di nyid la 'dzam bu gling du sgrol ma'i rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas/ lo gsum brgya lhag pa tsam nyan thos rnams kyi bka' bsdu ba gsum pa zin pa'i dus gzhan zhig na/ lha dang klu dang gago sbyin dang dri
za dang srin bo rnams kyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i theg pa chen khra'i mdon sdo phal che ba yang rgya gar gyi yul tha dad pa rnams su byon/ /rang byung gi sgyugs bam rnams kyang byung zhing gcig car dar bar gyur la/ de dag ston pa spro sdom bar+ṇa chos smra ba/ mi skye ba'i chos la bar pa thob cing / 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / byams pa la sogs pa'i zhal masang ba rnal 'byor spyod pa'i r+sā dbon lnga brgya dang / ngo ༄ ༄da med smra ba'i bdag nyid chen bo brgyad la sogs pa byung ngo / /de dag dang dus mnyam par bya gu rnal 'byor rgyud gsum dang / theg pa bla na med pa'i thabs dang / shes rab kyi rgyud ci rigs pa dang bcas pa yang dar zhing / do re sems dpa' dang / gsang ba'i bdag bo zhal mthong ba rnams kyis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la bstan pas/ dus de'i tshe sngags kyi theg pa thos pa thams cad dngos grub ma thos pa gcig kyang med skad de shar phyogs bhaṅga lar/ rgyal po ha ri tsan+d+ra 'khor stong dang bcas pa zung 'jug gi sku grub pa dang / m+wa ji shar rgyal spro makyu zhes bya ba 'khor stong dang / bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa dang / nub phyogs mal war/ rgyal po khyodza de4zhes bya ba 'khor stong dang bcas pa mi snang bar gyur pa dang / rtso phyogs koṅku nar/ rgyal bo hari bhadra 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ ril bu'i dngos grub grub pa sogs lo brgya'am nyis brgya tsam gyi bar du skye bo 'bum lhag gcig gis dngos grub thob/ 'on kyang rtag tu gsang ba bsrung ba'i phyir dngos grub ma r+ya bar du gzhan sus kyang sngags kyi spyod pa yin par mi shes skad/ de dag gi tshe/ rje bag ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nyid kyi zugs rjes ma bsgrubs par yang zhal bstan cing / rjes su gzung ba'i lo rgyus gsung bgros las 'byung ba mdo tsam zhig bsnyad na/ /'jigs pa bcu drug dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus gsham du'o//dang spro ni/ dgra'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ yog thi shar rgyal rigs zhig skyed mos tshal du gnyid kyis log pa na/ dgra'i dmag tshogs go mtshon jogs pa stong
tsam gyis bskor bas/ skyabs gzhan med de/ grol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa bcu drug las skyob pa zhig yod ces spros te/ de kho na la skyabs su 'gro'o bsam pas/ grol ma'i mtshan nas bos shing / skad phyung bas skad m+mu de nyid la rje bag ma mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ zhabs kyi 'og nas rlung drag bo g.yos pas dmag rnams phyogs bcur khyer nas rang gi yul du sleb skad/ / 9/gnyis pa ni/ seng ge'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ shing 'thun zhig nags tshal du song ba las/ seṅge mo bkres pa dang 'phrad nas za bar brtsams te khar thogs nas rang gi tshang dang nye bar song / der 'jigs shing skrag pas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ mdun du bud med shing tshwa gos can zhig byung nas seṅge a kha nas de blangs swe/ grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus su bzhag go //gsum pa ni/ grang gra'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ yul gyi bu mo lo bcu gnyis lon pa zhig me rtog 'thu bar nags gseb tu song ba na/ khu ni zhes bya ba grang bo che gtum bo dang 'phrad de/ des sna shal gyis bcings/ mche ba bsnun par brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma'i mtshan dran par byas shing / snying thag pa nas gsol ba btab pas glang ca ce dbang du gyur te/ khi stegs mthon po la bzhag ste/ sna shal gyis phyag byas shing /yang blangs nas grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus kyi gnas su yang de bzhin du byas so/ /de nas 'dun khang dang / lha khang dang / rgyal yi pho brang gi sgor yang de ltar du byas pas/ bumo 'di ni bsod nams dang ldan pa zhig go shes rgyal yi btsun mor gyur rto/ //bzhi pa ni/ me'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ sha 'khon chags pa'i khyim tshang gcig /nub mo khang pa la dgra yis me btang bas/ 'bros par brtsams pa las ma thar ba'i tshe/ kye grol ma kye ma ho sgrol ma zhes mtshan nas brjod pas/ khyim gyi steng du sprin shin tu sngo zhing mdzes pa zhig byung ste/ char gyi rgyun gnya' zhang tsam khyim kho na la babs
pas me zhi'o/ //lnga pa ni/ dug sprul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ grong khyer gyi smad 'tshong ma zhig /dus lan gapo mutig gi do shal lnga brgya nyin pa'i tshong dbon zhig rnyed de/ nam phyed kyi dus na r+ya darga gyi khyim du 'gro bar 'go pas/ rang gi khyim nas song ste/ lam du shing shi ri sha'i yal ga zhig la 'jus pa na/ shing la 'khril ba'i sprul gdug pas lus la 'khril shing zin pa'i tshe/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dran par byas pa tsam gyis dug sprul de nyid me rtog gi 'phreng bar gyur nas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du lus la gnas par gyur snrog/ sa/ shā /nas sprul de nyid dkar bo dug dang bral bar gyur nas chu bor zhugs shri sa /drug pa ni/ chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ gu dzi ra ta'i yul gyi nang tshan lha ru 42 zhes bya bar/ tshong dpon shin tu longs spyod/ che ba zhig yod pa/ ma ngu'i yul du rnga mong stong tsam dang / khyu mchog lnga brgya tsam gyis khal bkal te song ba las/ lam khar chom rkun stong tsam gnas pa'i 'grog dgon par phyin pas/ sngon du song ba'i tshong pa thams cad bsad pa'i sha khrag rus pas phyogs thams cad khyab/ tshong pa brgya stong ni gsal shing la btsugs/ chom rkun de rnams mi'i sha yang za ba srin spro lta bu go pas/ tshong dbon de shin tu 'jigs nas/ mgon skyabs gzhan med pas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pa na/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa dpa' 5༄ ga mtshon thogs pa'i dmag dpag tu med pa byung ste/ chom rkun de rnams rgyang ring du bskrad cing shi bsad ni med do/ /de /rdzu stu 3 shā rnams byer ba'i shul du tshong pa de nyid bde bar phyin nas slar yang lhaXru /bdun pa ni/ btson rwa las bskyabs pa ni/ rkun gra'i dbon zhig gis rgyal gra'i bang mdzod kyi khyim phug ste song ba na/ chang gibumapazhigarnyedade/ de'athungasapasade
nyid du myos shing gnyid du song ba/ rgyal yi mi rnams kyis rig ste bzung nas/ btson dong du bag zhags pas bcings liṃ bsngal sna tshegis pa myong ba na/ gzhan maspros skyabs med de/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas 'dab chags kha dog sna lnga pa zhig nam mkha' nas babs te byung nas zhags pa rnams kyang bkrol/ btson khang gi sgo yang rang bye bar gyur te/ ci bder thar nas rang yul du phyin pa na/ rmi lam du bud med rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ gal te khyed nga'i drin dran na khyed cag 'khor dang bcas pa rkun yi las slongs shig /r+yā byung bas rkun go nyid 'khor thabargya dang bge chom rkun gyi las spangs nas dge ba rgya chen spro byed pa byung ngo / //brgyad pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi 'jig pa las bskyabs pa ni/ rtso phyogs kyi lam du zhugs pa'i tshong pa lnga stong tsam zhig gru wa 3 gsum bzung ste ga4zengs chen por zhugs nas/ rin bo che'i gling du phyin te/ gru gcig ni rin pho ches khongs par byas so/ /yang de nas song ba na/ tsan dan sa mchog gi gling dang 'phrad de/ gru gnyis pa tsan dan sa mchog gis gang bar byas so/ /de nas yul du 'ong bar 'go pa la/ rgya mcha nor bdag rnams khrosate ga chen bo btang bas thag ring du khyer te/ rgya mtsho kha go mi gsi pa mang bo brgal ba'i mthar/ rba rmong drag tu 'khrugs pa zhig tu pheb/ de gong du tshong pa rnams kyis/ tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug /dbang phyug /zla ba/ nyi ma/ ku be+e ra la sogs pa rnams la nyin mtshan du gsol ba 'debs kyang ma phan la/ der gru'i thag pa chad de/ rin bo che dang tsan dan gyi gru stor/ gru bo che yang nub la khad pa na/ de na sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen gcig yod pas/ sgrol ma dran pas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags skad gsangs mthon bo bzlas pas de ma thag tu mthun pa'i rlung byung ste/ gru tshur log nas nub gcig la 'dzam bu'i gling du pheb pa na/ rin lpa rā dang tsan dan gyi gru yang rlung gis tshur bdas te/ mnyam du 'dzom mo/ /
/dgu pa ni/ sha za'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ shar phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu/ nyan thos ses pa kho na gnas pa zhig yin pa las/ der dus lan cig nub mo res kyi gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol sa la 'chag tu song ba'i dge myong re re shi nas/gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi tshogs pa 'grib par gyur pa las/ nub cig dge tshul zhig 'chag sar song bas/ sha za mdog ngam nag cing mi sdug pa mche ba gtsigs pa gcig byung nas maro ga nas bzung ba na/ theg chen pa rnams la krol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa cig lo1 ces zer gyi/ de la skyabs su 'a11snyo snyam nas/ grol ma zhes mtshan nas bos so/ /der lha mo nag mo ral gri jogs pa zhig byung nas sha za de la sdigs pa na/ sha za des dge tshul la bgo par gsol lte/ sa 'og nas lcags kyi bum pa mu tig gis gang ba zhig phyung nas byin no/ /de phyin chad gtsug lag khang der gago pa de rgyun chad do/ //bcu pa ni/ mdze nad kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ yul ku ma rak+ṣe tar las kyi dbang gis bram ze'i slob dpon zhig la mdze nad kyis thebs nas/ der phan tshun gagi la gcig 'gos te/ bram ze lnga brgya mdze nad drag pos zin par gyur/ nye du dang sman pa rnams kyis kyang bor zhing / bram ze'i gtsang sgra'i chos las nyams lte lhag mas 'tsho zhing / slong mor go pa las/ lam khar rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i ko sku gcig mthong bas dad pa skyes te/ bram ze lnga brgya bo rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas/grol ma'i phyag nas rtsisman gyi rgyun byung ba la zhus byas pa tsam gyis mdze nad de nyidadu zhi/lha'i lus ltar mchog tu mdzes pa'i lus su gyur skad/ //bcu gcig ni/ dbang spro'i pho nya ba'i 'tshe ba las bskyabs pa ni/ de la dbang spro ni shar phyogs kyi phyogs skyong yin la/ de'i pho nya ba ni dri za'i gdon yin/ shin tu rtsub cingargyugaslabachosal radugacodapa che ba zhig yin no/ /de las bskyabs pa'i gtam
ni/ yul bcom brlag gi nags tshal zhig na/ nyan thos kyi dge slong bsam gtan pa lnga brgya lho de/ de rnams dge ba'i chos la bag par gnas pa las/ dus nam zhig na dbang yi pho nya byung ste/ kha cig ni bram ze/ kha cig ni bud med/ kha cig ni dge slong gi gzugs brnyan can dang / res 'ga' gar sbyin gyi rnam pa drag spro seng ge dang grang spro dang / sha ra bha la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i gdong can mang spro byung ste/ res 'ga' ni sdigs pa dang / res 'ga' ni bag pa la sogs pas 'brid par byed pa na/dge slong kha cig ni dran med du song / kha cig ni spyo/ kha cig ni yid gzhan du sur te/ glu dang gar kho nas dus 'da' bar byas so/ /der dge slong zhig gis 'byung yi bar chad kyis gtses par shes nas/ lha mo snyol ma zhes bya ba 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob ro shes grags pas/ 'di la phan par khur ro snyam ste/ nags tshal 'di ni lha mo zhol ma'i yin no shes bris nas shing la btags so/ /de tsam gyis 'jigs pa de k+to rang zhi bar gyur te/ de thams cad lha ro6wal ma la mos pas theg pa chen bo la zhugs /bcu gnyis ni/ dbul ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ bram ze shin tu dbul ba zhig nyam thag pas/ lam srang zhig na sgrol ma'i ko sku zhig 'dug pa la/ rang gi sdug bsngal byung tshul gyi gtam rnams zhus pas/ mar rten zhig dang lte ba'i sa phyogs zhig bstan te/ 'di rkos la gter rnyed gar lhar ro shes gsung la/ des kyang brkos pas gser gyi bum pa mu chag gis gang ba dang / dngul gyi bum pa rin bo che sna tshogs kyis gang ba lags pa mang du rnyed nas/ bdun brgyud kyi bar dudabul ba'i ga bas bsal skad/ yang zhing pa dbul spro zhig gis/ rje btsun ma grol ma'i mtshan nas brjod cing gsol ba btab pas/ bud med shing d+ku gos can byung nas/ shar phyogasasu song shig ces lung bstan/ des kyangasharaphyogasasusongaste/ bye ma'istengazhigatu nyal ba na/ dril
bu'i sgra grags pas gnyid sad/ der rta ljang khya dril bu'i rgyan can zhig 3ga pas bye ma rko zhing 'dug go /de nas rta de yud tsam gyis gzhan zhig tu song bas/ rta'i rmig pa'i shul des brkos pas dang bor dngul gyi sgo/ de nas gser dang / shel dang / beḍūr+ya la sogs pa rin lpa rā sna bdun gyi spro rnams byung ba rim pas bye ste/ sa 'og gi yul zhig tu klu dang lha ma yin mang yi ga47sgor sgyug nas 'go yon gyi dga' ba du ma nyams su myong ste/ lan cig sa'i bu ga'i sgo nas rang gi yul du 'ongs pas/ de bar du rgyal po rabs gsum 'das 'dug zer ro/ //bcu gsum ni/ gnyen dang bral ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ bram ze zhig gnyen mang zhing nor che bar lho pa las/ nam zhig na mi ngas chen bo byung bas bu dang chung ma dang / spun zla skud spro zhang spro sogs thams cad shi ste/ yid mya ngan gyis kon nasartswar r+ṇ+ṇa sir 'ongs so/ /de na sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen rnams sgrol ma'i dus slo chen wa ༄da pa'i sar phyin pas sprol ma'i che ba thos pas/ me rtog snyam pa gang gtor te gsol ba btab/ phyir 'ongs pa na/ rgyal bo dza ya tsan+d+ra'i bu mo bag mar thob ste sa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ des sprol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsabargyad bzhengs shing / thams cad du sangs rgyas pa'i dus ston chen 5 2) yang btsugs so/ //bcu bzhi ni/ rgyal spro'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ni/ yula.alokhye zhes par/ khyim bdag dbang thang dang longs r+sā che ba zhig lho pa/ dus lan cig rkyen 'ga' zhig gis/ yul gyi rgyal yo des nyim bdag de la mi dga' bar gyurate/ bsnyad 'tshol ba la zhugs pa na/ des kyang rgyal yi mi mang spro brid nas khrid de 3 rā hu tir song ngo / /dus gzhan zhig na/ des yul tsamapur+ṇa du phyin pas/ mgo'irgyal bos gyad mi bzhi btang ste/9 khyim bdag de bcings nas/ rdzayong ru khrid do/ /des rje btsun ma sprol ma dran bzhin du gsol ba btab pas/ lha'i nyin rlabs kyis khyim bdag de'i rkang

bu gling du zab bo/ /slar rang gi grogs po ga bcad pa na/ de yang lam du song ba stag gis zos nas shi bar shes/ der r+pā gang yang ma grub pas ngal bas sdug bsngal cing yid mi bde ba'i tshe/ grogs zhig gis bskul nas/ sgrol ma la dad pa bskyed de gsol ba btab pa las/ 3 lam du lho chu bo sin+dha 'gram du song zhig /'go pa'i r+pā rnams 'grub par sngar ro/ /zhes byung bas de bzhin du byas pas/ chu spro si9 nang nas sngar gru nang gi nor rdzas rgya mtshor nub pa thams cad rnyed/ de nas grogs po shi ba'i sar can nas sa zhig brkos pa las/ rang gi kor rdzas bcol ba rnams thon/ de nas rang yul du nyin be+e/ tsan dan sa mchog gi sdong dum zhig rgyal bo la skyes su phul bas/ rgyal bos kyang grong khyer gyi mchog lnga byin no/ //gzhan yang dus nyis slob dag klu sgrub sgrubañca la bskul ba dang / m+wa go mi chu'i 'jigs pa las lan gnyis su bskyabs pa dang / thags cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen me'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / dge bsnyen btsun pa ro lo nyid med pa dug sprul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / spro1 dbon rā khangs brtan pa la zhal bstan pa sogs ya mtshan can gyi gtam rgyud shin tu mang ngo / //yang do ji'i gdan du gnas pa'i nyan thos se'u pa gcig dbyar dus sgyu 'phrul la phyin pas chu klung ne+e rañja na'aX/ phal skad du phal gu zhes yongs su grags pa/ de gsar du 'brub pa la brgal bas rab ma tshugs par chus khyer ro/ /der theg chen pa rnams zhol ma zhes bya ba chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa yode ces grags so snyam nas/ zhol ma zhes skad phyung bas/ do rje gdan gyi phyi'i khyams kyi sgrol ma'i shing sku zhig lho pa de der dngos su mnas/ rma nam yang nga mi dran par da ltar nga bos pas ci rung zhes gsungs/chu nang nas rang thon no/ /sku brnyan de la yang chu klung sgrol ma zhes grags so/ //yang lan cig ko ྅ gdan du khan mo zhig gis grol ma'i lha khang zhal phyir bstan

nas mkhas par shes so/ /de nas phyagata do rje zhal mthong ba'i bram ze gugyanywal tshe gsang ba'i ngang tshul zhes bya ba zhig la sgrol ma 'byung ba'i dbang bskur ba go cing / gdams pa dang / rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag thob bo/ /de skabs rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi sa na/ rgyud 'di'i dum bu dum bu snyan brgyud du ston pa zhig las/ rgyud tshig yongs su rdzogs pa'ang med la/ yi ger bawo pa'ang med do/ /de nas slob dbon des rtsegapo tu bsgoms pas rdzu 'phrul r+ya ste/ yog ya na lda je'i gnas su song nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams las krol ma 'byung ba'i rtsabashad kyi rgyud dang / gtum 13 ga ba'i rgyud rtsabashad dang / lag na ko ྅ mchog tu gsang ba'i rgyud dang / he ru ka bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud spyan drangs te/ yul 3 pu rar/ nags gseb tu lha khang byas nas der bzhugs nas/thun mong gi 'gro ba rnams la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa dag ston cing / sprol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas shar phyogs kyi rgyal bo lnga dbang du bsdus/ thams cad dag mchog la dad par byas/ lha mokhu ma dang / lha'i rgyal spro rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba dbang du bsdus te/ yon thams cad des bh+yor bar byed do/ /mi g.yo ba'i rig sngags la brten nas sgyu 'phrul 'grub ste/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis khor yugatu rin lhur+sha tshe'i gron shing dang / rwa ba dang / khang bzang dang / lha dang / lha mo la sogs pa sprul/ phyag na do 3'i rig sngags la brten nas/ bstan pa la snang ba lnga brgya tsam tshar bcad/ lo mang bor pha rol du nyin pa'i chos bstan nas/ he ru lnga'i rig sngags kyi mthu las nam mkha' la gya gyur gshegs te/ lcang pho can du lus de nyid kyis bzhud do/ //des gsang sngags bstan pa'i slob ma ni/ slob dbon ha ya rtso khi gcig pu yin te/ 'di yang go dbon snga ma dang mdzad pa 'dra ba las/ 'dis ni khro ba'i rgyal spro rta mgrin grub ste/ srin yi 'jig rten du lus ma spangs par bzhud do/ /slob dbon de gnyis ni bram ze sa ra ha dang dus mnyam pa tsam yin ko/ /ku dpon de la rgyud bzhi
wa de rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis zhus te/ slob dbon 'dis ni rig sngags de thams cad grub pa yin no/ /desa.ār+ya de bol bshad/ des sgra gcan 'dzin bzang spro chung ba la gdams swe/ r+sā dgo 'di ni dmangs rigs las rab tu byung ba/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la byang zhing / theg pa che chung gi sde stod thams cad mkhyen pa zhig yin la/ 'dis 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gzhung rnams lam gyi lus gcig tu bsgril nas bstan pa'i bstan bcosa.asma ga zhes bya ba brtsams gsung / 'dis ca pa'i sgo nas mya stegs tsakra warma zhes bya ba sun phyung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod / nyan thos mang 5 26da pas pham par byas te theg chen la bcug /rang nyid kyis sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten te/gnod sbyin mo grub nas sa 'og gi gter phyung zhing / nags nang stong pa rnams su yang dge slong stong phrag re'i 'tsho ba bh+yor nas skad/ mthar yul cing ko ṭar sku 'das so/de yang 'grel pa tshig gsal las/ klu sgrub sgra gcan 'dzin bzang spro'i zhal snga nas dang bcas 'phags pa lhas kyang rjes su bstan padang / zhes gsung pa'i sgra gcan 'dzin bzang spro de yang 'di kho na yin pas/ bram ze chen bor 'go pa ni mun sprul lo/ /de yan chad rgyud de rnams glegs bam yang gcig pu kho na yin la/ brgyud pa rang gnyis su phyes pa med gsung ngo / /des r+yā dbon dz+ra la shet+pa la gdams/ des kha che rnyarma sgyu pā la la gh+nā snapa/ ṇā snad gli mitra la gdams/ de rnams kyi lo rgyus mi gsung / des nyi ma sbas /de la nyi ma sngas pa ni/ kha che'i yul du sku 'khrungs skye ba bdun du sgrol ma'i sgrub pa spro yin par grags la/ skye ba de nyid la rā sna zhing chung ngu nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig yod pa yul dbus su song ste/ rab tu byung bas klu sgrub kyi ring lugs la brten nas/ theg pa chen spro'i mdo 3 mtha' dag la mkhas par byas so/ /slob dbon pag mitra la sgrol ma'i dbangabaskurabazhusate/ nyir〉larima'irgyudabargya rtsabargyad
mkhyen par grags/ slob darga 'dis sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten pa'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil 'khor cho ga la sogs pa gzhung bcu gsum tsam mdzad ces zer ro/ /slob dgo 'di ni slob dgo h+pho brtan gyi slorbe ma tsan+d+ra sho mi dang dus mtshungs pa tsam yin no/des na da ltar 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstsa pa can rlabs can du grags pa 'di yang 3 ma sbas pa gzhan zhig gis ni yin du rung mod/ slob dbon 'dis mdzad pa ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /'di yi slob ma'i gtsoyo ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshesaganyen yin te/ gzhan yang sgrol ma'i rig sngags grub pa'i slob dpon dpag tu med pa byung ngo /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis rnyin mitra la gdams/ des ta thā ga ta mitra la gdams/ des seṅga la gling pa rnyarma mitra la gdams/ des shī la ranyi ta la gdams te/ 'di ni sgeg pa'i do rje dang dus mtshungs pa ste/ de yan chad du brgyud pa ma chad par byung zhes sngon gyi slob dponaXrnams kyi rabs dang / gtam gyi tshigs bcad las 'byung zhes gsung ngo / //de dag gi skabs su/ slob dbon brgyad la 'jigs pa brgyad las bskyabs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar smyo phyogs su r+sā darga dikawarma zhes bya ba sdom brga lde snod 'dzin pa chen bo/ gshin rje gshed dang / sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud 'di nyid la brten pa'i rig sngags grub pa zhig ste/ des rtso phyogs thi dalha'i yul du mu stegs kyi bram ze'i k+ṣ+ṇā dka ga pu nī la zhes pa dang ca pa byas te/ mu stegs pham pas/ de'i gu yul thams cad sangs rgyas pas blangs so/ /de nas slob dbon de gtsug lag khang du dge slong rnams dang lhan cig chos r+sā gsol ba'i tshe/ mār+sās rnams kyis ga.a lag khang la tshebatang ba na/ slob dbon gyis rje btsun ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma nam mkha'i /byings su byon te/ nam mkha' las chu khra'i rgyun dngos su babs nas me zhi bar gyur
/yang slob dbona.a mar sing ha bya ba/ rgyal khra'i yig mkhan rab tu byung ba/ theg pa che chung gi mngon pa smra ba zhig /sprol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten te/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la zugs dam du mdzad pa zhigayin no/ /des nub phyogs ma la wa'i yul du gnas gzhi byas nas bzhugs te/ mngon pa slob pa lnga brgya tsam la chos mngon pa ston cing /lpo 3 shu rtsabazhi'i bar du gnas de nyid du bzhugs skad/ de dag thams cad du mngon pa la lbo bh+yong ba lnga brgya tsam gyi 'khor gyis bskor nas yod pa las/ dus lan cig phyogs de na nag phyogs kyi klu'i rgyal bo la li ta zhes bya ba lho de/ des slo bur du char drag spro mi bzad pa phab ste/ char chu las chu bo'i rgyun chu klung ya mā na tsam byung ste/ slob dbon gyi gnas gzhi dang / grong khyer mang bo khyer la khad pa na/ slob dbon gyis rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ gnas gzhi grong khyer u ta dza ya na dang bcas pa la chu de nyid g.yas stor du bsgor ba mang du byas nas/ mthar chu lo 3na spro gzhan zhig la babs pa na/ klu de nyid rang gi gnas dang / tu ru ska'i grong khyer chung ngu zhig khyer ro/ slob dbon de la sgrol mas mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos gyis shig ces lung bstan pas 'chi med mgu brtsams/ 'di da lta'i bar du yang rgya gar na nyi nang gnyis ka la shin tu dar bar lho do/ /'di rgyal yi yig mkhan yin ces pa'i rgyal spro ni wakram dit+ya yin par grags/ yang sprob dpon lha'i seṅge zhes bya ba rten dge bsnyen du ngabazhugs pa/ theg pa che chung gi mdo sde dang / mngon pa la cher mkhas pa/ kha che'i yulagyi rgyal spro shrī ha de ba zhes bya ba'i bla mar gyur pa/ chos smra ba zhig yin te/ de kha che/ la hor/ ma ru rnams su rgyal spro dang / khyim bdag dang / bram ze snatshogs pa dad par byas nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang lnga brgya tsam bzhings so/ /kha che dang nye ba'i yul gadza ni la sogs par chos mang du bshad pas/ tu ru ska stag gzig gi lugs phal cher nub/ stag gzig gi rgyal spro zhig gis/ slob dbon btson du bzung ste/ kra gro'i lugs byed na legs/ mi

be+e pa dang / spunaka shrī dang / na: ba dang / jazhi na pa rnams la bshad/ gam+bhi pa la ku sa la chung bas zhus/ de la.an+data lha nas zhus/ de la smyo mitras gsan/ de la grub chen zhi ba sbas pas gsan/ de la bdag gi bla ma gsum gyis gsan ko/ /yang 33 pa la/ spru la badz+ras zhus/ de la ra hu la gup+tas zhus/ de la dīpaX kār shrī dz+nyā pas zhus/de la ma n+dhe ma sirnyis zhus/ de la twa rathi mitras zhus/ de nas rim pas saṅgha d+mā/ rat+na n+d+ra dza/ na ya ka lngi/ rnyarma shrī/ shākya rak+ṣita/ su dzā ta/ bud+dha shrī bha dra/ ga rat+na/ gsun/rā ti gup+ta/ des slob dbon chen spro zhi ba sbas pa la'o/ /yang spu: pa/ ñja ka pa/ sgyu ji rā dza/ ha ri lhalnga pa/ rdzasita lha na rnams las brgyud kyang chog /yang ka na kā smra/ lo ka pralha/ chos 'byung zhi ba sogs nas brgyud pa'ang yod gsung / jalan ṅga pas/ slob darga mañji pā la bshad/ de ltar na bar skabs brgyud pa tha dad pa mang spror dar la/ phyis ni grub chen zhi ba kho na la bzhugs pas da lta de las rgya cher 'phel ba'o/ //dedag gi nang nas lo rgyus gzhan du bgo zin pa rnams de dang de dgatu shes par byas la/ der ma 'go pa dag bshad na/ ka na ka shrī 'di ni bal ga ka na ka shrī min ma ga rnyi nyid du sku 'khrungs shing / ku ru kuṇ+ḍa'i lde pa las rab tu byung pa/ rnam gnon tshul gyi dgon par mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs te/ lhar+sha lar paṇ+ḍita tsho mitra zhes bya ba zhig la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbanganasate phobadun du ༄me bzlas byas kyang mtshan ma bzang ba tsam yang ma cung tshe/ lholho 'phro bcadakas ci bder bzhugs pas/ nub gcig rmi lam du bud med cig gis dpal na ro pa'i drung du song zhes lung bstan/ de nas na ro pa la 'khor 'o zlogam pa'i dbang bskur zhus pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin bzang spro rang shugs su skyes/ zla ba drugatu balholhos pas 'khor 5765 pa'i zhal gzigs/slar yang na ro pa chen bo lo bdun gyi bar du bstenas/ rgyud sde dpag tu med pa gsan/khyad par 'khor lo bdemachogadang/ gdanabazhid / sprolama'abyung ba'i rgyud rnams
la mkhas par grags/ ma ga lhar rgyal wa she ya gra la'i skabs dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brang ba/ kha sa ma de ba zhes pa dang nus pa 'gran pas mu stegs kyis 'dom gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la dkyil 'khor bris shing bum pa bzhag pa la/ r+sā darga gyis yungs lngar gtor bas dkyil 'khor zhig cing bum pa cang / slob dbon gyis/ sgrol ma'i sku zhig ta la gcig tsam gyi nam mkha' la bzhag pa/ slob dbon nyid kyis ma bsdus bar du mā stegs rnams kyi sngags dang me mda' la sogs pa thabs gang gis kyang snang bar ma nus pas/r+sā dbon rgyal/ rgyal bos thikram wī lar ma rgyud 'chad pa yi slob daspron du spyan drangs so/ /'dis grol ma'i zhal gzigs shing / sgrol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas phan tshun dbang du bsdu ba'i las sbyor mdzadaXde/ 'khrug pa chen spro lan brgyad sdum skad/ an+dha pa ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa lho shin tu rtul ba ltar snang ba zhig /khro bo na ro pa la/ grol ma 'byung ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs rnams zhus/ rgyud 'di 'byung ba'i he ngu spur lha dgu bsgom zhing pho bcu gnyis bsgrubs pas/ he ru ka dang / sgol ma zhal mthong / dngos grub r+ya ste/ dpag tshad brgya'i lam yang yud tsam gyis chod par byed/de skabs grong khyer r+ṇi lir sog yi rgyal spro zhig lho pa des phobrang chen bo gser du bcu pa na/ slob dpon des kyang bem spro zhig 'tshem gyin de dang nye bar bzhugs so/ /pho brang zin pa na/ bem spro de dum bur dral zhing gshags pa na/ pho brang de yang rmangs nas zhig tswa /de ltar lan gsum song bas/ rgyal yo des kyang gtam de bos te/ slob dpon spyan drangs/ zhabs la phyag btsal/ slob dpon gyi gsung las byung ba'i dam bca' bzhi byed par byas la/ bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang la gnod pa mi byed pa dang /pho brang nang na gnas pa rnams kyis srog gcod sprong ba dang / rab tu byung ba rnams la mar pa byed pa dang / nyin re bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nas bapo cing phyag 'tshal ba rnams yin skad/ ta:ribemayimingaste/ deldanagad grubathob gan+dha bar grags/
yun ring du 'gro don mdzad/ mthar gulusade nyid kyis mkha' rma du gshegs so/ /yang shāzhin rla na pa ni/ shāka ki zhes pa g.yo sgyu'i bya ba sna tshogs pas 'tsho ba sgrub pa'i done lte/mtha' 'khob kyi rigs ngan gcig yin gsung / naka na ni tshan che ba'am/ stobes che ba'i stso ko/ /khraka spu'i rigs su lus r+sās shin tu che bas mtshan yang de bzhinadu thogs pa yin no/ /'di yang rnal 'byor pa byas te/ mi thub zla ba'i slob ma zhig la dgyes kor zhus nas/ lto phyogs spril bya ba'i ri la lo bco lnga'i bar du rtsegacig tu bsgoms kyang rtags gang yang ma byung bas/ skye ba gzhan du 'grub par smon lam btab ste/ g.yang sa chen spro zhig la mchongs so/ /der lus kyang ma rnyed/ nam mkha' las kyang sgra byung te/ r+yā na ro pas rjes su 'dzin par lhar ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas na ro pa'i zhabs bsten te/ dgyes pa do ji'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ a kyis dgyes pa rdo rje mi 'grub/ bde mchog 'khor lo sgom dgos pas bde mchog sga dbang bskur dgos gsung / khro bo na ro pa la ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo zhu ba ni shinatu dka' ste/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams las brgyad 'gyur gyi lhag pa'i yo byad dgos pas/ de skabs bdag la yo byad kyang med cing / lbo gros rtul bas rgyud rgya chen po gsar du nyan pa'i nus pa med zhus pas/ sgrol ma'i dbang bskur zhing rgyud kyang gnang la/ bde mchog yab yum kha mkhag sga gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang ba rtsegacig tu bsgoms pas mchorga gi dngos grub r+ya ste/ na ro pa tshogs kyi mgo pa rgya chen yi gral dbu la bzhugs pa'i drung du/ phyag 'tshal du 'ongs rke/ lus las me 'bar ba dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bstan te mi snang bar gyur to/ /de skabs 'gro don mdzad pa ma byung bas/ na ro pa'i slob ma grub thob bzhi'i grangs su ma bgrangs la/ phyisa.a lha yā ka ra'i slob ma mji ra pā la zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa shin tu bzang ba zhig yod pa la/ zla gcig tsam du sku dngos su bstan nas/ sgrol ma'i dbang bskurabadang/ rgyudabashadakanangag
rnams kyang gnang nas/ des kyang brga par bsgoms pas zla ba drug na dngos grub r+ya ste mthar klu'i gnas su song skad/ de la yang slob ma bzhi tsam yod cing / brgyud pa'ang gnyis gsum du rgyud 'di nyan bshad sogs cung 'dug kyang / pho rgyus rgyas par mthos gsung ngo / /la li ta badz+ra ni rgyal rigs shig yin la/ bya ba zhig la ma ga lhar phyin nas/ lam du shing drung zhig na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug pa mthong bas mchog tu dad de/ zhabs la phyag byas so/ /slar yang yul du ldog pa'i tshe/ rang gi bud med de mi gzhan dang 'dre ba gas kyis sems la gso par gyur nas yang ma ga ga chos la 'ongs pas/ shing drung der sngar gyi grub thob de nyid dang mjal ba/ grub thob de ni 33 pa chen spro'o/ /der 33 pas rgyud nyin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur zhing gdams ngag bstan pas ring spror mi thogs par rtsi pa bgo te/ gling bu 'bud cing smyon pa'i oṃ pas sems can gyi don byed pa zhig yod skad/ 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa mi gsung ngo / /dīhār+shara'i lo rgyus ni grags che bas gzhan du shes so/ /matsum sirnyi ni/ ro ga rje'i slob ma zhig ste/ sgra tshad dang mdo'i lugs la mkhas/ 'dis gsang sngags gzhan mi mkhyen/ sgrol ma'i rgyud 'di kho na la mkhas/ nus pa'ang thon te/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi chu bo gaṅga la gshegs kyang thang la 'gro ba bzhin thogs pa med pa/ dug sprul dang stag la sog/sa pa la bka' bsgo bar nus pa zhig go /tu ra shrī ni/ r+sha pa smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ ma ga lhar mya stegs kyi r+sha pa las lan gsum du rgyal/ bh+yo phyogs kyi yul du nyan thos rnams kyi r+sha pa bzog pa dang / kha che'i yul du nyi nang gi paṇ+ḍita thams cad r+sha pas zil gyis mnan skad/ kha che'i rgyal r+yā bla mar gyur/ yul gas 'i rgyal spro grol ma'i rig sngags kyis dbang du bsdus te/ sangs rgyas pa la bcug go /saṅgha shrī nas/ rnyarma shrī bar gyi lo rgyus mi gsung / shākya rak+ṣita ni/ siṅga la'i yul du 'khrungs shing / dang pho nyan thos se4payinacing/ de'isdangalugasalashinatugos pazhigaste/ ra khang gi yul gru'i
char gartogs pa ha ri puñca gser gyi grong ste der slob dbon rnyarma shrī la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad parari du dgyes pa ko ྅/ bde mchog 'khor pho/ /sgrol ma 'byung ba/ nag bo chenalnga'i rgyud de/ bzhi wa de dag phal cher la mkhas pa/ he ru spu'i zhal gzigs shing / zhol ma'i rig sngags la brten nas nag wa ༄na bo dbang du bsdus te/ dge bsnyen nag yi gzugs kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i dngos spro rnams dpag tshad brgya'i pha rol nas 'gugs pa zhig go skad/ tsag la rā dzā zhes bya ba rgyal spro zhig gis ha ri palngar grong khyer dang lha khang rnams 'joms pa'i phyir dmag 'dren par brtsams pa na/ nag bo chen spro'i phyag mtshan rtsegasum 'phangs pa zla ba tsam gyis bgrod dgos pa'i pha rol yin na'ang / rgyal yi pho brang gi steng du tri shul smib te pho brang zhig go /de ltar nus mthu dang ldan par grags/ su dzā ta ni yul namyo ḍā gtsug lag khang daṇ+ḍa pu ri'i mkhan bo ste/ rgyal rigs las rab tu byung ba yin no/bud+dha wī bhadra dang / k+ṣ+ṇā rat+na gnyis kyang yul de nyid du byon pa'o/ /dz+nyā na spya na ni/ yul der 'khrungs shing / mkhan spro dz+nyā na rat+nas rab tu byung ba/ gsang sngags spru nang gi rgyud mang du mkhyen pa/ khyad par sgrol ma'i rgyud la mkhas shing nus pa brnyes pa/ sku tshe'i smad la bal r+yā yul du bzhugs shing / rnal 'byor pa'i rma pa mdzad de/ phyag rgya pad+ma can las dngos grub thob pa/ 'bras bre gang dang / gang bum pa gcig gis sngags btsun stong phrag gnyis tsam la 'khor d+ku mar pa shin tu rgyas par ldang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mang bo can zhig go /slob dbon rā 3 gup+tas/ sgrol ma'i rgyud dang /nag bo chen yi rgyud dang / bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba dang / ku ru kulbe'i rtog pa la sogs pa sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' shas kyi dbang rgyud 'tshol bar bal spro'i yul du pheb sa lte/ dz+nyā na skya na dang / h+nā ba spya nu pā la/ ṇ+ḍita nu pā la/ gi3 pā la rnams las rgyud sde mang du gsan pa las/ rgyud 'di ni slob dbon dz+nyā na su na la gsan pa yin sgo /snang
grub thob khrikapa ni grub thob tam+bha pa las dbang dang man ngag thams cad thob nas/ yun ring du sgrub pa mdzad cing / mthar sbri spu'i me rtog gi tshal zhig tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ sgrub pa byas pas me rtog gcig zla ba bcu gnyis kyi bar du mi rnyings shing / de'i mthar nub gcig me rtog la me 'bar ro/ /de gsol ba tsam gyis thun mong gi dngos grub job ste/ sa 'og la jogs med du bgrod pa zhig ko /du spa ra jani/ khrus mkhan gyi rigs las grub pa thob pa zhig yin gsung / ha ri bhañja bzhi lo rgyus mi gsung / lo ka prarnyi pa ni/ rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhime ste/ ka na ka smra la rtsaba'i bla mar mdzad/ gsang sngags kyi chos ni grol ma 'byung ba'i chos slor kho na la legs par sbyangs pa zhig yin la/ yul gudzi rathar skyed tshal stong pa zhig tu gnas gshe byas nas/ lo drug tsam du sngags 'gang smyo zhig gis sgrub grogs byas te/ sprol ma'i bskyed rdzogs kho na bsgoms pas/ mkha' 'gro mas lung bag pa thob nas/ rig ma bcu gnyis la brten nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs zla ba drug byas pas 'dod pa'i dngos grub brnyes te/ gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa las/ lan cig yul de'i rgyal bo gar log gis rang gi yul ljongs bltar 'ongs pa'i tshe/ phyob dbon gyi gnas de nyams dga' bar mthong nas/ 'di na su zhig gnas zhes dris pa na/ 'di na sangs rgyas pa'i khyim btsun zhig yod de zhes rgyal lpa'i g.yog rnams nyis smras so/ /de nas rgyal spros gnas 'phrog par brtsams pa na/ skad cig la de'i phyi nang thams cad mer 'bar te/ rgyal bo 'khor bcas kyang tshig la khad par song ngo / /der go dka grub pa r+ya par shes nas/ gsol ba btab pas me zhi'o/de nas slob dpon na re/ rgyal bo khyod kyis sangs rgyas pa mchod par byed na legs/ mi byed na da lta nyid du brlag par bya'o gsung / rigs brgyud dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas mgo par mna' bor ro/ /de phyin nas da lta'i bar du yang yul 'di'i rgyal spro ni rus gar log yin yang / sangs rgyas pa la gtsoboraṃ mchod par byed pa yin no/ /de kong
yul de na sangs rgyas pa nyung ngu las med pa la/ rgyal wa de nyid kyis kyang gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs so/ /de nas brtsams te rim pas da lta'i bar du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar go do/ /der rgyal spro des sangs rgyas la dad par gyur pa'i tshe/kra zla'i ston pa kā dzi rnams kyis slob dbon gyi gnas la me btang bas/ slob dbon gyis kyang de rnams nyid la lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad rengs shing dran med du gyur/ zhag gsum gyi bar du ma gsos pa las/ de rnams kyi nye dus gsol ba btab pa las/ dril bu 'khrol ba'i sgras slar gsos/ de rnams rgyal gra'i chad pas 'jigs pas rang gi yul nub phyogs thag ring bor bros te song ngo / /kra zla'i gnas gzhi ma si ta thams cad slob dgo gyis yungs spur gtor ba kho nas zhig ste/ de dag gi shul du yang sangs rgyas kyis mgo rten re bzhengs/ sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsabazhengs so/ /rgyal bo la pad+ma gar dbang dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te/ gsang sdogs kyi lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs/ sngon rgyal spro de yi mnga' 'og na bram ze dang mya stegs mang zhing rgyal d+ku mgo gnas kyi gaphulan gar log kā dzi rnams kyi byed pas kra zla'i grub mthanya 'dzin pa stong tsam go/ sangs rgyas pa'i rab tu byung ba nyi shu tsam las med pa la 4ba dpon de nyid kyi sku ring nyid la kra spro thams cad nub cing rgyal bos sangs rgyas pa'i slob dgo mang spro spyan drangs pa la brten nas dge slong rang yang stong phrag gnyis tsam 'phel skad/lan cig yul der mu ge chen bo byung ba la r+yā dka gyis sa 'og nas 'bru'i gter chen bo phyung nas/ yul gyi mi thams cad la 'bru khal brgya brgya byin cing / klu dang gnod sbyin rnams las blangasate dbul 'phangs thams cad la mu tig gi do shal re re dang / nyin re bzhin du rto la re'i rin thang gi kha zas sbyin pa lo gsum gyi bar du mdzad/ mthar 'gro 3nga dang nye ba'i gling zhig na/ khye'u shi ba'i lus mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yod pas de la grong 'jug mdzad de/ sku lus snga ma de nyin gyis brlabs nas mi rul bar mar
rten sgo can cig gi nang du bzhugs so/ /'gro lding du yang spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad pa zhig byung la/ /slob ma bud med brgyad rga shi med pa'i lus su gyur te/ sku lus snga ma de la mar pa byed cing lho pa las/ lo drug cu nas de nyid slar yang sku lus snga ma nyid ke zhugs te/ der yang pho bcu tsam du skal ldan gyi sems can 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad do/ /slar yang mi lo gsum gsum du sku lus phan tshun du 'pho ba lan drug tsam mdzad nas/ skyolus gnyis rig ma'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa mi snang bar gyur to/go dbon 'di la twa ra l+lī mitra dang / chos 'byung zhi ba gnyis kyis rgyud 'di gsan/ chos 'byung zhi ba ni/ cade dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par grags zhes nyi ma dpal gyis bshad kyang / lo rgyus mi gsung / de la saṅgha shrīs zhus par byas kyang chog gsung / grub pa'i slob dbon lo ka prarnyis sgrub thabs dang / rgyud kyiXbasdus pa'i don dang / rdzogs rim dang / dbang gi cho ga dang / sbyin bsreg rnams mdzad cing / mi'i 3 ma'i 'grel pa yang 'di'i rjes 'brang ngo / /nyis rgyud 'di'i nyan bshad shin tu dkon pa la/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyis rgya cher dar bar mdzad de/ khori gas kyang / zhi ba'i zhabs kyi man ngag nyin ci ma log pa bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa kho nar gyur pa dang / 'grel pa gnyis gzhung phran brgyad dang bcas legs par mnos pas/ kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir sngon chad bdag kho na'i bsod nams kyi skal bar thob bo/ /ma rgyud rgyal bo zab mo'i mthar zug pa/ /sprol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi byung khungs rnams/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin bag khadi rgyal khams pa/ /twa ra nā tha zhes byas sbyar ba yin/ /ces pa rang lo sum cu pa la chos grwa gser mdog can du smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //

/bzhad pa rab bzhad tu ṭ+wā ra yis//bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du mdzad ma/ /zhes pa ste/ phyag 'al lo/ gang la na/ dad ldan rnams kyi re ba bskong bas rab tu dga' ba bskyed cing / ma dad pa rnams zil gyis gnon pas bsgyud chags pa'i rin lo 3'i dbu rgyan 'od zer 'phreng ba kha dog sna tshogs pa spel lte 'phro ma/ sngags kyi bzhad mo rab tu bzhad pa'i sgra tu: ra zhes sogs kyis 'go khams kyi bdag spro bdud dga' rab dbang phyug dang / de'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag dbang du sdud par mdzad ma de la'o/ bzhi pa phyogs skyong bcus 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni//phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams//thams cad 'gug par nus pa nyid ma//khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hāX gis//phongs pa thams cad rnam par zhol ma/ /zhes pa ste/ phyag 'tshal lo/ gang la na/ sa gzhi skyong ba phyogs skyong bcu dang / de dag gi 'khor gyi tshogs rnams thams cad 'phrin las sgrub pa'i bran du 'gugs par nus pa'i bdag nyid ma/ zhal khro gnyer g.yo ba'i rname par bzhugs pa'i zugs spu'i yi ge hāX gi go zer gyi lcags kyus 'go rgya thams cad bkug nas/ sems can dbul zhingaphongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba thams cad rnam par sgol bar mdzad ma de la'o/ lnga pa dbu rgyan gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni//phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtsemos dbu rgyan//brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma//ral pa'i a na go dpag med las//rtag par shin tu go rab mdzad ma/ /

mthil gyis bdung bar mdzad ma/ de yang zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa sogs shin tu drag d+ku rnam pa can du mdzad pa'i phyag zhabs kyi mthil du ye gi hāX sngon 'o ) re gnas pa las do rje'i me char spros pas/ gzhi dang / lhag pa'i gzhi dang / gzhi med pa dang / gzhi nyid dang / bcud kyi gzhi dang / /gzhi bzang spro dang / dag pa'i gzhi ste/ sa 'og rim pa bdun bo na gnas pa'i klu dang lha min dang gshin rje sogs gdug pa can rnams ni //mas pa tshe'ajoms par mdzad ma de la'o/ /gnyis pa chos oṃ rnam pa'i sgo nas bto /phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma//mya ngan 'das zhi oṃ yul nyid ma//swā hā yo dang yang dag ldan pas//sdig pa chen spro 'joms pa nyid ma/ /zhes pa ste/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la na/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal med pas bde ma/ /rgyu mi dge ba mi gsog pas dge ma/ spang bya nyon mongs med pas zhi ma/ sgrib gnyis kyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhi ba mchog gi dbyings la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pas de'i r+sā yul can nyid du gyur pa/ de'i mthus nyid kyis gsungs pa'i rig sngags/ tu re tu: re tu re/ zhes pa mjug tu snyahwa dang / 'gorayo dang yang dag par ldan par byas pa'i li ge bcu pa nyid tshes bzhin du bzlas pas khros pa khra'i rgyud kyi mtshams med lnga dang chos sprong sogs sdig pa chen bo rnams dang / de'i rgyu chags sdang sogs nyon mongs chen bo rnams dang / 'bras bu tsha grang sogs liṃ bsngal chen spro rnams kyang lhag med du 'joms par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid ma de la'o/ gsum pa 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bag pa la drugzhi snyu'i sngags kyi 'phrin las kyi sgo nas ba༄de pa/ khro mos sa gsum g.yo ba'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bar+sā pa/ brtan gapo'i dug rnams sel ba'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas bsto pa/

ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas mgo pa'i mthus/ /gangs can mgon bo bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi/ /sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las rgyas gyur te/ /'jig rten bde legs chen spros khyab gyur thig /ces yang shugs drag spros gsol ba 'debs shing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don rnams myur du 'grub par gsol ba gdab bo/ ༈ /gsum pa bsngo ba bya ba ni/ bcom ldan rje bgaXgrol ma'i lha tshogs la/ /phyag mchod bgyis sogs dge maci mchis pa/ /pha ma rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /sgrol phyir sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo / /zhes sogase bsngo ba dang / thog mtha' ma/ sogs smon lam rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun nas bya'o/ lha /bzhi pa lhag chad kha bskang zhing kongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya ba bzlas pa'i mthar/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag las dang bo bar gyur pas nying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang /cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / gtsang spra chung ba la sogs pa thams cad thugs rje chen bo dang ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol gyi/ bdag cag la sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la nongs pa bgo par gsol lo/ ༈ /lnga pa gshegs gsol lam brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /yo su phra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes rten la me rtog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med na gshegs gsol bya'o/ lha /drug pa shis pa bapo pa ni/ che ba'i che mchog ston pa bla na med/ /ces sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang / bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha/— /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/ /ldo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhi ma/ /yum gyuragayupil bsnams pa'i bkra shis shogces brjod la me rtog sga char dbab spro/ /maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga grangs gsog byed pa'i che nyin rer
thun bzhi'am/ de las mang ba'i grangs gsog tshe/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga sngar bshad pa ltar la/ mjug gi gtor ma 'bul ba thun re re'i mjug tu grub na nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / 'go don 'grub pa la gtor ma shin tu bsngags par rgyud sme bzhi nas gsungs pas de ltar bya zhing / zun re rer gtor ma dbul ba ma grub kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur la/ thun tha ma'i mjug tu nges par dbul bar bya'o/ gtang rag gi mgo pa'ang thun re re'i mjug tu dbul ba ma sgrub kyang thun tha ma'i mjug tu nges par dbul bar bya'o/ /gzhan pa dge ba bsngo ba dang / yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bgo pa gsol ba dang / brtan bzhugs rnams thun re re'i mjug tu nges par bya dgos so/ lha /drug pa 'di'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ nyir rje btsun sgrol ma dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi lha yin pas sangs rgyas sems can gyi don mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi lha mo 'di'i mthu dang 'brel ba yin zhing / gsang sngags rgyud sne bzhi nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bas nas 'gro ba 'dul bar mdzad pa ni bya grubaye shes kyi rang snang 'phrin las lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba rje bag snyol ma dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du bkod nas sems can dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa sogs lha mo 'di'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs pa dang / khro wo ji dpal ldana.a ti she rgya gar na bzhugs dus mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta sgra tshad la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa gdugs lnga phub pa zhig dang bstan pa rgyan du btsugs nas rtsod pa mdzad pa na/ dang bor der tshogs pa la mo ches go /de nas rigs pa'i dka' gnas je phra je phrar song ste khong rang gnyis gyis ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang mi go ba zhig byung / de nas kyang je phrar song ste mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta des sgra'i dka' gnas shin tu phra ba zhig la r+ṇa pa byas pa na ro pas kyang cung zad ma dkongs pa na khyod der r+pā cig gsungs nas sī zugs blangs chab bzhes te nang du byonanas rje bag grol ma la maṇ+ḍal hrū swe gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pa na sgra'i dka' gnas de ji 'brang kho mos skyong / /kho d+ku gdams pa 'di longs la/ /rjes su 'brang la bstan par gyis/ /zhes 〈 zug rje'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bka' gdams kyi bshes gnyen thams cad rje btsun sgrol mas rjes su 'dzin nyin slobs la/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs su bdag 'gyur mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rje btsun grol ma la/ /mar cing gsol ba gdab pa'i man ngag 'di/ /lbo ldan yongs la bdag gis phan par smras/dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cadaci du/ /rje btsun grol mas rtag tu rjes bzung ste/rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa la/ /'jam dpal sming spro lta bur bdag gyur cigces sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga'i lag len dang man ngag gi gnad gsal bar bkod pa bdud me+e bum bzang zhes bya ba ni/ mkhyen pa dang chub la sogs pag tan du ma zugs rgyud bstams shing /7 rgyal dbang 'jigarten gsum mgon mardza gi'aphrin las bsgrub pa la zla dang bral ba'i go gos can khu bo chen po.a chi thu mkhan po rje drung tho bzang phun tshogs kyis 7 gong sa lha mi rnam 'dren mchog gi zhabs brtan la shin tu bsas pa maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga'i lag len dang man ngagagi gnad rnams gsal bar bkod pa/ cha lag tshang ba 'di lta bya zhig dgos zhes bskug zhing / bal bod kyi sa mtshams su 7 rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang spro'i zhabs brtan du ched dmigs kyis sgrub sdi gsar btsugs khrims ldan gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi tshogs 'don du 'dzugs rgyu sogs kun la phan che b.ralang bsams lte/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul r+ṇi b+thā rgyan du 'dzin cing 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag bo chen yi lung gis paṇ+ḍi tar bsngags pa rgyal khams pa dge slong ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi d+ku tshog pa zla ba'i dkar tshes rgyal ba dang yi nyin pho brang chen wa rwa/ ta la'i gzims chung thede ba can du sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang thub pa'i bstan pa rin lpa rā phyogs thams cadadu 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur gi /'dis mtshonadus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dang / /rje bag hral ma'i lha tshogs zugs rje yis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gzhung sa che'i/ chos srid mnga' thang nub med rgyas gyur cig /ces lha ldan par pa dpal ldan dang sprug g.yab tho bzang brtson 'grus sogs kyis par 'di gsar bskrun bgyis pa'i 'a1 zugan 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ho
༄༄tsho/ /sgrol ma g.yul bzlog ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga dgra las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༄ / /na mo gu 4ār+ya twa re ya/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pa'i nor bus kyang / /lha mi'i rin chen bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /stong gsum byur bor bkang ba'ang zil ga' pa/bla ma mchog dang rje btsun sgrol ma ni/ /dbyer med zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag byas te/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bdud bzhi'i chu klung 'bum/ /ma lus yongs su bzlog byed sgrol mdos kyi/ /chu lon ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa bri/ /'dir snyol ma g.yul bzlog ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ yid ches shing dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir pho rgyus dang / cho ga dngos gnyis las/ dang spro ni/ smigs dus kyi 'gro ba la zugs brtsebar dgongs te/ byad kha dang mthu bzlog pa dang / mna' zos pa dang / gza' skar ngan pa dang / rdzas ngan dang / lha 'dre drag bo dang 'gras pa'i gnod pa sdubazlog pa dang / 9rims nad dang / god ka gcod pa dang / mdor na nyes pa thams cad ba'og cing dge legs thams cad spel ba'i phyir/ mgon spro klu sgrub kyis mdzad ces grags so/ /de yang sngon rgya gar shar phyogs su rgyal spro zhig gis/ mu stegs skad chen gyi bu bsad pas/ mu stegs des rgyal bo 'khor bcas klu la gtad/ de'i sang nub rgyal yi pho brang du sprul chen bo ha ha zhes 9zer ba byung bas/ rgyal bo 'khor bcas brgyal zhing 'chi bar thug pa'i tshe/ mja gnas nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis mo ga 'di byas pas/ sprul des rgyal zla'i lir+sha chu mig nas bton/ mu stegs kyi nyi bo mchus gzhibs te shi/ yang za hore gyi yul du rgyal bo sgriXm sgyu zhes pas/ snge brgyad drag shul can thams cad khyad du bsad/ mi dge ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs byas pas snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad khros te thabs gang gis kyang ma phan par/ gu ngu mthar byed ces pas cho ga 'di byas pas mi nor rgyas shing ga yo rdzas par gyur pa gas nyin rlabs che ba'i lorgyus shinargya mang zhing / mkhas grub mang bos phyag len mdzad/ jo bo chen spros bsnams te ston pa rin po che la gnang nas rim par brgyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa la bh+yor ba dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang spro ni/ gnas khang gi
gung du/ pad 'dab kyi steng rje btsun ma'i sku byin rlabs can zhig bzhugs su gsol/ gnyer spyod 'go yon dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bzang mang dang / gtor ma gsum bshams/ rje btsun ma'i dbu la dar dkar gyi gur phub/ rin yo ca brdar ba'i 'jim pa la tshe'u spe zhol lcags ri dang bcas pa ji ltar 'tsham pa'i nang du/ zan las byas pa'i ngar mi mtho gang pa gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis smras pa rta la bskyon g.yon ma'i lha'i gzugs dpagatu med pa byung / des nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par byas/ rgyal ba thams cad la mar ṇā sprin chen spro sprul pas gos par mar/ gzhan yang sprin chen po sprul pa las bdud ci'i char rgyun babs pas/ dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi mi rnams zhi zhing tshim par byas/ lha'i snya dang bcas pa'i 'od zer slar log /rang gi sems zla ba phyag mtshan sngags dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyiganas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rje bam ma 'phags ma snyol ma skyamadog ljang r+gha zhal gagi phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yone dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag gnyisarok+ṣal sngon bos mtshan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la mdzes shing zla ba'i shod kyi rgyab yol can/zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing / ga41 bsnyams pa'i tshul gyis bla mayi dam skyabs gsum bka' sdod dang bcas pas bawor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i nyi borayo dkar bo/ mgrin para.āḥdamar bo/ thugs spur hāX sngon bos mtshan par gyur/༷: yo pad+ma ut+na boyi swāhā/ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas gnas lnga byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ bo ta la yi gnas mchog nas/ ces sogs kyo ka gcig gi rjes su/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang / bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba ma lug pa/ /mar pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rigs drug rgyud lnga'i 'gro kun dang / /sde brgyadaXgadon pa /gas 'byung spro'i tshogs/ /rbad 'dre lan chags mgron rnams kyang / /mar sbyinaXgnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes spyan drangs nas phyag mchod rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ rje bag 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / zhes pa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i bar spyan 'drenalan lag bdun pa bya/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig skabs dang bstun nas bca pa'i mjugargya/ sgrol gsol gyi mthar/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bzlog pa tshar re rol mo drag brdung dang 4sa pa bya/ yang sngar ji lta ba bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ yan lag bdun pa/ sgrol ma/ snyol gsol dang bcas lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/
byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma dang bo bla jim dang rje bag ma mag gsum chos bsrung dang bcasu pa la/ smyo kā ros phul te.a ༷ sogs nyis mchod/ gnyis pa gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron dang bcas pa dang / gsum pa rigs drug khung rje'i mgron rnams la.a kā go'e/ sam+bharas baspros lte/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod do/ /'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rol mo dbyangs ci rigs dang bcas pas/ na mo/ bla ma yi dam rje btsun grol ma dang / mchog gsum chos skyong bsrung ma'i nyin rlabs dang / gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags bden pa dang / /'di ltar mchod sbyin bgyis pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnal 'byor dbon slob sbyin bdag bcas pa la/ /lha klu dri za grul bum sha za dang / /sul bo brjed byed spyo ༄da de dag ni/ /rgan kon bu dang bu mo 'khor g.yog bcas/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro log 'dren gshin rje dang / /rgyal 'gong mkha' 3nga sa bdag klu gnyan tshogs/ /gnod sbyin 'byung spro btsan bdud yi dwags dang / /drang srong gza' skar lo zla zhag dang ni/ /za ma sogs la rgyu ba'i gdon bgegs kyi/ /gago 'che'i bsam bh+yor ma lus zhi gyur cigso ༄/ra 'dod dgu'i dam rdzas 'di ster zhing / /bsgu med bden pa dam pa'i chos 'chad )/ /bdag dang rgyu smor lho bdag 'khor bcas la/ /mi nad phyugs nad gdon bgegs na6 pa dang / /mi nor longs r+sā 'phel ba'i 'gal rkyen dang / /dus min 'chi dang lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /gca pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog par mdzod/ ces 'phri / las bcol/ de nas rang nyid rje bag mar gsal ba lnga 'o'i rgyal spro rta mgrin du bsgyur te/ hwaX/dam chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams/ /'dir ni brtsol ba'i las rnams mgu/ maca sbyin chen bo cad dang bcas/ /che gi'i glud du khyad la 'bul/ /'di la gago par ma mdzad cig /snang srid lha 'dre sne brgyad spro/ /sngags 'chang nga yi bka' r+ṇa la/ /gzhan gyis rbad par ma nyan cig /gso bgegs chen bo thams cad kyang / /bsam bh+yor ngan pa zhi bar gyis/ /khyed rnams dgyes pa'i gtor ma dang / /srog chags nor glud mang
bo dang / /la rdzas lung rdzas 'go dgur bcas/ /yid 'ong khang pa spe'u zhol dang / /dar gyi gur phub 3ra ri ri/ /'bru tshom dgu yi khri la bzhag /dar glud rgyan can sna tshogs dang / /yid 'ong rta yi tshogs makyogs la/ /'bru yi ngar mi chen bo bskyon/ lus la gser g.yu'i rgyan cha btags/ /rgyan ga yid 'ong sil li li/ /dar gyi gos gyon lhubs se lhubs/ /smra ba mkhas dang 'dzum mdangs can/ /'og na rta zhon zhungs se zhungs/mgo la thod bcings pur ru ru/ /ca 'jo sna tshogs bsgyur la mkhas/ g.yu yi lham chung zul lu lu/ /gser gyi ska rags khyugs se khyugs/ /nam rgyang ldem pas sku la brgyan/ /pho gdong yo gdong mi skad smra/ /mnga' ris 'go dgur tshang ba rnams/ /yon bdag glud du khyed la 'bul/ /yid 'ong nor ni mang bo dang / zhal zas zhim dgu mngar dgu dang / /'khor g.yog ngare mi sum cu dang / /sman spros sgron me gsal ba rnams/khyed la mchos par 'bul lags kyi/ /sngags pa phur bu bsgril ba dang / /yungs spur spyon gyis brabs pa dang / /zor kha sna tshogs 'phen pa dang / /gtad gnon sbyor ba 'gyed pa tsams/ /de dag nus pa phyir bzlog cig /bon bo rnga gshang brdung ba dang / /sngo dmar 'ur ko 'phen pa dang / /btsodamar 'phen par byed pa bzlog /drag sngags phra men gago pa dang / /snge brgyad drag spro bskul ba rnams/ /de dag nus pa phyir bzlog cig /chos skyong lha 'dre thams cad kyang / /la la dkor cha'i shul du 'grang / la la mna' zan gshed du 'ong /༈ /la la stegs pas drag bor rbad/ /la la bden pa'i rgyu 'bras ston/la la rims nad dal yames gtong / /'ga' zhig sad dang ser ba gtong / /char mi —'bab dang lo nyes byed/ /lan chags bu lon 'ded pa dang / /nye 'brel grogs kyi shul du 'brang / /mdze nad gtong ba'i klu rnams dang / /gago byas lan ldon klu rnams dang /sha khrag srog dbugs za ba deng / /'bras bu 'o dgag za ba dang / /dar snabs mi gtsang za ba dang / /'byung ba'i lha dang sa bdag dang / /lo dang spar kha sme bar bcas/ /kun rda
kyang glud kyis mnyes gyur swo /gago 'gal ngan pa zhi bar ma'/ /bu yon lan chags da gzhal pho/ /bdag cag yongs rma 'phel bar mgu/ /rkyen ngan bar gago nyir bzlog cig /lho gtong nus pa bzlog tu gsol/ /bsams pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /byams pa'i sems kyis mchod sbyin bgyi/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis dam chos bshad/ /ṣ+ṭha kyang ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da ni byams sems ldan par gyis/rang rang lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan gyi lus la gnod ma byed/ /sdig bh+yongs thar pa'i lam la snyegs/ /nad dang dal yams bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod dang / /lo tog char chu rgyas par mdzod/ rmo bur brgyad cu rtsagacig bzlog /ye 'grog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsabazhi'i nad rnams bzlog /stong phrag brgyad cu'i gdon rnams bzlog /yas bdud g.yos dang mas sri langs/ /pha tshan rgya 'dre thams cad dang / /ma sru'i byur 'dre thams cad bzlog /lo zla zhag dus ngan pa bzlog /phung 'dre thams cad bzog tu gsol/ /srid la brku ba bzlog tu gsol/ /byis pa'i gdon rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /mi kha kha mchu ma gtong zhig /gzhan gyi g.yul ngo zhi bar gyis/bdag gi dmag thabs legs par mgo/ /myos shing 'thibs pa bsal ba dang / /nyin gcig nyin gnyis nyin gsum pa/ /rims nad thams cad zhi bar marode/ /nyam nga 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol/ /yul phyogs dge bar mdzad du gsol/ /dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'thab r+sha zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /pho brgya 'tsho dang ston brgya mthong ba dang / /bkra shis ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang / /bgo nams nyi go bzhin du 'bar bar mdzod/ /mi phyed mi gzhig kun gyi dngos grub stsol/ /de nas mdos sna 'khrid mkhan/spros sna dang / mngar skyur gyi gser skyems pa/ spros phor ba/ rol mo mdos rgyab pa sogs tshar du dngar/ bdag nyid kho ro'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mdos 'phen par nyin te/ 'di ltar/ hrīḥng ni khrag 'thung rta mchog dpal/ /srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /nyon cig lha
