dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can lang tsho rgyas pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la mdzes shing brjid chags pa/ dwangs gsal go kyi rang bzhin can/ /go kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i nyi borayo dkar bo/ mgrin paraXāḥdamar bo/ thugs spur hāX sngon bo/ de las go zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mo a ༷ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhwaX baX haXḥrang dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs spu'i hāX las 'od zer 'a'okla/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ sngar bzhin mchod la/ khyed rnams kyisaXbadag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btswab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ yo sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi kho ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma thams cad dag /rkya lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasayo las rin spro che'i r+pā yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang duyo go du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ nas /rol mo rnams dwangs shing bogs ripa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ mo.a ༷ āḥhūX/ sogs kyis byin gyis bsnab la/ yo.ār+ya tu re a ༷ pra hwa ñcha hwaX swāhā/ nas/ sha9 bar gyis mchod/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal bo/ /lha dbyu smi 'am ci yis bsten ma/ kun nas ko cha dga' ba brjid nyis/ /6de dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /zhes pas bstod/ rje btsun ma'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang dang / thugs spur zla gdan la tuX yig dkar yi mthar/ sngags phreng kha dog dkar spro mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer ston spu'i zla ba 'bum dus gtso tu shar ba lta bu dkar phrom phrom 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang /tshe 'dor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par
du phanatshun r+sha pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / btson rar 'ching ba'i sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi las thams cad sbyangs/ 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byas/phro zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad dang khyad par du 'jigs pa dang ga btso de dag gis nyen pa'i 'gro ba rnams la phog pas/pa las ngan sbyangasate 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal de dang de las thar par bsam la/ yo tu re tu: re tu re sarba dur so ba ni mo tsa na ya swāhā/ zhes pa bzla/ kha cig las/ yo twa re tu: reXtu re mo tsan ya swāhā/ zhes dang /muñca na ya swāhā/ zhes kyang 'byung / bsnyen pa'i gras/ yi ge 'bum bzlas na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes mesungs pas/ rab 'bum phrag bcu/ 'bring lnga / tha ma gcig bzla'o//bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mchod bstod bya/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ zhes sogs sam/ bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun sgrol ma zugs rje chen bo dang ldan pa khyed kyis/ bdag cag phan tshun r+sha pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang /khri mun du bcug pa sogs kyi 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal las skyob par mdzad du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab/ rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba snya stod smad nas rim gyis 'od du zhu nas/ thugs spu'i twaX yig la thim/ de yang rim gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rje bag ma sgrol ma'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsam la dgib brdzo/ thun mtshams su 'tsher so gsum gyi rnal 'byor la bslab/ gtor ma 'bul 'dod na/ dkar gsum sogs kyi gtor ma zlum bo bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasam las rin kro ce'i ñcā yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du'atsha na du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen bor gyur/ yo.āḥhwaX/ lan gsum/ mar pa gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang sga zugs lnga'i sa bon las lho zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje bag ma ga bsngalathams cad sel ba'i sprol ma la rgyal ba sras bcas kyis balhokha ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ jigs go zer gyi sgagus gtor ma'i bcud thams
cad drangs lte gsol bar gyur par bsam la/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags la i daX ba m+wa ta btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas 'bul/ mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ rang la bstim pa'am gshegs su gsol ba gang mos bya'o/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sa stegs gtsang mar ba byung dang dris byugs par maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la bum pa dkar spro rtswaX yig gis mtshan pa'am/ hwaX yig gam tshom bu dkar bo tsam bkod/ mdun du gtor ma dang mtha' mchod pas bskor/ seng ldeng nags sgol lam 'di de nyid kyi bdag bskyed gong bzhin song rjes/ dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i tshe b.ra.a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bum pa dkar spro hwaX yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i sgrol ma/ zhes pa nas/bzlas pa la thug gi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs gzhan don yin na/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgrub bya che ge mo tha mal pa'i rnam pa can 'khod pa la/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las r+p+pa zer dang bdud rtsidakar gra'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste lus la thim pas/ tshe rabs jog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du/ kha mchu gling gzhi sogs phan tshun cud pa dang / baphun rar 'ching ba dang / r+ṇi lam ngan pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal myong 'gyur gyi las ngan thams cad sbyangs/ rje btsun ma'i skyabs 'og tu chud pas/ 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal de dang de las thar par gyur par bsam la gong gi sngags de nyid bzlas pa la brtson par bya/ gtor mgron zur du spyan 'dren mi dgos pa ma gtogs gtor ma 'bul tshul sngar dang 'dra/ thun gsum la sogs pa'i rim pas 'jigs pa las thar pa'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du 'bad par bya'o/ /des ni kha mchu sogs rtsod pa dang /3 lam ngan pa dang / khri mun du chud pa las nges par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'di
nyid skye sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyir du nyams su blangs pare 'dod na/ swa bhā lus stong par sbyangs/ chos kun rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /bdag dang mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i steng /sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i rje btsun ma/ /chu shel ltar dkar phyag g.yas mchog smin mthil/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i bum pa bsnams/ /g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya yis/ /:khral yu ba thugs spur legs bzung ba'i/ /'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha phye zhing / dbu skra phyed bcings lhag ma sil bur babs/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ /'od phung dbus na skyil kung phyed pas bzhugs/ /bcu drug lon pa'i nyams ldan lang tsho rgyas/ /zhi 'dzum mdzes shing brjid chags dwangs shing gsal/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis legs mtshan pa'i/ /hāX las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs thim zhing gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs te/ /dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan/ /phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshang ma'am brel dus su/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal pho sogs brjod cing / rje btsun 'phags ma sprol ma dang / /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa 'am/khyod zhabs pad+mor sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig rdung so sor bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /'khor ba ma stongs bar du legs bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos 'khor ma lus bskor du gsol/ /bdag gzhan dge kun byang chub chen por bsngo /zhes pa brjod de tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs bya/ /bum pa'i nang dang thugs spur zla gdan la/twaX yig sngags phreng dkar spros bskor ba las/ /zla 'od lta bu'i 'od 'phros rang gzhan gyi/ /las ngan kun sbyangs rtsod dang r+ṇi lam ngan/ /btson rar chud sogs 'jigs dang sdug bsngal las/ /thar bar byas te bde la bdod par bsam/ au tu re tan+d+ra re tu re sarba dur sobanimotsanayaswāhā/ mnganyu skabs sbyarabazlasamatharayigabargyadang/
ār+ya tu re.a ༷ zhes sogs kyis/ /mchod cing bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang shes bya/ /rje btsun bcame ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /zhes sogs 'go r+pā gsol 'debs rgyas pa'am/ ba༄me ldan 'das mas bdag dang dmigs yul rnams/ /phan tshun r+sha dang 3 lam ngan paXdang /btson rar chud sogs 'jigs dang sdug bsngal rnams/ /rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs shing bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes pas gsol btab nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun gyi lha 39 snod zhu rang la thim/ /rang yang rim gyis 'od gsal stong par gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las chu las nya bzhin du/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i skuXru bzhengs par bsam/ /ro ༄'i thugs dam sgrol ma nyer gcig las/ /sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /rje༄ 4) gzhung dang dge 'dun bkra shis dang / /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yig cha las/ /zur du phyungs te bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ don tshan gsum gyis lag tu blang bder bkod/ /gnyis pa slob dpon chen spro nyi ma sbas pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag la gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang / las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang spro ni/ 'di'i lugs kyi rjes gnang dang man ngag thob cing nyi sgrub nyi bsten pa sngon du song ba'i sgrub pa spros khrus byas gos gtsang ma gyon/ ras khris la sogs pa'i rten bshams pa'i mdun du stegs gtsang ma'i khar/ ba'i sbyi ba sa la ma lhung bas byugs par dkyil 'khor byas te/ de'i dbus su kyil dzaḥs mtshan pa bri/ der me rtog gi tshom bu bkod/ phyi rol du me tog sri tshom bu lnga 'god/chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang / zhol ma la gtor ma gcig rang gi chos skyong dang /mkhe' 'gro nyi dang / gzhi bdag sogs la ci 'byor bshams/ 'di rnal 'byor chen m+mu rgyud la brten pa yin pas/ 'byor na nang mchod kyang bshams/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad gi gis rje bag ma sgrol ma ga bsngal thams cad bsreg par mdzad ma'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsam la/ mchod pa cho ga snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod yod na/ stong pa'i ngang las sha lnga bdud rtsilnga'i steng du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa zhu ba las zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen spror gyur par bsam la
'byu gsum lan gsum brjod/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dzaḥyongs su gyur pa lasaltaspyabala'am me thab dzaḥs mtshan pa/ de las go zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma sgol ma sdug bsngal thams cad bsreg ma sku mdog dkar mo/zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs spur me thab bsnams pa/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sems dpa'i skyil mo sprung gis bzhugs pa/ rin bo che'i rgyan dang 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i 'phreng ba brgyan pa/ gzi bajid dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa༈ de'i thugs kur phyagaXmatshan sa 11 gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ yo.ār+ya twa re stse sogs mardzo pa lngas mar/ dzaḥhūX baX gorang dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi nyi bor yo dkar bo/ mgrin par āḥdamar bo/ zugs tar hwaX sngon bos mtshan par gyur/ slar yang thugs lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/dbapu sga lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangasayo pañca ku la sa pa ri sgrur puspro sogs kyis mchod/ mo sarba ta thā ga ta.a r+nghi ṣiñca tu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbangaXbaskur dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa4 nas/ bdag gis dbang bskur ro/mo sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi sto ka ta sa ma ya ñcā ye hāX/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag /bde ba chen bo myong / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'dir kha cig las kyi rigs su 'dod kyang thams cad mkhyen pa bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'thad ces gsungs/ de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las bdag bskyed bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ rang gi thugs spu'i sa bon las spros pas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchode par gyur par bsam la/ spro na/dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ zhes sogs dang / lha yi me rtog dam pa 'dis/ zhes
sogs tshigs bcad dang bcas/ yo.ār+ya tu re sa pa ri gara.a ༷ blo hwa ñcha sruhwa/ zhes sogs chu gakhi nyer tsho rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ phyag 'tshal nyer gag tshang mas bgu pa'am/de tsam mi nus na/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal spro/ zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rang dang mdun bskyed gnyis spu'i thugs lngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bstor ba las go zer dkar spro me ltar gzi bajid che ba 'phros/ 'phags pa mchode/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/4 khyad par du sems can bca du bzung ba rnams kyi las r+p+pa gyi sdug bsngal thams cad gasreg nas/ go zer tshur 'dus te yig 'bru rnams la thim pas gzi bajid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na yo.ār+ya༄ bo'o ki te sha ra ya/ lho twi satwa ya/ mahwa satwa ya/ mahwa spun ru ṇi kā ya/ tabyathā/ ri dzu gadha ri/ nir ma te/ twa re ljo ra ya/ ṣ+ha ga gte tu: re/ lham lha ye mo tsani tu re swāhā/ zhes pa bzla/ gasgrub bya dmigs bsal ba yod na/ sngags brgya nare song bzhi mdzams su/ che ge mo btson rwa las thar par maphrad cig /ces pa bcug ga bdun bdun bzlas/ bzlas pa'i rmojug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskangs la mchod bar+sā bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mar gtor rnams cho ga snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i jigs 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs lte gsol bar gyur par bsam la/ yi ge bcu pa las daX ba rlung ta btags pa gsum sogs kyis gtor ma dang yo rje btsun ma la 'bul/ mchod cing bto/rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma zugs rje can/ shes sogs kyis 'dod don zhu zhing bsgrub bya dmigs bsal bgo na/ myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i 'phro la/ khyad par sngon bsags las ngan 'brag bu yis/ /btson rar chud pa'i nyam thag stems can 'di/ /—brtsildan 'phags ma'i zugag rjes skyobs marga la/ /sdug bsngal 'di las myur du drang du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum sogasna kyis gsol ba dragatu btab bo/ /dzogator ma gnyis
pa nyin gyis brlab la/ yo shrī sto pā la sa pa ri sgrura.i daX sogs kyis nyi sgeragyi chos skyong la phul/ sngags de la.a sogs btags pas mgu/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das sogs kyis bstod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas kyis/ /macode sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las kyis/ /gdag cag bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /ces dang /dmigs bsal go na/ khyad par rngo/ btson rar tshi/ srung ma rnams nyis mthu stobs nus ga yis/ /myur du drangs te bde la 'go par mgu/ /ces 'phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma gsum pa/ a kā ros 'byung spro nyi la bsngos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/gzhi bdag la sogs mthu ldan tshebargyad rnams/ /'go yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bstan dar 'gro kun bde dang ldan pa dang / /bdag sogs bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mgu/ /ces bca/ yig brgyas kha bskang / bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par sgyur par bsam la bsngo smon sogs bya'o/ /de ltar thun bzhir bcad de bsnyen pa khri tsho gcig yan chad rdzogs par bya'o/ tsho/gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyas par byed nad kyis cho ga bzhin shes par bya la/ bsdun/ bag pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba'i maṇ+ḍal khris/ mar gtor bshams/sgrub grogs dang bcas pas bdag mdun sngar bzhin bsgom la/ mchod pa rgyas par 'bul/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa lan gsum sogs kyis ba༄de/ smra ba bcad/ sgrub grogs re mos kyis sngags rgyun ma chad par bzla shing /largya re song baXdang / mgo bsto mdor bsdus re byas la/ bcom ldan 'das ma zugs rje chen bo dang ldan pas che ge mo shes bya ba 'di nyid btson ra las myur du thar par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ brgya brgya re thon pa dang mchod bstsa rgyas pa re byas la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ thun mthar gtor ma 'bul tshul sngar dang 'dra/mdun bskyed gshegs gsol mi byed par/ thun phyi ma rnams la sngarayode gsal 'debs tshul gyis bskyed/ thun bzhi'am nyin mtshan drug tu cad de sngags rgyun bar ma chad par bya ba rnams nyi dang
'dra/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis btson ra las thar pa'i mtshan ma byung gi bar 'bad/ sgrub pa ga nyid bgo par gsol la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /'di ni rtags yang yang thon pa'i myong grub yin zhes gsungs so/ /sdug bsngal bsreg pa'i snyol ma yis/ /bca 'don cho ga bya ba'i tshul/ /mal sdu kangags kyi man ngag la/ /brten nas kun mkhyen bha ston gyis/ /gsal bar mdzad pa ji ltar bar/ /phyo man rnams la phan pa'i ched/ /shin tu 'khyir bder bkod pa'o//lha gsum pa rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs nas brgyud pa'i man ngagal gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang / las bh+yor ro/ /dang spro ni/ dben pa'i gnas su rten dang / mar gtor rnams tshogs par byas la/stan bde ba la 'kho de/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams rgyud dang 'dres nges pa t+yā du btang / rang nyid skad po gis rje bag ma sprol ma'i skur bzhengs par gyur par bsam la/ mchod pa rnams gong bzhin spyan gyis brlabs/ rang nyid rje btsun ma grol mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'ihwaX yig jing rgu/ de las go zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje bag ma krol ma bla ma don lho grub pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbu la brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis gabastor ba mdun gyidam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu nu bh+yaḥ na ma twa ra lha ga ge sa pa ri1ra bh+yaḥzhes pas phyag bya/ tu ra bhā ga warti sa pa rimara.a ༷ sogs kyis maca/ dag mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ dzaḥhāX ba 6tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur par bsam la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ swa bhā pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dnga.a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi stengs rang gi sems nyidahwaX yig jing gu/ de las go zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mar/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma snyol ma sku mdog ljang gu /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas kyi dang bos lcags kyu dang/ gnyisapami'ajigasapaskya sasbyinagyiphyag rgya mdzad

bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mtshode/ /tshig rkang nyi ma gsum 'dra ba la/ rma bya'i mdangs bkra dbang khra'i glud/ /5 5 gu ngar glud 'byung bzhi lus kyi glud/ / 5 5 4 srog chags sna tshogs phyugs kyi glud/ /5 5 5 dur ba rin chen tshe yi glud/ /5 5 5rin chen sna lnga bca nams glud/ /5 5 5 'bras bu sna tshogs dpal 'byor glud/5 5 5 3nga bzhi gling phran dbang thang glud/ /5 5 chos kyi rgyal spro gshin rje'i tshogs/'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /da ring sbyin pa'i bdag spro yi/ /tshe dang srog gi glud 'bul gyi/ /mchod yon 'bru sna sna tshogs dang / /'go yon rin chen sna lnga dang /zhal zas me rtog nag bos maca/ /de dag long la tshe srog sbyin/ /bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams na/ /skye rga na 'chi'i ming yang med/ /de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa/ /skye rga na 'chi las grol te/ /bde ba can du skye bar shogbden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /sbyin pa'i bdag bo 'khor dang bcas/ /nad dang 'chi bdag las grol nas/ /tshe dpag med pa'i sku thob shog /ces brjod/ de nas rgyal chen bzhi la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mar gtor byin gyis rlabs la/ yo e h+ye lha/ tsa tur mahwa rā dza sa pā ri gar sa ma ye/ zhes spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye staX/ zhes gdan 'bul/ yo rnyi ta rā 2 ya/ yo thi rū bhā ka ya/ yo ji mṛ ba ṇ+ṭha ya sa pā ri sgrur bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta skyo ji shu mu khe bh+ya sarba tad khaX.uṅga te spa ra ṇas maX ga ga na khaX gri t+na da ba p+lu ta ya swāhā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ yo tsatur mahwa rā dza sa pā ri sgrur a ༷ sogs kyis mar/ rgyal bo chen bo dpal ldan pa/ /ma rgad mdog mtshungs spa wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ /kha dog sngon bo ral gri 'dzin/ /phrul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/
'phags skyes bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen spro mthu bo che/ /kha dog dmar ser sprul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la mnga' mdzad pa/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded daspron chen spro gser mdog can/ /wa con dang ni sna'u le 'dzin/ /gago sbyin tshogs la dbang basbyar ba/ /rnam 'os sras la phyag 'tshal pho/ /rgyal chen bzhi bo 'khor bcas kyis/ /masdangad sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ cha gsum gtor ma gzhung ltar 'bul/ /'brang rgyas dkar nag mtshams nas bcad de/nag yi dpal 'bar lnga yar sngar/ khrus khu phor pa dang lhan cig gshin rje'i drung du bzhag ste can gyis rlabs/ sam+bha ra'i sngags lan bdun gyis gshin rje 'khor bcas lam rgyags tshul du bsngos la/ yo ya ma rā dzā sa pā ri gar a ༷ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mgo/ rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal brtan bos/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hwaX 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpag tshad brgyad khra'i pha rol na/ /thod pa lcags rtu grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sdodapon spro/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo/ /gson gshin kun gyi zam kha pa/ /gson spro rkos la 'debs pa spro/ /shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa/sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /legs nyes chos bzhin sprode pa bo/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can/ /'khor bcas deng 'dir bdag la dgongs/ /khyod kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags la/ /bza' ba bzang bo 'di 'bul gyi/ /'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams/ /ma 'tsho bar ni gzhan du dengs/ /zhes dang / ya ma rā dzā sa pā ri gar garngo/ zhes bca la thal mo brdabs/ sum+bha ni dang las sngags brjod cing /yungs tar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bodug /rol mo'i tsham rngams dang bcas/ gshin rje'i gzugs rdzongs chas gtor ma nyer spyod khrus chu gdan zhal khobs cha gsum sogs yo byad ma lus pa lha'i grong zad mthar bskyal/ gzugs bdeb pa sogs mayin par masga ༄gar bstan la mdun du rdzongs chas rnams bzhag la/ skyel mkhan rnams 3 mig mi blta bar bya'o/ /de nas glud gos kyi tshon
skud grol te bsgrub bya'i ske la brtson/ sne gnyis kyis lag pa'i srin mdzub dang rkang pa'i mthe bong la dkri/ nad pa lta bu tsog pyar 'dug mi thub pa rnams la g.yon pa kho na la bcings pas 'thus/rang bdud rtsi'akhyil pa'i skur bsgyur nas/ snyu ba 'ag rgyal gyi phyag rgya byas te/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsab dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 5 chos kyi gu dge 'dun gyi tshi de bzhin gshegs pa dang /do rje dang /ri rin bo che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang /snying bo dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang / rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad dang / khyad par du yang rje bag ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ bsgrub bya'i sdig sgrib/ nad gdon/ lo skeg /zla skeg /zhag skeg /dus skeg /chag che/ nyam nga / btsog grib/ mi gtsang ba/mthu gtad/ bdud kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen ngan pa thams cad tshon skud 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig /ḍak+ki hāX dzaḥ lan gsum byas/ a mṛ ta sogs drag tso'i sngags brjod cing / ye shes kyi ral grir mos pa'i mtshon gyis tshon skud dum bu dum blor bcad cing / gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang / /tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong / /gnod sbyin sne dbon dbang phyug che/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa ste/ /de dag rnams kyi gzi byin gyis/ /byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig /yo sarba bca naX ka kho rda 2 da nā ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing tshon skud gtubs pa de lag pa g.yon pa sa bsgrub bya la g.yon du bskor nas kham phor nang gi dug dang 'o chu la dor zhing / las bum gyi chu thigs gcig zugs la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jigarten dug gsum ste/dkon mchog gsum la dug mi mnga'/ /dkon mchog gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /snying po yi ge bcu pa 'don/ /sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ /sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /bden
pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /de bzhin du chu dang me dang rlung la sbyar/ khung po 'don/ bsgrub bya 'di la 'byung ba dang 'byung gyur gyi dug thams cad shāca ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bapo/ glud nas tshon skud dug phor dang bcas byang phyogs kyi grong zad sar bskyal nyi mig mi blta bar bya'o/ de nas bum chus bsgrub bya'i lus ril po'am yan lag rnams bkras shing / ji ltar bltams pa nas/ bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /'khyil sgas kyi mthar/ che gi d+ku sdig pa rang sgrib pa thams cad shāca ku ru ye sruhwa/ de bzhin du sbyang te/ nad thams cad/ khon/ grib/ rims/ byad/ byur/ skal ba ngan pa/ smi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ mi kha ngan pa/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba/ lo skeg zla skegzhag dang dus skeg /rgyal khra'i 'jigs pa/ chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gago pa/ btsan dang rgyal yi gago pa/4 ku gnyan dang sa bdag gi gso pa/gdon dang bgegs/ bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sbyar cag bkras pas sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen thams cad dag par bsam/ gal te dngos su bkur mi rung na gzugs brnyan bris pa dung me long du shar ba la yang bkur rung ngo / /de nas bsgrub bya'i khar chu cung zad 'dzin du bcug la/ do rje dang bcas pa rma bya'i r+sā chun yi steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i twaX yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las cad zer 'phros pas bsgrub bya la bkus shing ma dag pa'i skyon lhag ma rnams sngags kyi 'ode zer gyis byabs pas kha nang gi chu la thim par bsams la sngags nyi mthar/ che ge m+mu sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ sogs gong bzhin sbyar la/ kha chu de khrus chur bor la/ na mo ྅ btsun rtsab dang sogs dang / bden pa'i nyin gyis gas kyis/ che ge mo la ga' cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung gra'i rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad khrus chu 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song shig /sum+bha sogs ba33 la/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kor gyis brab/ chu bo la sogs par dor ro/ /de nas bsgrub bya gos dkar bo bkon/ gdan dkar po la bzhag ste/
sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang spro lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' 3nga ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing las rgyal bar rgyur/ /chu ni me las rgyal ba ste/ /rlung ni sprin las rgyal bar gyur/ /do ji yis ni rin chen phug lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas/ pa la/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis che ge rolas bya ba bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis par sgyur cig /dza ya dza ya/ si d+dhi si d+dhi/ pha la pha la ga de nas/rang gi thugs lnga'i tu yig las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad khyab/ sha skyi lpags mtshams thams cad 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur te/ nad gdon bgegs sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i bsrung ba chen spror gyur par bsam/ sngags kyi mthar/ che ge dra sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes sbyar te/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs rje yis/ /'gro ba 'di nyid bdag gis bsrung zin gyi/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye sruhwa/zhes brjod cing / bsgrub bya'i nyi bo lus kyi mdun rgyab/ dpyang pa g.yas g.yon/ dpyi g.yas g.yon rnams su do rje rgya gram du bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas 'brang rgyas dkar wa de bsgrub bya'i lag tu gtad de/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas/ /snying spro bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni//de ring bu yis za bar bgyis/ /'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /zhal zas bsten pas nad kun las/ /grol 'gyur ze tshom bya mi dgos/ /snying bo brjod cing za ru /cug go/de nas shis pa brjod cing me rtog gi char dbab/ gsum pa rjes kyi chog ni/ mar
pa rnams kha gsos lte nyin gyis rlabs la 'bul/ 'khor ba las sgrol ma thoka gcig gis balhod/yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nyis nongs bshags bya/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes rten lho na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs nyis brtan bzhugs dang / rten med na/ badz+ra muḥsaye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim pa'i mos pa dang / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa badz+ra muḥ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa'i 'ode kyi 'khor 59 phyo nas rim bzhin nang mar thim/rang yang sku'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu ste snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste 'ja' yal ba lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rje btsun ma'i skur lam gyis gyur par bsams la/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis m+bhi ltar bya'o/ /dge 'odes yab rje mnyam med tsong kha pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /yid can kun la bkra shis dge legs kyi/ /mtshan mas yongs khyab dka' ston 'phel bar shog /ces rje btsun ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'chi bsgru bya tshul tshe dpal pad+mo rgyas byed byin rlabs kyi nyi ma bdun 'bar zhes bya ba 'di bzhin zlo ldan rnams la 'chi bzu gsar rtsom gyi ming len pa las sla bas dgos pa chung yang r+pā gnyer can mang pos bskul ba la brten nas/ 7btsun pa ngag dbang lbo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ dam tshig do ྅sa bsod nams kun sdud gling gi bla brang du bsgrigs pa rang gzhan mang bo la phan jogs par gyur cig/ //
༄༄༄/ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor d+ku sgrub thabs bzhugs so/༄༅rgya/ /na mo ār+ya tu re/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo bsgrub par 'go pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang / sems can thams kyi don du myur ba myur bar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i taX yig dkar r+yā 'od zer gyis/ bde ba can dang spro ta la sogs nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ go zer rang gi snying gar thim/ rje btsun 'phags ma slom ma dang / zhes pa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa'i bar dang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'tshi shog /gu pa'i bar bca/ rdzas zhing rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ yo shā n+ya tu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā bo༄m+bha konyahaX/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las goX 'i sa gzhi/ ra gur bla sre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su baX las pad dkar/a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du taX yig dkar spro las tsol taX gyis mtshan pa/ de las go zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon dka mchog gsum mtshon pa'i phyag rgya can/ phyag gnyisagayubal sngon bos mdzes pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ dpral ba'i dbus na ye shes kyi spyan dang / phyag zhabs kyi mthil na rnam thar sgo bzhi mtshon pa'i spyan bzhi mnga' ba/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa'i nyi bor rigs kyi bdag bo tshe dpag med kyis brgyan pa/ nor bu rin bo che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ ska rags/ do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pasabargyanapa/ (rdzasakyid gyir+sāgayogs smad g.yogs
ga shal 'chang ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang spros mdzes pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ 3 3'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i nyi bar yo dkar bo/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs spur zla gdan la taX yig dkar spro hāX r+gha bos mtshan pa/ zugs lnga'i hwaX las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ yo.ār+ya tu re sa pa ri sgrur ye h+ye hi dzaḥhūX baX tadam tshig pa dang gnyis su med pa gyur/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud/ rigs bdag tshe dpag med dang dbyer med du 'dres pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mar pa rnams bya rma ltar bsangs/ sbyangs/nyin gyis brlabs la/ yo.ār+ya tu re sa pa ri sgrura.a ༷ sogs kyis mar/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus nas/ /rab mdzes lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba gang /dran pas tshe dang ye shes mchog stsal ba'i/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/de nas rang rje bam mar gsal ba'i thugs spu'i gas phreng laso go zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi jig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags ma'i ko 'phang la bawo/ r+pā bcud thams cad kyi yon tan dang sangs rgyas byang sems zhi khro rab 'byams rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa 'chi med m+mu bdudañca'i rnam par bkug /m+bhi m+mu tshe dpag med kyi sku dang phyag gi bum par thim/ thim pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi nyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad 'chi med r+b+ya bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang / tshe dang bar nams thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ 'chi med che'i dngos grub thob par bsams te/ yo tu re tu: re tu re ma ma.ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭi ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'tshi gyur nas/ ces sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam dang shis brjod kyis brgyan par bya/ thun mthar gtor ma 'bul na/ dkar gtor gtsang ma bshams la/ bsangs/ sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs spu'i 'ode zer gyis rgyal yum sgrol ma la sangs rgyas byang sems ye shes pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan
drangs pa'i ljags go zer gyi sgu gus drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ yo.ār+ya tu re sa pa ri sgruras daX ba p+lu ta kha kha ṣā 3 sle lha/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod cing sngar ltar bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol te gshegs par bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs tshe dang shes rab bgo nams sogs 'phel zhing / mthar thug bde ba can du skyes nas mchog 'cha par lhar bas phan ā+o shin tu che'o/ /zhes rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sgrub thabs 'di yang /dad pa dang gtong ba dang tshul khrims dang rnam dpyod phun sum tshogs pa grwa tshang chos rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis yang yang nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/ sde r+pā 'dzin pa dge slong khro bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ bkra shis lhun zla'i gzims chung yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'o // //go༅༅/ /rgyal yum sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin dbang gi rgyal spro zhes bya ba bzhugs sa/go༅༅/ /na mo gu ru we/ lha brgya'i gtsug rgyan ngos la zhabs sen gyi/ /nor bu'i go chags rgyal yum rje bag ma'i/ /zhabs pad gus bsten de nyid bsgrub pa'i thabs/ 'go dgu'i mchog sbyin dbang gi rgyal spro bri/ 'dir rje btsun ma snyol ma bsgrub par 'go pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang / ma sems can thams cad kyi don du myur ba myur bar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgrub pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam pa'i khyad par gyi sems bskyed lan gsum mam/ bdun sogs bya/ de nas/ rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs spu'i taX yig sga lho zer gyi/ bo ta la nas bla ma dang gnyis
su med pa'i rgyal yum sgrol ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bstor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ lho zer rang gi snying gar thim/ sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / zhes pa tho ka gcig gis phyag bya/o.āḥhwaX gis nyin gyis brlabs pa'i mgo pa 'khor gsum bden stong du rtogs pa'i ngang nas/ au ār+ya twa re sa pa ri gar a ༷ nas/ shap+ta'i bar dang / me tog bdug slos mar me dri/ zhes pa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces bdun rnam dag byas nas tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs te/ sbyor ba tshogs gsog pa'o/ /de nas/ swa lha was stong par sbyangs nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs gsog /stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid taX yig ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las ut+pal taX gyis mtshan pa/ da las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus/ phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma sprol ma sku mdog ljang sngon gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya thugs zhar mdzad pa'i phyag gnyis lhasprol sngon pos mtshan pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byasaXshing rin bo cha'i dbu rgyan dang / snyan rgyan dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang /zhabs gdub dang / do shal la sogs pa rin lo 3'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ mtshan bzang bo so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus mdzes par byas shing / lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ zla ba'i 'ode kyi rgyab yol can/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs shing / g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i sgyi bor yo/ mgrin par āḥ thugs spur hwaX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bde ba can dang / spro ta la sogs nas badzoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhāX baX godam tshig
pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs spu'i hwaX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ yo sarba ta thā ga ta.a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus gang /dri ma dag /chu lhag pa nyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lo1 dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchode pa rnams badz+ra amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā bos sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ yo ma ma bhūX las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/snamo go du zhu ba las byung ba'i mgo rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ yo āḥhūX/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ yo ār+ya tu re sa pa ri gyura.ar+ghaX nas shatsho bar gyis mar/ bde gshegs kun gyi 'phrin las rnams/mdzes sdug lha mo'i skuran bstan nas/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol bar mdzad la bstod par bgyi/ /marga da yi ri bo ni/ /rgyu skar do shal 'chang ba bzhin/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /mthong bas don ldan mdzad la 'dud/ /dran pa tsam gyis gdon bgegs dang / /nad rims dus min 'chi ba dang / /phyi nang 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs/ /'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas/bden 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i sems gsal stong gi gzung rnam snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rje btsun snyol ma'i sku'i rnam par shar ba/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa lha'i sku phyag rgya chen bo la rtsegacig tu mnyam par 'jog /bsgoms pas skyo na/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs spur zla ba'i steng du/ taX yig hwaX gis mtshan pa'i mthar/ yo twa re turgyu re tu re swāhā/ci zhes pa yi ge bcu pa'i sngags sprang 'od zer dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bas bstor ba pas 'ode zir 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang / sdig
sgrib nad tshogan bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ 'odawer ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ r+pā bcud thamasacad la phog4 pas/ stod thams cad kyi ma dag pa thags cad sbyangs/ bde ba can lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing dang / bcud kyi sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bawo/ yang lho zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mgo pa phul/ de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer sna lnga 'phro bsnge bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi khung ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi nang thams cad khrig mer gyis gang / tshe dang bsode nams lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs par bsams la/ yid ma yengs par bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral bar brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bzla'o/ /mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs de las byung ba'i dge tshogs mtshan mar 'dzin pa dmigs pa'i dug dang ma 'dres par bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /thun gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul bar 'go na/ gtsang zhing bgo pas mdzes pa'i dkar gtor chab kyis bran/ mchod rdzas bzhes pa gtor mar bskyar nas byin gyis brlabs/ rang rje bag sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs lnga'i jitaX yig ba cird zer gyis/ bde ba can dang / bo ta la sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas rnams nas rgyal yum rje btsun sprol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i jigs ṣ+ka kyi sgu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ a kā ro'am/ yang na/ yo.ār+ya hwa re sa pa ri gara.i da ba liṃ ta kha kha ṣā lha ṣā twi/ zhes pa bdun nam gsum sogs gyis phul/ rdza ༷ sogs kyis mchod/ sngar gyi bstod pas bstod/ 'di'i mtshams su long byung na phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gnyis sam gsum mam/ bdun ci rigs bca na 'brel chags shing skabs su babs/ de rjes/ rje btsun bcom
ldan 'das ma zugs rje can/ zhes sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bsngo ba smon lam byas la b.rode par gsol/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs te shis pa brjod do/ /tshul 'di ltar rnal 'byor la ba' par byas pas gnas skabs dang mthar zug gi phanayon bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gsungs pas/ bdag la phan par dgongs pas nyams len la ba' par mdzod cig /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /lus can srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol mdzad bcom ldan rje btsun ma'i/ /sgrub thabs mchog sbyin dbang gi rgyal/ /legs par bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rdzas/ /zla ltar dkar ba ci mchis pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo / zhes rgyal yum sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'gu dgu'i mchog sbyin dbang gi rgyal lo 3sa bya ba 'di ni/ zha lu ri phug nas dge slong gsum ldan ko ྅ 'dzin pa/ zab m+mu don la rtsegacig tu gzhol ba'i bla chen saṅgha shrī d+dha dras bskul ba la brten nas/ mdo rgyud dam pa'i man ngag 'dzin pa'i chos smra ba lbo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ chos grwa chen spro bkra shis lhun spro'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zha lu ba rin chen chos legs so// //༄༅tsho/ /sdug bsngal sel ba'i snyol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/༄cug/ /na yo.ār+ya tu re ya/ sdug bsngal sel ba'i krol ma'i bsgom bzlas bya bar 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ chos kun rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ bdag dang mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i steng / /tuX las ga bsngal sel ba'i rje btsun ma/ /chu shel ltar dkar phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mthil/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i bum pa bsnams/ /g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya yis/ /tsol yu ba zugs spur legs bzung sha'i/ /'dab ma snyan gyi thad du
kha phye zhing / /dbu skra phyed bcings lhag ma sil bur babs/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ /lho phung dbus na skyil kung phyed pas bzhugs/ —/bcu drug lon pa'i nyams ldan lang tsho rgyas/ /zhi 'dzum mdzes shing bajid chags dwangs shing gsal/gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis legs mtshan pa'i/ /hāX las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs thim zhing gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang lho 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs te/ /dbang bskur lho dpag med kyis dbu la brgyan/ /nyam thag 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog rje btsun ma/ /rma zhabs pad+mor sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa ma lus 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig stung thams cad bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /'khor ba ma stong bar du legs bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos 'khor ma lus bskor du gsol/ /bdag gzhan dge kun byang chub chen bor bsngo/ /bum pa'i nang dang thugs spur zla gdan la/ /tuX yig sngags phreng dkar bos bskor ba las/ /zla lho lta bu'i 'a 'phros rang gzhan gyi/las ngan kun sbyangs r+sha dang smi lam ngan/ /bca du bcings sogs 'jigs dang sdug bsngal las/ /thar par byas te bde la bgu par gyur/ /yo twa re tu: re tu re sarba du ra so ba ni mo tsa na ye swāhā/ zhes pa gang nus bzla/ yo.ār+ya tu re a ༷ nas/ shatsho bar gyis mar/ phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal bo/ /lha dang mi'am ci yis bsten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba'i bajid kyis/ /rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ /zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang dmigs yul rnams/ /phan tshun k+ṣ+ṇā dang r+ṇi lam ngan pa dang / /ba' du 'ching sogs 'jigs dang sdug bsngal rnams/ /rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs shing bskyab tu gsol/ /mdun gyi lha mo phode zhu rang la thim/ /rang yang rim gyis ṇ+ḍa gsal stong par gyur/ /go pa'i ngang las chu las nya bzhin du/ /bgum ldan 'das ma'i sku ru bzhengs par gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun
sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ de yi sa la 'god par shogces sogs bsngo slon bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i ched du dharma badz+ra gyis tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa'o// //༄༅༅/ /'phags ma sgrol ma nyi sbas lugs kyi tshogs 'khor bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bya tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༄tsho/ /'dir rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgo nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar 'dod pas gnas dben par nyi dor gas par byas rnye rje bag ma'i khris 'bur sku rab gnas can bkram/ mchod pa lhos pad bsham/ mdun du stegs kyi khar tshogs/ gtor ma mkha' 'tsho nu ma ltag bu'i mthar la ga/ /sha chang sogs zas sna gang 'dzom legs par bshams lte/ rang stan bde ba la 'go/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres par byas mthar/ tshogs khang bskyed pa ni/ yo swa lha zhwas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bde stong dbyer med pa'i/ /lde shes rang bzhin lhaXyi gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /stod bcud dag pa lha'i 'khor lor gyur/ /de nas tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron spyan 'dren ni/ yo/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug drug pa ko ྅ 'chang / /rgya bod mkhas grub dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa/ /sras bcas tshogs kyi mgron du gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /bdag gi skyabs gcig bcom ldan rje btsun ma/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las sgrub pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur/gcig lhag nyi shu'i grangs ldan lha tshogs gshegs/ /gzhan yang bgrang yas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs/ /khung rje'i yul gyur rigs drug lan chags mgron/ /zag med tshogs kyi mgron du gshegs su gsol/
yo gu ru ār+ya twa rā sarba bud+dha bo d+dhi sata sa pa ri sgruracwa h+ye 3 dzaḥdzaḥspyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ gdan dbul tshogs dngos gzhir 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgya khyon rab yanges pad+ma'i stso mchog tu/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs mgoXrgya mtsho 'di/ /rtsabargyud bla ma'iXtshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul/ /bzhes nas rnam thar 'khyongs par byin gyis rlobs/yo.āḥgu ru badz+ra rnyi ra sa pa ri gar ga na tsakra pū dza ṣā twi/ rtu/ rgya khyon rab yangs pad+ma'i t+yā mchog tu/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsa'i tshogs mag rgya mtsho 'di/ dag mchog cagasum rgya mcha tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mchog dang thun yodangosartsi phyo/ /'angusasarba rtsayo d+dhi satwa thi ra/ 713 sto pa la sa pa ritwarag na m+wa sbyodza slo lha/ rwa/ rgya sh+ka rab yangs pad+ma'i r+pā mgatu/ /dam rdzas bdud i rdzas mardzo rgya mtsho'ad/ /khung rje'i mgron gyi tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'khrul snang bag chags drung 'byin shog /yo.āḥsha ḍa ku la sā pa ri gar ga na tsakra pū dza ṣā twi/ las kyi ṇ+ṭha sa phud jogs nas/ /ho gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i sh+ka/ /'di la the tshom mi bya ste/bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /dbyer med gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /zhes brjod nas slob dbon la phul/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs chos rnams bzang yo ༄/ /rin thang med par legs 'ong chos/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de nas tshogs la rol/ /lha ma stod gcig tu kugs te stegs kyi khar bzhag /mtshan yin na dpal 'bar bags chab kyis bran te/ rtswa/ rgya sh+ka rab yangs pad+ma'i go mchog tu/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs lhag rgya mtsho 'dis/ /lhag ma'i mgron gyi tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs 'grub par mgu/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la sogs brjod mthar bkra shis kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes nyi sbas lugs kyi sgrol ma'i tshogs 'khor 'bul tshulaX'adi/ rdza mdo bya khyung bla ma zo bzang chos 'grub nas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar/ dge slong zo bzang chos 'byor lhun grub gyis/
dben gnas chos kyi pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /shulhaX// //༄༄gya/ /rje btsun ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor r+ya bla brgyud gsol 'debs byin rlabs can bzhugs so/ /༄༄rgya/ /don kun ma lus grub pa thub pa'i dbang / /'chi med dpal ster yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga rig pa ngag dbang grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'grub byin sprobs/ /paṇa grub gtsug rgyan do rje gdan pa dang / /'jig rten mig gcig ba ri rin chen grags/ /gang des rjes bzung grub chen sle nag par/ /gsol ba zlo /sku tshe mthar nyin bshes gnyen sgre pa'i zhabs/ /bka' phyag gnyis 'dres zla go gago nu rje/ /dbon rigs sgom pa tshul khrims snying spro la/ /gsol ba tshi /thugs sras sgom chung shes rab byang chub dang / /dri med tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul 'dzin zhabs/ /rtogs pa'i bdag nyid 'bri gung gling pa la/ /gsol ba zlo /mtshungs med bla ma dam chos gling pa dang / /mkhas grub chen spro chos kyi tshul khrims dpal/ /skye rgyu'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med lha lung par/ /gsol ba gu /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung thog gnas pa/ /gdams pa'i mar 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyur byang chub bzang spro la/ /gsol ba gu /kun mkhyen chen bo bkra shis rnam par rgyal/mkhas btsun spyan snga bgo nams lha'i dbang spro/ /skye nu'i rnam 'dren dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba tshi /mang thos mkhas pa'i rtser son 'phrin las zhabs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos cher ba do rje 'chang / /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la/gsol ba tshi /gsang chen snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i bslab gsum rje/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /do rje 'changadabang mgo sprobago nams la/ /gsol ba tshi /mkhas grub gnyis ldan chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /kun mkhyen ngag dbang
zlobazang rgya mcha t+yā /snang mtha'i rnam sprulathobazang ye shes la/ /gsol ba ོ /'phags mchog tho bzang bskal bzang rgya mcha mdon/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i ded dbon zla med pa/ /khyab bdag lcang skya rol pa'i do ༄ la/ /gsol ba tshi /dman log lam las zlog byed skyabs sems dang / /bgo nams ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs bsags nas/rgyal yum 'phags ma'i gzugs sku'i phra rags la/ /gsal snang brtan pa 'job par bdag byin sprobs/ /thugs spur 'khor lo yig 'bru'i spro bsdu dang / /rigs kyi bdag yi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /drug ldan 'od gur bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /mnyam gzhag ting 'dzin g.yo ba med par shog /mtho ris chu rgyun ji bzhin chad med pa/ /grag stong sngags kyi bzlas bca sgyur blangs pas/ /lhag pa'i lha mgo 'dzad med byin gas kyi/ /phung spro snying gi pad mtshor 'jug par shog /tshig tsam ma yin deng nas byang chub bar/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo lhag pa'i lhar bsten mthus/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal te/ /gzhom med r+sā 'i tshe srog 'grub par shog /rdul bral ston gyi zla ltar dkar ba'i dgos/ /'gro kun lnga pa'i 'jigs pa las grol ba/ /thar pa'i khang bzang rtser son bdag gzhan gyi/ /don kun sgyun gyis grub pa'i dpal sur shogr+ṣi pa'i lugs kyi rje btsun sgrol dkaralid bzhin 'khor d+ku rjes gnang gibla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la rang gi thob rgyun ltar bla ma gsum gyi mtshan bsnan pa ma gtogs gzhan pa rnams kun kāñjanā r+nghi (byi shārnyitsho sbra sung yin ko/ /zhes pa'ang 7btsun pa ngag dbang tho bzang bstan pa'i go༅༅/ /rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor r+ya thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debasardza(spya snar pa'i chun go sa bya ba ༄༅༅/ /rgyal kun yum gyur yid bzhin 'khor d+ku zhabs/ /ngag dbang grags pa khro

ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ar+ya twa re sa pā ri sgrur bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ mo.ar+ya trī re sa pā ri sgrur a ༷ pra tī ñcha hūX swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ sha9 bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur rig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad liṃ bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur thig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ma sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin 'o tshe thob par bya/ de'i phyir du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ de nas bdag bskyed sgom pa na/ yo swa bhā 4shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā bo(khronyahaX/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad ma dkar bo/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid yi ge taX yig dkar spro/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston spu'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing nor bu chu shel ltar dri ma med pa dwangs shing lho 'phro ba/zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can shin tu mdzes pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon ut+pal dkar gra'i yu ba nas mtheb srin gyis thugs spur bzung ba yal ga gsum du gyes pa snyan gyi thad spur me rtog 'bras bu gang bu gsum gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshon pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ nu bur rgyas shing rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang dar dmar gra'i sham thabs can/ zhabs
do —rje'i skyil mo kung gis bzhugs pa phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun ma/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang lho sgor can/ de'i nyi bora.o dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar bo/ thugs dar hūX sngon bo dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du taX yig dkar bo/ de las cad 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bsgor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhāX baX spoganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs lnga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas yo sarba ta thā ga ta rdza bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūX/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma nyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur par mos la/ yo ar+ya twa re sa pā ri sgrur ar+ghaX pra hwa ñcha sruhwa/de bzhin du shatsho bar gyis mchod/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'aphrin las rnams/rab mdzes yid 'ong lha i skur bstan nas/ /rab mang 'gro la tshe yi mchog stsol ma/rab dkar lha mo ut+pal bsnams la bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ /rang gi khung gar 'khor lo dkar spro rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa mu khyud rim pa lnga dang ldan pa lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid taX yig dkar po/ de'i mtharayo bdag gi tshe dang bson nams 'phel bar gyur cig hwa/ zhes pas bskor ba/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bstor du/ tu re tut+ta re tu re swā/ zhes pa'i yi ge brgyad/mu khyud nang ma la.ā li g.yon bskor/ gnyis pa la kā li g.yas bsgor/ gsum pa la rten 'brel snying bo g.yas bsgor/ sngags thams cad kyang dbu can gyi rnam pa gyen sgreng /bzhi pa la do rje r+gha yi phreng bas bskor ba/ lnga pa la go zer sna lnga'i phreng ba g.yas bskor du 'bar bar gyur par bsam/ sgyi m+mu bla ma lho dpag med mgon po tshe dpag med du
gyur pa'i zugs spu'i sa bon las h+phu zer 'phros/ 'khor 'das kyi bcud dang yon tan thams cad ṇā bdud ci'i rnam par bkug pa/ phyag mtshan gyi bum par zhugs nas gang zhing lud pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rang gi nyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad 'chi med a bdud r+ṣi gang ba dang / gu ga'i sngags 'khor las kyang paṃ bdud me+e rgyun babs pas lus thams cad gang bar gyur par bsam/ yang sngags 'khor de rnams las 'od zer dkar bo zla lho 'bum phrag lta bu 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nang gdon sdig sgrib dang d+ku bar gago sogs zhi bar byas/ go zer ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas phyir 'phros/ lus kyi phyi nas go zer dkar d+ku gur khang 'dom gang khor yug tsam dwagyis bstor bas zhi ba'i las thams cad grub par gyur/ yang khung ga'i yig 'bru rnams las go zer ser yi tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nad thams cad gang / tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab sogs rgyas par byas/go zer phyir 'phros/ go dkar yi gur khang gi nyi rol tu 'od zer ser d+ku gur khang du gyur pas rgyas pa'i las thams cad grub par gyur/ yang khung ga'i yig bru rnams las lode zer dmar spro'i tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ 'od ser yi gur khang sga/ phyi role tu 'od zer dmar yi gur khang du gyur pas dbang gi las thams cad grub par gyur/ yang snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer mthing ga'i tshogs 'phros/lus kyi nang thams cad gang / mngon rma kyi las thams cad 'grub pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ go dmar yi gur khang gi nyi rol tu gower mthing ga'i gur khang gis bsgor bas drag spro'i las thams cad grub par gyur/ yang khung ga'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer ljang gu'i tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub par byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/
lho mthing ga'i gur khangagi nyi rol tu lho zer ljang gu'i gur khang du gyur pas 'phrin las thams cad grub par gyur/ yang snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer mchin kha'i tshogs 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/lho zer phyir 'phros/ 'od jing gu'i gur khang gi phyi rol tu go zer mchin kha'i gur khang du gyur pas dngos grub dang nyin rlabs brtan par gyur/ gur khyim drug bo thams cad kyang dbyibs sgo nga lta bu dum bu gcig tu gyur cing / sra mkhregs bskal ba'i rlung gis kyang gzhig tu med pa/ de dag sga bar mtshams thams cadaldaskyabal 13 spros mtshams med par 'khrigs pa'i bsrung ba chen bor gyur/ lho zer dkar spro'i gur khang gi nang /rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar spro rtsibs brgyad pa spubs can zhwa khobs kha sbyar ba lta bu g.yas bsgor du 'khor ba/ me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pas gdon bgegs thams cad bya sgro mgar gyi sol mal du bab pa ltar gzhob thul thul bsreg par gyur/ slar yang rang gikhung ga'i sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang 'od zer dkar spro 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag /'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos shing / yid gzhan du g.yengab dang / sngags ma dag pa sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ yo tu re tu: re tu re bdag gi tshe dang ba5de nams 'phel bar gyur cig swāhā/ zhes pa dang / spel tshig legs sbyar gyi skad du byed na/ yo tu re tu: re tu re ma ma.ā yu pu r+ya dz+nyā na yo ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa gang rigs sheg bzla/: spel tshig can thog mthar brgya matsam re bzlas rjes yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla rung bar rgyal the dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsungs/ mjug gi rim pa la dbyangs gsal dang / rten 'brel sang bo lan gsum res nyin rlabs brtan par byas rjes/ yig brgya brjod de lhag chad kha bskang zhing / mchod bstod snga ma bzhin du bya/ nongs bshags dang dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis spron lam byas rjes/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa badz+ra muḥs rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig gi cade kyi
