par gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du taX yig dkar bo/ de las go 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ rgyab yol dang go skor can/ thun mong la las bum gyi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hāX las sna tshogs ko ྅ lte ba la hwaX gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi'akhyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon zhal sgagag phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs 3 3 'phyar zhing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can dar dang rin spro che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ lha thams cad kyi nyi borayo/ mgrin para.āḥ zugs spur hāX gis mtshan pa/ thugs spu'i hāX las go zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bum pa'i mar pa byin gyis brlabs la/ mo.ar+ya tu re sa pā ri gar a ༷ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer rma rol mo dang bcas pas mar/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'aphrin las rnams/ /zhes sogs dang / 'jigs pa'i hūX sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus sgyuza ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstode/ /ces bstod/ yo badz+ra lku da ka hāX dang 'bru gsum bzlas la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag pa la 'khril te song ba bum pa'i lha'i zugs sgar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa la trī reyirgya cadang / las bum gyi khar gzungs dor zlas nas/ las kyi lha'i thugs spur nyi ma la hāX yig gi mthar gas kyis bskor ba las lho 'phros gso byed thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bkug nas bum chu la thim par bsams la yo badz+ra mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hāX phaṭa/ cesagangamangabazlazhing/ yigabargyalan bsum bzlas la/
yo tu re tu: re tu re swāhā/ hāX bdun gyis byam pa gnyis su mar yon dbul/ gzhwa tas me rtog dbul/ mo ar+ya trī re sa pā ri bor tsho nas shatsho bar gyis mchod/ las bum gyi kha rgyan gyis bsang chu blangs te g.yas skor gyis bsangs la/ amṛ tsho sngags brjod/ ji srid rjes gnang gi bya ba rnams ma pos kyi bar du bgegs rnam par zlog pa'i 'phrin las mañju cig /ces 'phrin las brtsol/ bum pa'i lha'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces bapo/ de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa la/ bsang chus gnas khang dang mchod rdzas sogs la gtor ste bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhūX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen spro'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su yo las rin bo che'i r+pā yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du yo go du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil me rtog /bdug phros/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa gyur/ yos ༷āḥhūX/ nas/ sham+bha āḥhūXgi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ yo badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha guXpra tsa sga ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da swa bhā chubadz+ra satwarta da ya sato khi ṇi hāX ༷ hāX lho ༄zu ga.ā khaX swāhā/lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ snang pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dkar bo/ de'i steng du.a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su yi ge taX yig dkar yo de las go 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs/ dor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus yang dag mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /mo ar+ya twa re sa pā ri sgruras h+ye 3/ 9dzaḥhwaX baX godam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sngarayangazhesapanas/ma khyed rnamasastasa'adi lamangon par dbasha
bskur du gsol/ zhes pa nas 'od dpag rmed kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ spro na/ dbyangs rol phyag bya dang bcas/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /yon chab rgyun yang mi chad pa/ /bla ma lha yi tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yo ar+ya tu re sa pā ri sgrura.a ༷ pra hwa ñcha hāX swāhā/ de bzhin du/ skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun bzhin du/ /zhabs gsil 5 5 5 yo ar+ya twa re sa pā ri sgrur pabyaX 5 me rtog pak+ṣa tshal bzhin du/ /me rtog 5 5 5 yo 5 tsan+dan sdong yi tshal bzhin du/ /bdud spos 5 5 5 6 pe 5nyi zla nor bu'i lho bzhin du/ /snang gsal 5 5 5 a lo ka tshi ga bur ri yi rgyun bzhin du/ /dri chab 5 5 tshi garnye 5 bu ram shing gi tshal bzhin du/ /zhal zas 5 5 tshini 44 5 yi wang gling bu'i rgyun bzhin du/ /sil snyan 5 5 5 sham+bha pra tī ñcha hāX grwahwa/zhes mchod pa dbul/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tu re ma/ /k+ṣiṃre yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad ma dkar yi dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba yi ni gdan steng du/ /ko ྅ skyil kung bcas mdzad na/ /mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston spu'i zla ba'i mdangs dang ldan/ /zla ba yi ni rgyab yol can/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bkra/ /mukhral bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /'dod sbyin sku de 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phags ma zhol mar phyag 'tshal lo/'khor lo dkar yo 'od zer 'bar/ /rmas brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bsgor ba'i rnam pa can/ /'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad —yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma/ /lha mo ṇā la gsol ba 'dis/ /bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /nus ldan khyod kyis skyob tu gsol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /'phagasamarmaladad byasapas/ /deXrtagatu6bzhin dgongs/ /bdag
kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ ‘/thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol/ /lha mo sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog /sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can/ /gzugs ldan rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mdzes pa'i dar gyis smad g.yogs can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i dbus gnas su/ /zhabs gnyis do 3'i skyil kung mdzad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can/dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo ge la rtag tu 'dud/ /rma la cha tsam bstod pa yis/ /bdag cag byang chub sgrub pa la/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi gyur te/ /mthun rkyen pun sum tshogs par shog /ces bstod/bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs lngar pad zla'i gdan la/ 'khor lo dkar spro rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar zla ba la taX yig dkar bo mtha' bskor duyo che ge mo shes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsgo nams ye shes rgyas par marga cig hwa/ zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor dang / rtsibs brgyad la twa re tu9 re tu re swā/ zhes yi ge brgyad kyis bsgor ba gsal gdab/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las lho zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la martsode/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe thekha ba la sogs pa'idone byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje byin gas rnams tshur bsdus/ ṣ+ka zer rnams sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsam/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa de nyid la gnas bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ yo tu re tu: re tu re swāhā/zhes pa yi ge bcu pa ste 〉nga po dang / yo twa re tut+tha re tu re ma ma.ā yuḥpu h+ye dz+nyā na yo ku ru swāhā/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas pa'i las sngags ci 'grub bzla/ ma ma zhes pa'i tshab du slob ma'i ming bcug na rung ngam snyam mo/ /oṃ ma mang pogo tshe slob ma rnams kyi mingayig lho pa'i mos pa byas kyang chog /mthar yig brgya brjod/ de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yo las rin bo che'i rma yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen bo gyur/ yo āḥhāX/ lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlabs/
mdun bskyed kyi lha'i ljags 'od zer gyi sgu gus drangs te gsol bas zag med kyi bdud rtsis zugs mnyes par gyur par bsams la/ o.ar+ya twa re sa pā ri wā ra ba liṃ pra hwa ñcha ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mar/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'aphrin las kun/ /zhes sogs tho ka gcig gis bar+sā la 'dod stso la gsol ba gdab/ rgyas par byed na slob ma la rjes gnang ji ltar rang gis kyang blangs la/ rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor d+ku lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes rjes gnang gi don du gsol bgadab/ de nas k+ṣ+ṇā ma rnams tshogs pa na khrus byas be+e thog mar sto rwa'i mar pa can gyis brlabs la khro ro'i tshogs spyan drangs/ de la mchod pa phul la bstod pas bstod/ de nas bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs la bgegs rnams bkug pa la/ na maḥsarba zhes sogs zhi ba'i sgo nas sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin/ sum+bha ni/ sum+bha ni zhes sogs zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag yi sgonasagator ma snyir bskor la/ tsham rngam dang bcas gtor ma btang / gu gul gyis bdug yungs spur gyis brab cing / bsang chu gtor la bsrung 'khor bsgom mo/ /de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ khyed rang rnams nyin gas kyi gter chen wa re bag ba6 ldan 'das sgrol ma dkar mo spyan bdun yid bzhin 'khor lo ༄ nyin ma'i go zer drug sbrags kyi rjes gnang bka' babs dgu dang ldan pa zhu ba la thugs bsam 'di bzhin du marga/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal pa'i rnam pa can min par rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor r+ya ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dngos yin snyam pa dang / bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun gyi lta'adra'am tshom bu yang rje bca ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su mos la/ rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig mdzad par zhu/ zhes brda sprad/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul zin pan/ 'o lags/ rang cag rnams kyis dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po lan cig rnyed pa 'di chud ma zos par khung spro ci lon re mdzadadagos/ khungapolenapa thabasamachog
tu gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i khung bo yongs su rdzogs pa tshang la ma nor ba zhig la thos bsam sgom gsum byas te rang gzhan gnyis lnga'i don mthar phyin pa zhig byed pa yin la/ de lta bu zhig byed pa la lhag pa'i lha khyad par can zhig la bsten dgos pas rje btsun sgrol ma 'di ni nyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba'i yin zhing / lhag par 'brom chos kyi rgyal bo la rje btsun grol ma nyid kyis/ khyod kyi rjes 'brang kho mos skyong / zhes bka' gdams kyi rnam thar gtsang ma 'dzin pa rnams bu ltar skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes shing / dpal ldan rdza 3 sha dang chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen bo yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyis rje btsun sgrol ma lhag pa'i lhar bzung nas rang gi lung rtogs kyi mātan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'tsho don rgya chen bo mdzad pa sha stag yin la/ rje btsun sgrol ma la'ang sku'i bakho pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yode pa las da lam tshe sbyin lha mo sku mdog dkar mo/ mtshan 'os pa tsam gyis dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba 'joms par mdzad cing / gsol ba btab nas gzungs sngags tshul bzhin du bzlas na 'chi med a rig 'dzin nges par stsal bar mdzad pa'i rje bca ma yid bzhin 'khor yo'adi ni/ r+gha ri bo ta lar mkho spro spyan ras gzigs la/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen spros sems can gyi t+yā mdzad pa'i grogs bdag gis bgyi'o/sems can gang dag bdag gi ming 'dzin pa de'i tshe bsring bar bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bdag yid la byed pa'i sems can de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub la nges par dgod par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsol swe mgon spro spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phrin las kyi grogs ldan mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes/ ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar khro bo ྅ dpal ldana.a nyi sha dang / 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nas bzung bka' gdams kyi bshes gnyen thams cad la lha mo 'dis sku tshe ring ba dang / 4zhaphrin las rgyas pa'i grogs mdzad cing / lha mo 'di la gsol ba btab na tshe ring bar ma zad
shes rab kyang ches cher 'phel bar 'gyur ba dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar las 'byung ba ltar yin pas de lta bu'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can 'di la deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen zhu snyam pa mdzad la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sku gsum ye shes dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rje btsun ma'i/rjes gnang dam pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ thun mong ma yin pa la/ gang drin ma dang 'khor ba las sgrol ma lan gsum gsum/ de nas thun mong la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba nyi dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal/ las gyu 'bras thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i phan yon sogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas brjod/ khyad par khyed rnams kyi spro ba 'phel ba'i ched du chos 'di ji ltar byon tshul gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam zhu ba la/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen bo ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa la rje btsun mas gnang ba stsal te/ 'chi ba sgu ba'i rtog pa las 'di'i man ngag zur du phyung zhing / rje btsun ma dngos las kyang gdams ngag rnams legs par gsan/ de las bla ma gser gling spru dang / jo lo 3 dang / 'brom rin spro che rnams la rim par brgyud pa dge bshes spyan snga pas gsan/ khong la 'chi ltas kyi mnal lam byung ba na/ /grogs shig la bzlas pa bcol bas sa ñcha dkar bor ram me 'dug pa cas/ spyan snga'i zhal nas/da 'phro bcad pas chog gsung / de nas sku tshe mthar phyin/ 'di'i bsnyen pa 'bum tsho zhig bskyal na bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs/ 'di 'phrin las kyi lha mo yin pas 'grub sla ba yin gsung / spyan snga pa la/ bla ma sle nag pas gsan be+e khong spyan lnga'i drung na chos gsan skabs/ mnal lam du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub phyogs su nub pa cas/ bla ma la zhus pas rlung log pa'i 'chi ltas shin tu ngan pa yin/ 'on kyang 'chi ba slu ba'i thabs bzang bo yod kyi gsung / gdams ngag 'di gnang / khong gis sgrub pa lo drug mdzad
pas rje btsun ma'i zhal gzigs/ chos mang du gsung ba yi ger bdode pa rin chen sems kyi gter zhes bya ba yod skad/ yang paṇ+ḍi ta ngag dbang grags pa la/ bla ma do 3 gdan pas gsan te sgrub thabs mang du mdzad/ de la ba ri lo ñcha bas gsan cing sgrub thabs rnams bod du bsgyur/ de la yang bla ma sle nag pas zhus so/ /smi nag pa la dge bshes sgre bas gsan te/ khong dang 1— 7sa bsam mdzad dus/ la r+sā pa'i stag ris yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig la lag ris bstan pas/ 1khu nga btsun pa skyode la chos kyi las 'phro gsha' ma zhig 'dug ste/ tshe lo gsum las mi thub par 'dug zer ba dang / sngar khong la 'chi ltas kyi smi lam ngan pa yang yang byung ba gnyis 'doms pas/ thugs dbyung ste tshe lhag sgrub pa la bskyel bsam nas gsan pa 'phro bcad/ dbus su byon pa'i lam khar gzhu mkhar gong du bla ma k+shi nag pa dang mjal/ lo rgyus zhus pas/ byang chub sgrub pa la lam gyi bar chad sel ba'i thabs khyad par can nga la yode kyi/ 33 pa khrod thugs bde bol gyis sprong zhig gsung nas 'di'i sgrub thabs gdams ngag rnams gnang / der sgrub pa mdzad pas/ zla ba bcu gcig na rje btsun ma'i zhal gzigs/ khyod kyis lo drug cu thub/ sems can la phan thogs pa 'ong gsung / phyis dgung lo drug cu'i dus gsol ba btab pas/ nga'i sku zhig bzhengs na lo bcu gcig 3de par 'dug gi gsung bas ras bris shig bzhengs/ dgung lo bdun cu'i dus yang gsol ba btab pas/ yang nga'i sku zhig bzhengs dang lo bcu thub gsung bas lugs ma cig bzhengs/ ras bris de da lta rwa sgreng na bzhugs skad/ dgung lo brgyad cur slebs skabs yang gsol ba btab pas/da dung nga'i sku cig bzhengs na lo mang du thub gsung pas/ gyang logs la ri mo zhig bzhengs/ de nas lo bco lnga'i bar bzhugs/ yongs dril dgung lo dgu bcu rtsalnga bzhugs skad/ khong gi zhal nas/ 'di bzlos shes na mgo sug bral yang 'gal ba med/ ro khyang brus kyang 'gal ba med/ shadum bur thor kyin song yang 'gal ba med gsung / chos
rje sgam bo pas kyang sgrub pa mdzad skabs sku tshe lo gsum las med par mkha' 'gros lung bstan pas/ dge bshes sgre ba la gdams ngag 'di gsan nas sgrub pas lo brgyad cur bsrings/ de lta bu'i sngon byung gi lo rgyus shin tu mang zhing / rang re'i bla ma khams gsum chos kyi rgyarmo 'o da②nga kha pa chen bos kyang / rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi zhal gzigs te sku r+b+ya bar chad bzlog pa'i tshul mdzad/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub la/ 1zu gang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ khyod bstan pa la bsam nas 'chad nyan yun ring byed pa la/ thugs rje shin tu myur zhing / chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab dang / r+b+ya dngos grub gtso bor sgyul ba'i yi dam 'di la bsten pa gal che gsung nas/ 'di'i gdams ngag rnams gnang / sgrub pa mdzad pas sku tshe mthar phyin/ paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ bar chad bzlog pa la 'di rang gang las kyang stobs che ba zhig 'ong ba 'dug gsung / bstod pa tshe dang ye shes spel bar byed pa'i rin bo che zhes bya ba mdzad/ 'di byin rlabs shin tu che zhes bla ma rnoms gsung / mkhas rtsi shor bzang rgya mtshes kyang dngos su zhal gzigs/ bsto pa lo ༄nga ka gang mang zhig rtsom zhig de'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i a dngos rtsi ster gsung ba bzhin mdzad pas dgung lo brgyar nye ba bzhugs/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'di'i sgrub pa tshad ldan mdzad pa la sku tshe mthar ma phyin pa med gsung / 'di nyid byin rlabs myur bas 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub phal mo ༄'i thugs dam gyi ga༄71ra mdzad cing / bka' babs kyi brgyud pa yang dgu tsam dang nye brgyud kyang 'ga' zhig byung / de lta bu'i grub pa'i skyes mchog dam pa bar ma gad pa la rim par brgyud cing / de thams cad kyis 'di'i sgo nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi gter chen bor gyur pa yin/ des na gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/ thog mar rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa smin byed dbang gi go thub rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa gal che ste/ legasagrubalas/ gzhanagyisarjes mganangabar/ /gsang sngags
gzung bar mi bya ste/ zhes gtsangs pa bzhin/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs gsum gyi rjes su sbyor bar byed pa la/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas de ltar du gnang ba stsal ba ni chos de nyid nyams su len pa la dbang bar 'gyur bas/ dbang gi go ston dang yang phyogs mtshungs pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang ba spyi rgyud las/sngags kyi nus pa skyed pa'i dbang / 'byor pa skyed pa'i dbang / bgegs zhi bar byed pa'i dbang / k+ṣ+ṇā rung du byed pa'i dbang ste bzhi gsungs pas/ snga ma gsum yang rjes gnang dang rig gtad sogs la gtso bor byed pa yin/ de lta bu'i chos 'di ni gsang sngags zab mo'i gdams pa phul du phyin pa yin kyang / de theg chen gyi chos zab mor 'gro ba nyams su len pa khra'i gang zag la rag las/ de bsam pa byang chub kyi sems la rag las/ de'i rgyu tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la rag las pas/ mdun gyi sku 'dra'am tshom bu 'di kho ngas bsgrubs zin pa ltar rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su mos la/de'i steng gi nam mkha' la rtsabargyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rangadapa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sung ma dang bcas pa nam mkha'i yongs su gang ba bzhugs par gsal btab nas/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyamtsho chen bo 'di las bdag gis nges par bsgral bar bya/ de'i phyir du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems kyi 36 pa blangs la tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam du mos pa brtan bo dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mgo/ ces brda sprad la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig rngu thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug cing byang sdom phog /de nas maṇ+ḍal bstan pa ni/ mdun na gnas pa'i sku 'dra'am tshom bu 'di nyid pad+ma dkar bo dang zla ba'i steng du rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ces pa nas/ go stor can/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin gsal btab/ bla ma nga nyid kyang rje
btsun ma dngos yin snyam du mos la sku'i rjes gnang gi r+pā du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sku gsum ye shes dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rje btsun ma'i/ /sku yi rjes gnang tsho du gsol/zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas/ slob dayon gyi thugs ka nas lo1 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs spur phog /de'i thugs ka nas kyang lho 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog ༷pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sbyangs/ rnam smin khros bcas sha khrag gi lus stong par sbyangs/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dkar bo/ de'i dbus su rdza las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du slob ma'i rnam par shes pa'i ro rtso taX yig dkar bo/ yongs su gyur pa las slob ma rnams rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston spu'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing kor bu chu shel ltar dri ma med pa dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i nyams can shin tu mdzes pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon mukhral dkar glu'i yu ba nas mtheb srin gyis thugs spur bzung ba yal ga gsum du gyes pa snyan gyi thad spur me tog 'bras bu gang bu gsum gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshon pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing lan bu ring ru 'phyang ba/ nu bur rgyas shing rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi r+sā g.yogs dang / dar dmar spro'i sham thabs can zhabs 1— rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams la spyan re re ste ye shes kyi spyan bdun ma/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od skor can/ zhes ltar bskyed nas sgom du bcug /thun mong ma yin pa la/ slob ma rnams rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs skar 'khor lo dkar spro rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba dang mu khyud rim pa gsum ldan/ lte bar taX yig sngags thel tshig dang bcas pas bskor ba/ rtsibs brgyud la twarelasogasapa'iyegebargya// mukhyud rnams la ā li/ kā li/
rten khung gis bskor ba lho zer dang bcas pa bskyed/ de'i sī bor o dkar bo/ mgrin para.āḥdamar bo/ thugs spur hwaX sngon bos mtshan pa gsal gdab/ thun mong la/ bla ma'i zugs ta'i taX yig gi go zekhu cas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje bag ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bsgor ba spyan drangs/mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gyi phung bo 'khrigs pa bzhin du rma/ khyad rang rnams kyi lus la char chen spro bab pa bzhin du sib sib thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang rje btsun ma'i sku dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mgu ces brjod la dril bu dkrol/ me tog gtor/des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag /sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ phyed rang gi lus lhar sgom pa'i skal ba can du byas/ 'chi med ṇā dngos grub dam pa thob snyam pa'i mos pa mtha/ ces brda sprad/ de nas/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes khros marode byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sku gsum ye shes dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rje btsun ma'i/ /gsung gi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum gsol ba gangab/ de nas/ slob ma rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs spu'i ta yig dkar yo cad du zhu ba las 'khor lo dkar spro rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa mu khyud rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du taX yig gi mthar yo dang hwa'i bar du spel tshig sbyar bas bsgor ba/ rtsibs brgyad la rim pa ltar tu re tu: re tu re 〉zhes pa'i yi ne+e brgyad/ mu khyud nang ma la.ā li galho bsgor/ gnyis pa la kā 'i g.yas bskor/ gsum pa la rten 'brel snying bo g.yas bskor bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs lngar yang sngags 'khor de 'dra ba re yod pa'i mos pa mañju/ de dag las 'od zer dkar bo 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyi khung ga'i sngags 'khor la phog pas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nad
gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par a bar chad zhi bar byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ r+yā ma rnams kyi lus kyi nyi nas 'od zer dkar yi gur khyim 'dom gang khor yug tsam zhig gis dkar 'khyil gyis bskor bas zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ de bzhin du 'od zer ser spro 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyi khung ga'i sngags 'khor la phog pas go zer ser spro dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / tshe dang balho nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan jos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab sogs rgyas par byas/ lho zer phyir 'phros/ go dkar yi gur khang gi phyi rol tu lho zer ser yi gur khyim gyis bsgor bas rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ yang 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyi snying ga'i sngags 'khor la lho pas ༄ zer dmar spro dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thar/sa cad gang / khams gsum dbang du sdud nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ 'od ser yi gur khang gi phyi rol tu lho zer dmar yi gur khyim gyis bltar bas dbang gi las thams cad 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ yang 'od zer mthing ga 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyi snying ga'i sngags 'khor la phog pas h+phu zer mthing ga dpag tu med pa 'phros/lus kyi nang thams cad gang / mngon spyod kyi las thams cad 'grub pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ go zer phyir 'phros/ go dmar yi gur khang gi phyi rol tu go zer mthing ga'i gur khyim gyis bsgor bas drag glu'i las thams cad 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/yang lho zer ljang gu 'phros/ h+phu ma rnams kyi snying ga'i sngags 'khor la phog pas go zer ljang gu dpag turbad pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ go zer phyir 'phros/go mthing ga'i gur khang gi nyi rol tu lho zer ljang gu'i gur khyim gyis bskor bas 'phrin las thams cad 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ yang go zer mchin kha 'phros/ slob
ma rnams kyi snying ga'i sngags 'khor la lpag pas go zer mchin kha dpag tu med pa 'phros/lus kyi nang thams cad gang / dngos grub thams cad brtan par byas/ lho zer phyir 'phros/ go ljang gu'i gur khang sga phyi rol tu lho zer mchin kha'i gur khyim gyis bsgor bas dngos grub dang byin rlabs thams cad brtan par byas byung snyam pa'i mos pa mtshod la sngags 'di rnams rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ yo ye dharmā he tu pra bha 5he tuX ṣān+ta thā ga rto h+ya bodata/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro rnyi e boX bā dī mahwa shra ma ṇaḥye swāhā/ ka kha galha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha na/ ṭa t+ta ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da rnyi na/ pa pha ba lha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha khi sa ha k+ṣa/rdza ā/ i ī/ lku mū/ ri nī/ li wī/ e i/ yo au/ skraX aḥ yo twa re tushī re tu re ma ma rdza yuḥ pu h+ye dz+nyā na pu lta ku ru swā hwa/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum ma ma lnga re rjes zlos byed du gzhug /khyed rang rnams 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i thugs lnga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rje btsun ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs rnams dbyangs gsal gyi yī ge'i rnam par spyan drangs/ me tog la thim pa'i me tog khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags phreng nus pa dang ldan par byas song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ slob dpon gyis me rtog 'bor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ des rje btsun ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag /khyed rang gi ngag dang rje btsun ma'i gsung dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad/de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes khros mdzod byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sku gsum ye shes dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rje btsun ma'i/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsolabagadab/ denas/ blam/thugasaka'is bon las rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi byin
rlabs thams cad phyag mtshan me rtogaphashāt+pal dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa'i rnam par spros/ slob ma rnams kyi snying gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang sgob/yid kyi sgonas bsags pa'i jig sgrib thams cad dag thugs kyi nyin rlabs yid la zhugs/khyed rang gi yid dang rje btsun ma'i thugs dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ces brda sprad/ de nas dbang lha bstim pa'i rjes gnang ni/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ sku 'dra'am tshom bu rje bag mar bskyed pa slob ma'i nyi bor bzhag /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /dus 'di nas ni thams cad du/ /lhag pa'i lha ni mdzad du gsol/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas rje btsun ma slob ma rnams kyi lus la thim pas rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs dang slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ slob ma mang po yod na rang 'dra re thim pas zhes sbyar na legs/ des rje btsun ma'i thun mong ba'i rjes gnang grub/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang sga sngon 'gro gsol 'debs/ sogs song zin pas/ dngos gzhi la spyan dmigs 'di bzhin mgu byas la/ slob dbon dang mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs spu'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad dang / khyad par rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi nyin rlabs thams cad 'khor lo dkar spro cibs brgyad tshe ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog cing 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i rnam pas nam mkha' gang bar byon pa dang / mdun bskyed dang slob dpon mas kyang de 'dra ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa chad/ slob ma rnams kyi ba spru'i bu ga thams cad nas thogs med du zhugs/ thugs spu'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ de las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpagatumedapa skya:li'ibabs/ pasathamasasdad 'chi med ye shes
kyi bdud rtsis khongs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sangs kyis dagtshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar a be+e sha ya rdza a dzaḥhāX baX gozhes ci mang bca cing kor dril gsor dkrol bya/ yang rang gi lhong ga nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /yo twa re tu: re tu re swāhā/ sarba ta thā ga ta rdza bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya smra ye hāX/ zhes brjod cing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dzaḥgāX baX spo dbang lha slob ma rnams la thim par mos la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gsar gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon spro dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang spro'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum du grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu kun la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi dam pa ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ zhes sho so ka gsum gyis shis pa brjod/ puskye sogs mchod pa lngas mar pa ni lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /yang slob dbon gyi zugs spu'i 'khor lo dang sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng chad zhal nas jon/ slob ma rnams kyi zhal nas pazhugs/ thugs ma'i yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsams la/ yi ge bcu pa spel tshig can brgya rtsabargyad kyi rjes zlos bya/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang / bcom ldan 'di la sogs
bya ba ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar du rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo lhag pa'i lhar bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes rjos mdzod byas la/ slob dbon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma bob kyi bar du/ rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gso la/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal ba dang / /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rje bag ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skyagasung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad ko ྅ slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jugacing brtan par gyur cig /dzaḥhāX baX 4 zhes bca cing me rtog gtor/ de dag gis rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang lhan du sbrags te bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin legs par 4ba pa yin pas dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mgu cig /gtsobos ji ltar bka' m+mu pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ gtang rag sga maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i rjes su bdag nyid bran du 'bul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis/ /khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gcig /de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa bshams la mar bsto byas te yig brgya mang du bzla zhing /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis dang bcas bya/ de nas/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal la/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu sprul/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur par bsams la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'di bris dge bas bdag gzhan yid canarnams/ /bdud sde'igayul/sarnamanal66 bhiḥ byang grol

brtser dgongs bzhugs par gyur/ /ces brjod/ dngos gzhi sde tshan dang bo dkon mchog hū la dmigs nas maca pa'i nyin gyi gzungs lan gsum mthar/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ bdag cag dbon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs tshogs rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes me rtog 'bor ba dang bcas 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ sne tshan gnyis pa ni/ krol ma nyid la dmigs nas/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / /zhes pa nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag rgyur cig /ces yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal dbul te/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab pa'i don rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam zhing / nyer bstod tshar gnyis dang / rje btsun btsom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /zhes pa nas/ yar lnga'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /ces me tog 'phor zhing gsol ba btab/ sde tshan gsum pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dbul/ nyer bstod tshar gsum/ 'dod gsol rnams sngar ltar bya/ sde tshan bzhi pa ni/ /gong dang 'dra zhing nyer bstod tshar bdun brjod/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas/ gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa yin pas shin tu byin rlabs che zhes sgrol ma nyid nas sa/sungs 'dug /grangs gsog tshe/ mchod pa kha gsos byed nas sde tshan dang bo nas 'di'i bar bya la/ mjug tu nyer bstod tshar bdun gyi mthar/ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pas/ /zhes sogs phan yon dang / legs bris ma sogs bton nas/ /thugs lnga'i tuX yigaljang khya'i mtha' bskor du/ /zhes pa nas/ rje btsun khyod kyi drung du skye bar mdzod/ /rje btsun btsom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /zhes pa nas/ chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan rje btsun sgrol ma'i lha tshogs la/ /phyag mchod bgyis sogs dge maci mchis pa/ /pha ma rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /sgrol

zhes sogs kyi dri lan ni/ sems dpa' gsum zhes pa'i don lha ye shes sems dpa' 'gro tshe nga gi gnas byed pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' dang / bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i rlung lho zer lnga pa lha skur shar ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de la dmigs nas bsgom pas rtsaba'i rlung lnga / yan lag gi rlung lnga dang bcas pa'i rlung thams cad snying ga'i mi bshig pa'i thig ler 'du zhing ting nge 'dzin khyad paran can skyed cing gzhan don kho nar sems pas na ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ de dag la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos mthun byed tshul yode kyang de tsam zhu/ de ltar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs can skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i 1zlo ga bla ma'i nyi bo/ mgrin pa/ thugs ka 'am snying kha/ lte ba/gsang gnas rnams su ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yo āḥrwa swāhās mtshan pa kha dog dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu rnams so ṇā rang mdangs sku bdud rtsidang 'od zer 'phro ba las rtsa'akhor rnams bskyed par ma gsung / snang stong zhes sogs kyi don/ chos thams cad ming gis btags tsam ma gtogs rang ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa'i yul stong pa nyid dang / yul can bla ma'i thugs bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyis ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i nges don gyi bla ma la sems rtsegathig tu mos gus kyis legs par bzung nas ye shes de nyid drang don gyi bla ma zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i skur shar ba'i thugs spu'i twaX yig la ṭ+wāṃ gis mtshan pa hāX yig/6 tuX gyis mtshan pa twaX yig gi mdun du hāX yig bdod pa twaX gyis khog par hāX ḍig shel 'asbring dang 'phreng thag bzhin gsal tshul bcas gsungs pas gang bder bya/ da lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nga rgyal gsal snang ci bon byas te rdzogs rim zab ṇā smin byed du 'gyur nges bya'o/ /slar yang tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyang phyir bla ma'i thugs kur twaX gyis mtshan pa las cade zer 'phros rang bzhin chos sku'i ngang nas gzugs skutsirnam par skyabs gnas ma lus pa spyan drangs gnyis med du thim pa/ bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su gsol ba 'debs
tshul yin (ga)'i rtags can gyi m+bhi gtsug nor bur byang chub bar du bzhugs zhes pa ni/bde ba chen yo dgu ba'i gnas nyi m+mu rtsa'akhor gyi dbyibs gru gsum/ 'bras dus kyi bde stong dbyer med mtshon/ gru gsum gyi de la stong pa'i dbye ba rnam thar sgo gsum dang /sku gsum/ nyi dkar bsar mtshon pa'i stong nyid/ nang dmar ba'i lha ga'i dbyibs su yod pas boX gyis mtshon pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes/ rten brten pa thams cad der tshud pa bsgom dgos pa'i gnad kyis/ m+bhi yi ca'akhor gyi lte bar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma kun 'dus kor bu'i lugs su bzhugs pa la/ yan lag bdun gyi thog mar brtan par bzhugs pa gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang gnad don che zhing snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa kho na yin par ma zad/ sngon byung gi gling gzhi ltar m+bhi gtsugalha ga'i dbyibs can gyi bde chen 'khor ṇā dbus kyi bla ma do rje 'chang gi bka' drin gyis mthar thug pa'i bde ba chen d+ku gnas skad i gis gas dus kyi tshe thung gcig la thob par tshor par mdzad pa'i bla ma yid bzhin gyi sgor bu dbang gi rgyal spro m+bhi bo bde chen 'khor d+ku mdzes rgyan lta bur byang chub ma r+ya bar du brtan par bzhugs par mdzad du gsol zhes gdung shugs drag bos thog mar brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i gnad ni/ lam 'bras kyi yon tan thams cad bde stong gi ye shes su 'dus/ de ltar bsgom pa'i rlung thams cad ca'akhor der 'dus pa'o ye shes de nyid myur du 'grub par ston pa'o/ /dper na rgyal yi gtsug rgyan bzhin no/ /(nga)'i rtags can gyi 'od zer 'phros pa'i sga ༄ken dang 'byung ba thim rtags sogs kyi lan/ nyer bsdu'i skabs/ rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs spu'i tuX/ hwaX gis madzhan pa las bde ba chen yi rang bzhin gyi go zer dmar spro 'phros/ gang la snag pa thams cad bde ba'i 5༄ bar chams kyis 'gro nus pa zhig dgos/go zer 'phros zhes pa man ngag gang ba'i tshul du gsung / de 'dra'i go zer 'phros pas ñcā bag thams cad bde ba'i rnam rol dang / ñcā shams cad gzhal sdas khang / bag
thams cad rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa'i gsal snang legs par bsgoge ra go du zhu nas sems can rnams lhar gsal ba waṃ thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i skabs su/ 'dzam gling gi mi mngal skyes sa chu me rlung rtsathig le'i khams drug ldan zhig rim gyis 'chi rim bzhin sa chu la thim pa dang phyi rtags su lus sa la byings pa'i nyams dang / 'khos lo lnga'i lha rnams gtsomo la thim pa'i dus sa'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung chu'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung laXthim pa'i nang rtags me+e rgyu lta bu'i snang ba shar ba'i mos pa byed/ rang lus kyi stod smad rgyab mdun rnams go du mer gyis zhu nas snying kha'i gtso mo la thim skabs su chu med la thim pa'i bh+ri rtags mchu dang lce sogs skams pa dang / so la dreg pa chags pa dang / gtsomo yang 'od du zhu nas sngags 'phreng la thim/de twaX yig la thim/ tuX yig khog nang gi hāX la thim skabs chu'i bzhon pa'i rlung me'i bkon pa'i rlung la thim rtags/ nang du du ba lta bu'i snang ba shar ba'i mos pa byed/ de ni dper na khang pa'i nang du bas khongs rjes du ba rags pa sangs rjes su du ba phra mos 1 7stom gyiso gang ba lta bu'i snang ba shar ba lta bu'o/ hūm̐ sga zhabs kyu༄ ni ha la thim skabs me rlung la thim pa'i nyi rtags lus kyi go mtha' nas sdud me'i bzhon pa'i rlung kun rtog g.yo byed kyi rlung la thim pa'i nang rtags mkha' snang me khyer lta bu'i snang ba shar ba'i mos pa byed/de ni casam phra ba du ma mer bsreg nas/ ro ma nam mkhar gtor tshe dmar khrim khrim tang ba'i snang ba 'char ba lta bu la byed/ de ni rlung dbu mar thim rtags rags pa yin/ha mgo rwa ra thim skabs/ kun rtog g.yo )da kyi rlung snang ba la thim par rtsom pa phyi rtags phyi dbugs chad cing / rlung dbu mar thim pa'i nang rtags phra ba ni/ mar me 'bar ba lta bu'i snang ba shar ba'i mos pa byed/ de ni dper na khang pa'i nang gar me rlung gis mi bgo par gsal bar 'bar ba lta bu la byed/ mkha ༄1 zla tshes la thim skabs rlung snang cad la thim nas snang ba rang dus ston gnam g.ya' dag pa la zla go nyis khyab pa lta bu'i
snang ba dkar lam pa shar ba'i mos pa byed/ zla tshes thig le la thim skabs snang ba mched pa la thim pas mched pa rang dus ston gnam g.ya' dag la nyi 'od kyis khyab pa lta bu'i snang ba dkar lam pa shar ba'i mos pa byed/ thig phe nā da la thim pa'i mched pa nyer thob la thim nas nyer thob rang dus na ston gnam g.ya' dag la srod kyi smag 'thug spros khyab pa lta bu nag lam pa shar ba'i mos pa byed/ nyer thob 'di la dran bcas dran med gnyis ri'adi dran bcas dang / 'di'i mjug tu rnal 'byor pa la dran med zhig 'byung yang skyon can dran med min 'di skabs dran pa nyams phul ji tsam che ba bzhin 'od gsal dwangs shing 'thug pa zhig 'byung ba kun mkhyen tsong kha pa chen bos gsungs so/ /nā da yang je 4 phra je phrar mi dmigs par gyur skabs nyer thob 'od gsal la thim dus 'od gsal rang dus su slong byed kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba'i ston dus kyi g.ya' dag pa'i tho rangs kyi nam mkha'i rang mdog lta bu'i snang ba 'char/ de'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa yin/ de 'dra 'od gsal thams cad stong pa de ma'i 'od gsal dang / sngon du yang yang bsgom pa'i bden grub bkag tsam gyi h+phu gsal stong pa nyid de bu'i go gsal yin pas/ de gnyis 'dres nas ngo 'a'od pa na 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa zhes bya la/ lugs 'dis nyer thob 'od gsal du thim nas 'od gsal rang dus na ston gnam g.ya' dag la dkar lam dmar lam nag lam ste phyi yi slong byed kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba'i ston dus kyi tho rangs kyi nam mkha'i rang mdog ji lta ba bzhin snang ba 'char/ de'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal mngon du byas pa yin la de 'di'i sbyang gzhi yin la/ dpe dang don gyi go gsal mthar thug pa gnyis kyi skabs su lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs khyad par can la brten nas gzhi'i 'ong lugs ji lta ba bzhin dus chu la thim pa nas bzung ste/ 'od gsal la thim pa'i bar rtags dang bcas pa rdzogs rjes thams cad stong pa 'od gsal lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen bo 'char ba ni/— de sbyong byed kyi lam yin zhang / de nas kun
rtogs g.yo ba'i rlung gi dbang gis cad gsal las g.yos nas lugs ldog gi thob mched snang gsum sogs rim pa ltar 'byung ba yin/ 'bras bu mi slob pa'i 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad pa'i tshe yang / gzhi dang lam gyi lho gsal skye ba'i rim pa dang 'dra bar sa chu la thim pa nas nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pa'i bar sngon du song nas ye shes chos kyi sku 'od gsal mngon du byed cing / de nas kun rtog g.yo ba'i las rlung thams cad zad pas 'od gsal las nam du yang ldang ba med pa yin la/ de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi de'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi 'od gsal 'chi ba dang mthun pa'i sdud rim byas nas shar ba 'di yin pas rgyud la bskyed par bya'o snyam nas bsgom pa de la 'chi ba chos sku5/'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor zhes bshad pa ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i stong nyid sgom tshul dang mi gcig par sdud rim gyi sgo nas stong nyid bsgom ste 'od gsal chos sku la nga rgyal 'jog pa ni/sngags bla med kyi thabs mkhas kyi man ngag gi mthus sgrub pa bo rang nyid snyigs dus kyi tshe zung gcig la chos sku sgrub pa'i thabs 7mkhas khyad par can yin pas/ gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i bla med do— rje theg pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lam 'di la yid ches brtan spro bskyed la sgom pa la 'bad par mdzad phyir yi ge la ngal ba ma byas par bris so/ /slar yang chos sku las lha'i skur 5ldang nas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la bar+ṇa par mdzad du gsol/ (ca)'i rtags can gyi gsal snang dang nga rgyal gyi lan ni/ phyag 'tshal yul sgrol ma re las rang 'dra re rang la thim nas byin gyi brlabs pa dang / nyer gcig bo re re las zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams sgrub tshul du ma yod pas de dang de'i rtogs pa myur du skye bar mos nas/ mthar sprol ma nyer gcig go du zhu nas gtsomor thim/ gtsomo yang rang la thim pas gtso mo'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang sgrub dgos par cho ga'i tshig zin ltar 'bad na 'thus/ dbang shes la tha mal du snang ba 'gog pa ni shes sgrib ma dag bar du mi nus par gsungs/ /(cha)'i rtags can rtsadabu ma ro ma dang rkyang ma gnad
du bsnun tshul gyi lan la/ rtsadabu ma nyi sngo la nang dmar ba/ drang zhing 'khrongs pa chu shing gi sdong spro lta bu/ nang dmar zhing snum pa rgya skyegs kyi khya ba lta bu/ gsal la dwangs pa til mar gyi mar me lta bu/ 'jam la mnyen pa pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu'i khyad chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma gagu nar khrag 'babs pas dmar bo/ g.yon du rkyang ma byang sems dkar bo 'babs pas dkar bor gsungs/ khams rlung 'babs pas thugs kyi rtsa/ khams dmar bo 'babs pas gsung gi rtsa/ khams dkar bo 'babs pas sku'i rtsar gsungs/ ro ma dkar spro rkyang ma dmar bor go sdos nas gsungs pa ni zhal las shes/ dbu ma'i yar sne krad rgyas steng dung khang gi 'og nas gug ste smin mtshams su go/ mar sne pho mo gang yin gyi rtags rtser zug pa/ cha shas re rkang mthil gnyis su yod par gsung / ro rkyang yar sne sna bug la zug pa/ lte 'og nas rkyang ma g.yas su 'khyog nas pho mo gang gin gyi rtags rtser song nas dri chu 'phen 'dzin byed/ ro ma g.yon du 'phyog nas bshang ba 'phen 'dzin byed/ bdag bskyed dang lus dkyil du rtsagasum 'khor lo drug ldan du gsungs don lus gnad yongs rdzogs bskyed phyir dang / lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba bcu drug 'dren phyir sogs khyad chos dang / gsang 'dus dang dril bu'i rdzogs rim skabs su/ 'khor lo drug gsal te thog mar snying khar gnad du bsnun par bzhed/ bde mchog lū yi pa dang / 'jigs byed stor dang / nā ro nī gu'i khrid gas su 'khor lobazhi gsal nas thog mar dmigs pa'i tshe bar gnang du bsnun par bzhed/ dus 'khor dang rgyud khu gzhan du 'khor lo drug dang thog mar smin mtshams su bsnun par bzhed tshul so sor yod/ gsang ba las ches gsang ba'i 'di'ildogs rim skabs 'khor lo bzhi ldan du gsungs pa rtsa'i gtso bo rtsa'adab brgya dang nyi shu dang /twā khung bde ba'i gnas/ ste mgrin me'i gnas dang / de bzhi la rten 'bar 'dzag gi bde bo 'tshi pa sogs kyi ro rkyang mar sna dbu ma'i nang tshud cha yig rnam par gsal bas

ldan bdud ci'i gtor ma 'di/ /yul lha gzhi bdag gnas r+yā tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /mthun rkyen bsgrub cing sdong grogs gnas spro mdzod/ /ces dang / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs zhes sogs bden stobs brjod/ dbang gi r+pā du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dbon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen glu'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon spro chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la sgyurmo/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la khul/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la khul/thar pa chen khra'i grong mchog tu/ /mgonaXbos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ gsum pa rdzogs pa dang mnyam du zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ de nas/ las bum gyi chu 'thor ba dang chabs cig yo badz+ra.armā ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hāX phaṭa/ces brjod pas phyi yi khrus dang / de nas/ rang gi sgyi bor zla ba la yo dkar bo/ mgrin par pad+ma ga.āḥdamar bo/ thugs dkar nyo ma la hāX sngon bo/ yi ge gsum las lho zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros pas/ sdig sgrib nyes stong sgo gsum tha mal gyi rnam rtog rnams sangs kyis dag /rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'ozu ga dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces nyin gyis brlabs pa nang gi khrus kyi tha snyad mdzad pa'ang snang /rigs dang mos pa 'dri ba la/ bu ṣ+ṭha su yin ci la dga'/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o/ /dgos ched dri ba ni/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig kozhes bsgo/ byang sdom bzung ba la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can /mas cad bdag
