pa 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ /zhes gsang bar gdams/ do ji nyi bor reg cing / lus las byung ba'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ ṣ+ṭha kyi dam tshig 1— rje 'di/ /'ga' la smras na mag zung 'gems/ /zhes 1— rje snying gar reg la/ sems las byung ba'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ 1— rje sems dpa' deng rma kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes casang bdun pa dang / phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ko'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa 'bru gsum brjod de mna' chu 'thung la/ 'di ni bu khyod bdud rtsiste/ /ma bsrung sreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrung na dngos grub myur ba ste/ /bdud rtsilnga yi chus 'grub pa'o/ /yo pañca añja ta lku da ka t+ta t+ta khra/ zhes dam tshig smi dang / bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ 1— rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyis/ /ṇā kyis smad par mi bya zhing / /dam tshig 'gal bar mi bya ste/ /dmyal la sogs par 'gro 'gyur ro/ /zhes masang dang spro la dam bzhag bya/ bsdu na dam bzhag sgor bzhag kyang chog par gsungs/ rang gi khung gar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi cad nga zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi dkar 'ob 'ilnga pa'i lte ba la hāX gis mtshan par gyur/ yo sarba yo ga tsitakhu ba ta ya mi/ zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i thugs spu'i zla ba ṇ+ṭha las rang 'dra chad pa rang gi khung ga'i zla ba do rjer thim pas brtan par gyur par bsams la/ ṇ+ṭha me rtog dang bcas khung gar reg ste/ yo su ra be+e sa ma ya stuX ho sin+t+ra badz+ra ya thā su khaX/ zhes brtan par bya/ dpyal mgrin snying ga rnams su thal mo sbyar la/ yo na mo khe hāX/ na mā mi hāX/ na mo na ma hāX swāhā/ zhes phyag bya/ 'di yan gyi gdong g.yogs dang bcas te 'jug pa'i khor rnams song nas/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du 'jug pa la/ rje btsun ma dpal deng rma kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas
thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i/ /ko ྅'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces sha 3sa mig dar phye/da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos/ /mo badz+ra pā sh+ya ñcāzhes blta bar bskul/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i nyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor d+ku dbus su rje btsun ma dkar mo/ rtsa'adab so gnyis la rang 'dra'i rje btsun ma so gnyis kyis bskor ba/ mgrin pa longs oṃ kyi 'khor d+ku dbus su rje btsun ma dmar mo/ rtsa'adab bcu drug la rang 'dra'i rje btsun ma bcu drug gis bskor ba/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo dbus su rje btsun ma sngon mo/ ca'adab brgyad la rang 'dra'i rje btsun ma brgyad kyis bskor ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor d+ku dbus su rje btsun ma ser mo/ ca'adab re bzhi la rang 'dra'i rje btsun ma drug cu rtsabazhis bstor ba/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor d+ku dbus su rje btsun ma ljang gu/ ca'adab so gnyis la rang 'dra'i rje btsun ma so gnyis kyis bsgor ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa gnag snum ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa la/ mukhral dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing zlum pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon thugs spur dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya can gnyis spus mukhral sngon bo re re 'dzin pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/ rin bo che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa zla ba'i rgyab yol can mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad gsal zhing yongs su dwangs pa ste/ do ji'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur par bsam/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba'i rim pa bzhi las/dang bo bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub do ྅sa sangs rgyus la/ /mchod chen ji ltar smyo ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab bya'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag 365/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ añja r+sā sngags brjod pa dang / bum chu 'don bas phyi nang gi bgegs dang bhan chad bsang / swa bhā kau sngags kyis rang gi rnam smin
sha rus kyis mtshon pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pa med par lta bas zer zug tu 'dzin pa sbyangs/ sto pa'i ngang las rang nyid rje bag ma skyamadog ma rgad kyi mdangs can shin tu ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi zhing 'dzum pa gnag snum ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa la ༷khral dang / rin bo che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing zlum pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon thugs rka/ra dadon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya can gnyis spus tha'al sngon spro re re 'dzin pa/ nu ma 'bur zhing rgyas pa/ rin 11 tshe'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad gsal la yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por mdabu ma phyi sngo la nang dmar ba sgom phra mda' lhag tsam de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gro sog tsam pa/ de gsum ga lus kyi gzhung shing gi tshul du yod pa'i dbu ma la ro rkyang gis lu gu rgyud du 'khyud pa'i snying gar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa'adab brgyad pa/lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa'adab drug cu re bzhi pa/ nyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa'dab so gnyis pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa'adab bcu drug pa/ gsang gnas su bde skyong gi 'khor lo ca'adab so gnyis pa rnams dwangs shing gsal bar gyur par mos la/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed mnyon mongs chod mdzod la/rnal 'byor don dam rgyal yo de nyid bdag 'grub mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma sngon mo gtso'akhor dgu las/ rang 'dra gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ba rang gi snying ga'i tsa'akhor du byon/ sku las 'od zer 'phros khung ga'i canang thams cad gang bas zhe snang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye
shes mngon du byas/ de bzhin du/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ser mo gtso'akhor drug cu re lnga las rang 'dra gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis gad kyi tshul du byung pa rang gi ste ba'i ca'akhor du byon/ sku las 'od zer 'phros/ lte ba'i canang thams cad gang bas nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor —ba'i phung bo gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i mgrin pa longs go kyi 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma dmar mo gtso 'khor bcu bdun lasagi rang 'dra gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung pa rang gi mgrin pa'i ca'akhor du byon/ sku las go zer 'phros/ mgrin pa'i rtsanang thams cad gang bas 'go chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'edu shes kyi phung spro gnas bur/ gu ༄sar rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ljang gu gtso'akhor so gsum las rang 'dra gnyis pa mar 4me — —gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ba/ rang gi gsang gnas kyi rtsa'akhor du byon/ sku las go zer 'phros/ gsang gnas kyi rtsanarje thams cad gang bas/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung bo gnas bur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/bla ma rje bag ma'i m+bhi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma dkar mo gtso —'khor so gsum las rang 'dra gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung pa/ rang gi nyi d+ku rtsa'akhor du byon/ sku las lho zer 'phros/ m+bhi yi canang thams cad gang bas/ gnyi mug gi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung bo gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ma53 du byas so/ /'di dag gi skabs su dmigs rnam brda 'phrod nges pa'i sbyang bya'i dri ma gnas 'gyur bya'i phung lnga marga du bya ba'i ye shes lnga sogs so i skabs thob kyi 'chug med thog 'di ltar gsungs kyang r+pā du mi 'gyur snyam pa'i the tshom gyi gegs ma zhugs pa ni gnad kyi don no/ /de ltar bla ma'i lus kyi dkyilaX'akhor du sprim pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib
pa deg /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa dbang zhing / 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag go /zhes dag pa brjod cing / gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du gzugs dang lang m+mu dpal phun sur/ tshogs pa'i rig ma dang / maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab pa la/ byang chub do da( sangs rgyas la/ /mdode chen tshi bdag kyang tshi nag mkha'i 5 zhes lan gsum/ yo āḥhūX/ bar la gdong g.yogs bcings/ bla ma skad cig gis don yod grub pa ljang guyum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar de nyid rang gi mig dang lag pa'i yul ma yin par lcog tu bzhag pa myang bas lus sems thams cad brjode du med pa'i bde bas khyab par bsam/ dngos su nang mchod myangs/ de ltar myangs pa la brten nas 'bras dus kyi lhan skyes bde ba chen wa'i nyams khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs par gyur par mos la/ rdza ho mahwa su kha/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog lnga ldan go zer 'phro ba byung ste/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas rje btsun ma'i rig pa chen mo'i byin rlabs ngag la zhugs/ ngag gis bskyod pa kun rlung sngags dbyer med nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ yo tu re tu9 re tu re sruhwa/ zhes lan gsum gyis sna drangs brgya cabargyad 'don mthar/ bye brag rgyas pas na/ yo tu re tushī re tu re bdag gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad shāca ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes zhi ba dang / r+yā tu re tu: re tu re bdag gi tshe dang balho nams thams cad puṣ+ṭi ku nu yi grwahwa/ zhes rgyas pa dang / yo tu re tu: re tu re bdag gi dbang du khams gsum gyi 'gro ba pho mo zas nor longs spyod thams cad wa shaX ku ru hrīḥdzaḥswāswā/ zhes dbang dang / mo twa re turgyu re tu te bdag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces drag bo ste las bzhi'i spel tshig sbyar ba lan gsum re bzla/ spyan dar bsal la/ de ltar bla ma'i kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam rang byin rlabs sgom pa dbang zhing /
'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku grub pa'i nus pa bzhag ko /zhes ngag pa brjod/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du pad+ma can sogs mtshan ldan gyi phyag rgya dang / maṇ+ḍal phul/byang chub tshi mchod chen tshi bdag kyang tshi nam mkha'i 5 zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab 'bru gsum bar de tha mal gyi sred zhen dang kun dkris sgrib phyir gdong g.yogs bcings/dngos gzhi la sgom pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya shin tu brtan spros mthig g.yo ba tshad tsam nges par gal che bas tshig don bzhin ma yengs par/ rang nyid skad cig gis r+pā yod grub pa ljang gu ral gris mtshan pa'irdzangal dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can du gyur pa la/bla mas rje bag ma dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang go pas mtshan pa'irdzangal sngon po 'dzin pa zhig gtad par gyur par bsams la/ rgyal ba kun yum bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lha mo mchog 'di bu yi mchod rten mngon du gyis/ /zhes brjod cing byin pa dang / rang 'go lha yab yum du gsal ba lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi gsang gnas āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar spro 'dab rdza brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas hāX las lda ྅ sngon 5 bstolnga pa'i lte bar hāX gis mtshan pa sngags kyi 'du shes/thabs 'di la brten nas zag med kyi bde ba marga du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes dang ma bral bas/ yab yum gyi rtags dang rtags kyi tshesprad pa rtsado snga skyil kung / rtags kyi rtser zur sel rlung gi ngo lo yig 'brus bkag pa rlung do 3 skyil kung / byang sems 'pho med du bskyil ba thig le do 3 skyil krung ste gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems twā bo nas mgrin par slebs pa na dakho ba/ mgrin pa nas khung gar slebs pa mchog dga'/ khung gnas lta bar slebs pa na khyad dga'/ lta ba nas gsang gnas su lhos pa na lhan skyes kyi bde ba skyes/ de lta bu'i dga' ba bzhi re re yang / dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug phra ṇā lho yis spu ris phyed de/ bde ba de dang stong par sbyar ba'i bde stong zung 'jug 'bras dus kyi ye shes khyad par can skyes par mos la mnyam
par bzhag /spyan dar bsal la/ de ltar lha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang zhing /'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag ko /zhes dag pa brjod/ bzhi pa tshig dbang sga r+pā du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab pa la/ khyod zhabs pakhra'i bka' drin gyi/ /garoyin dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gtab/ bla ma'i lus dkyil gyi lha rnams las rang 'dra re chad pa rang gi lus kyi rtsa'akhor rnams su byon/ de dag kyang rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams kyang gtso mo la thim/ gtsomo yang thugs ga'i twaX yig la thim/ de yang rim gyis zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par bsams la/ dngos spro med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bu dri med pa/ /stong nyid ye shes ko ྅ yis/stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom/ /zhes brjod cing / bden pa'i dngos bo cung zad tsam yang ye nas med pa la/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba pode med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral bas/ nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri mas ma gos pa/ de lta bu'i stong pa nyid de/ yul yul can ye shes gnyis gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs pa stong nyid ye shes kyi ko ྅ des stong pa nyid du bsgom/ zhes pas zung 'jug bde ba chen bo rgyud la skyes par gyur/ bla mas gsungs par bsams la mnyam par 'jog la/ de ltar bla ma yab yum gyi don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo lo nyid sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag go /zhes dag pa bar/ ga༄rka ngas ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ces lan gsum gyis dam tshig khas blang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te
bdag bran du/ /khyed la zlo khyed kyi tshi ga yis 5 zhes lus bran du dbul ba rnams bya/tshogs mchod 'bul na mtshams 'dir 'bul/ chos bka'i sung ma gnyis kyi gtor 'bul grub na legs pas bya/ gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ yo gu 4ār+ya twa re sa pa ri sgrura.a ༷ nas/ shatsho bar gyi mar pa dang 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ dbyings rig rnam dag pad zla'i gdan steng na/ /ma rgad mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/lang tsho rab rgyas g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum zhabs/ /thabs shes zung 'brel ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spro zhing long lho na rje gong mas mdzad pa'i gdung 'bod gnyis kyang 'don/ na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal yum lhag pa'i lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /brtseb chen bos bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur pas/ /rgyal yum khyed la phog thug ci mchis dang / /khyad par dam tshig las 'gal nongs pa'i rigs/ /ba༄kha bzlas chag cing le los g.yeng ba sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i bya ba ci bgyis dang / /mdor na sgogasum nyes pa'i dri ma'i tshogs/ /snying nas 'gyod pa drag spros bshags par bya/ /de ltar rabatu bshags pa'i nus pa yis/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi yig brgya lan gsum gyis kha bskang / ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs dang / lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / bdag la dngos grub mchog 6lo la/ /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol zhing / dngos grub zhu ste/ yo badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod nas/ rnam dag yid kyi rdzing bur zhes sogs smon lam dang / shis brjod ni/rab yangs 'chi med lam dang zhes sogs kyi shis pa bsgo cing me tog sil mas phyogs thams cad khyab par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing / /rnam dag dam tshig sdom pa srog ltar srung / /rim gnyis rnal 'byor go pa'i skal bzang gi /lag
na sgrub gnyis 'dod gu'i gter brgya mchis/ /de phyir sgyi nang rnyogs pa kun bsring ba'i/dpal stug mngon dga'i grong khyer lta na sdug /zung 'jug nor bu'i ba gam 'phang mtho bar/ /bgo pa'i zem skas cho ga 'di brtsams so/ /dge 'dis rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i gar/ /spros med bde ba chen zla'i mkhar 'phags nas/ /mkha' khyab dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo'i sprin/ /grol ba'i dge legs snang ba myur 'tshar shog /ces rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs tsit+ta ma ṇi dang 'brel ba'i bdag 'jug len tshul nyes nyung mun pa 'joms pa'i zla ba gsar pa zhes bya ba 'di yang lam 'di'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i dge slong thong bzang chos 'phel lags nas bskul ba'i ngor/ mtshan zhabs dar han khri byang sprul ming byo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor 'bod pas 7skyabs gcig stag 6 ko ྅ 'chang gi gsung 'di ga'i dbang chog nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs kyi sgos mos rnams dor nas bdag 'jug rkyang pa ngag 'don 'khyer bder phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa'ang bskul ba spro nyid nas bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //go༅༅/ /rje btsun sgrol sdu dang dpal lda1 lha dzi sbrags sgrub kyi g.yang 'gugs napa sbri /lhashā tshol zhas bya ༄༅rgya/ /na mo gu ruswār+ya tu re shrī man de giye/ 'dir rje btsun sgrol ma dang dpal ldan lha mo sbrags nas mchod pa'i skabs su g.yang 'gugs bya ba'i tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi dang 'brel ba'i mchod chog de gzhi bdag gtor brtsa bar sngon du btang / cho ga dngos ni/ kyi rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las rnams/ /gcig bsdus bla ma rje btsun mar/ /gus pa chen spros gsol 'debs na/ /byin rlabs dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreng ba yis/
steng phyogs lha yi g.yang khug cig /thog dang 'dra ba'i spyan gnyis kyis/ /bar gyi mi yi g.yang khyag cig /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs gnyis kyis/ /'og phyogs klu yi g.yang khug cig /mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin phyag rgya yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub g.yang khug cig /rin po che yi rgyan mang gis/ /'dod dgu'i longs r+sā g.yang khug cig /lha rdzas dar gyi na bza' yis/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i g.yang khug cig /rigs bdag tshe dpag med mgon gyis/ /'chi med tshe yi g.yang khug cig /gser mdog 'od zer can ma yis/ /bsrung skyob sba ba'i g.yang khyag cig /nam mkha'i mdog can ral gcig mas/ /mthu byad bzlog pa'i g.yang khug cig /nyer gcig lha mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /'phrin las sna tshogag g.yang khug cig /rgyu'aphags ma'i thugs rje'i rnam par 'phrul/ /dka' bsrung dpal ldan lha mo la/ /gus pas mgo cing gsol 'debs na/ /las bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dbu gdugs rma bya'i slo mdongs kyis/ /lha yul tshe yi g.yang khug cig /gur khyim me rlung rab 'khrugs pas/ /mi yul chos kyi g.yang khyag cig /bzhugs gnas khrag mtsho'i klong 'khoragyis/ /klu yul nor gyi g.yang khug cig /rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan dre'u rta yis/ /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang khyag cig /mgo pags sprul gyi rta chas kyis/ /'dode dgu'i longs spyod g.yang khug cig /zhabs gnyis mdzes byed lcags sgrog gis/ /dkon sder bsdad pa'i g.yang khug cig /rin chen thod skam dbu rgyan gyis/ /mtshan ldan bshes gnyen g.yang khug cigspyan gsum zlog ltar 'khyug pa yis/ /spros bsam sgom pa'i g.yang khyag cig /sprul dang seṅge'i snyan rgyan gyis/ /rig lung gtong ba'i g.yang khug cig /zhal gdangs mi ro za ba yis/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i g.yang khug cig /smyo la la yi gad mo yis/ /mkhas rnams mgu ba'i g.yang khyag cig /phyag g.yas do re'i be+e can gyis/ /log smra tshar gcod g.yang khug cig /phyag g.yon khrag bkang thod pa yis/ /skal ldan rjes 'dzin g.yang
khug cig /dbu skra sma ra rab 'bar bas/ /snyan grags rgyas pa'i g.yang khyag cig /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan bzang gis/ /tshulakhrims bsrung ba'i g.yang khyag cig /re lde dar kos g.yang gzhi yis/ /lam gtso gsum gyi g.yang khyagaXcig /mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal gyis/ /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i g.yang khyag cig /khrag zhag thal ba'i sku rgyan gyis/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i g.yang khyag cig /stag sham sprul gyi ska rags kyis/ /zab lam rim gnyis g.yang khug cig /lte gtsug nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /bde stong zung 'jug g.yang khug cig /thugs dam sho re dkar nag gis/ /mngon shes lnga yi g.yang khyag cig /khram sogs sku chas sna tshogs kyis/ /mchog thun dngos grub g.yang khug cigma sring gdong can rnam gnyis kyis/ /'khor slob 'du ba'i g.yang khug cig /lku ma dung skyong lha hra yis/ /bu tsha dar ba'i g.yang khug cig /rab dwangs zhi ba'i lha slo yis/nad gdon zhi ba'i g.yang khug cig /rab bajid rgyas pa'i lha mo yis/ /tshe bsod rgyas pa'i g.yang khyag cig /rab chags dbang gi lha mo yis/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud g.yang khug cig /rab rngam drag wa'i lha mo yis/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i g.yang khug cig /res 'khor dus bzhi'i rgyal slo yis/ /sde bzhi'i dga' ston g.yang khug cig jo mo tshe ring mched lnga yis/ /rang rang dngos grub g.yang khug cig /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis nyis/ /bstan 'gror sman pa'i g.yang khug cig /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho yis/ /gang bsam 'grub pa'i g.yang khyag cig /kye tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa/ /lha yi bsod nams dpal 'byor g.yang / /dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na/gnas 'dir phywa dang g.yang la byon/ /dga' bo 'jog bo la sogs pa/ /klu yi mi zad gter gyi g.yang / /da dkar tshi/ /gnas 'dir tshi/ /'khor los balhar ba'i rgyal spro sogs/ /bar gyi mi yi phyugs g.yang de/ /dar dkar tshi/ /gnas 'dor tshi/ /rta nor ra lug la sogs pa/ /sgo na rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang / /dar dkar tshi/ /gnas
'dir tshi/ /gser dngul dar zab la sogs pa/ /phug na nom rdzas 'byor ba'i g.yang /dar dkar gu/ /gnas 'dir gu/ /bu dang tsha bo yang tsha sogs/ /bar na mgo nag mi yi g.yang / /dar dkar tshi/ /gnas 'dir gu/ /pha rol mi mthun dpung 'joms pa'i/ /khung stobs ldan pa'i dpa' rtsal g.yang / /dar dkar phyu/ /gnas 'dir zlo/mi mthun zhi ba'i bkra shis g.yang / /mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i phun tshogs g.yang / /dar dkaratshi/ /gnas 'diratshi/ /mdor na sngon bsags bgo nams kyi/ /sa bon byin rlabs gru char gyis/ /bskyangs pas don gnyis 'od gag gis/ /re ba'i bang ba gang bar shog/ //ces rje btsun zhol ma dang dpal ldan lha mo sbrags sgrub kyi g.yang 'gugs nor bu dga' 'khyil zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad ldan slob ma 'ga' zhig gi 'dod mos ltar/ sbyi bkwan yongs 'dzin gyi sgrol ma'i g.yang 'gugs la 'khor gnyis dang lha mo'i g.yang 'go /lhashā gra shāstag ste/ dka' bcu pa zlo bzang rta dbyangs kyis sug bris su gagyis pa dge ༄༄rgya/ /bcom ldanā 'das go n+dha lcugs ma skrol ma la brten pa'i bla ma rnal 'ju( ga (sogs pa bya tshul go༅༅/ /na mo gu rukār+ya tu rā yi/ gang gi mtshan snyan 'dzin dang brjod pa'i mdo/ /mi bzad 'jigs pa'i ra ba las zholate/ /bla med bde ba mchog la dkrir mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal yum bcom ldan sgrol mas bdag skyongs shig /'dir 'phags ma'i sgrubs thab las 'byung ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa bya tshul lam tshig nyung ngu 'go pa la skyabs sems sogs rgyud dang 'dres nges sngon tu btang nas/ bdag nyid kyi lus tha mal pa'i gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i
spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ thugs rje dang byin rlab gter chen spro rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig 'phags ma sgrol ma dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i drin can maba'i bla ma/sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa mtshan dpe gsol rdzogs kyis spras pa/phyag g.yas chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas pad+ma'i yu ba 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma dkar bo snyan gyi thad sor kha 'byed pa'i steng du do sngas mtshan pa/ g.yon gyis pad+ma'i yu ba 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan thad du rgyas pa'i steng na dril bus mtshan pa/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum dang /dbu la gser mdog paṇa zhwas mdzes pa/ sku las go zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i dbus na zhabs do ji skyil mo krung gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs gar ye shes sems pa/ rje bag 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu rin wa rā mar gad kyi ro bo lta bu/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas thugs spur mtheb srin sbyar bas5khrala'i yu ba 'dzin cing / phyag sor lhag ma gsum sgreng pas dgo mchog gsum mtshon pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sku la dar dang rin spro che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing / 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs spur/ ting nge 'dzin sems pa yi ge tuX yig ljang khu 'od zer 'phro ba ste sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'i m+bhi borayo/ mgrin pa.āḥ thugs spur hūX/ lte bar gsang bar hwa rnams kyis mtshan pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par//ye shes kyi rang snang tsas grub pa zhig rigs pa'i rtsal gyis gsal btab la thugs lnga'i hāX las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i mos pa brtan po bya ba la/ de dag nam yang mi 'bral bar byang chub ma thob kyi bar du nyi bor bzhugs par gsol bar btab pa/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/ dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i maca sprin spro ba/ tshe rabs thog med
nas bsags pa'i nyes nyung sdig pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa bya ba/ rang gzhan so skye 'phags pa kun gyi dge bar rjes su yi rang gi dga' ba bsgom pa/ chos 'khor bskor ba gsol ba 'debs pa rang gzhan kun gyi dge ba'i rtsab thams cad bla med byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo ba sogs/ bsags sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa nyams su blang ba dang / thugs spur ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' bskor du yi ge bcu pa'i bsngags 'phreng gis bskor ba la dmigs pa btad nas/bzlas pa ci nus bya ba dang / bla ma'i mtshan sngags bzla ba sogs gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ slar yang / bla ma dang rje btsun ma dbyer ma mchis pa la gsol be gdung shugs drag po btab pa'i mthu la brten nas bla ma'i jiganas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing kha gsum byung ste rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ sgo gsum gyi sdig rdung bag chags dang bcas thams cad lhag med du sbyangs te/ bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab yi shes kyi dbang thob par mos shing / slar yang / lte ba dang gsang ba'i yi ge sruhwa gnyis las/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros pas rang gi gnas lngar thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa sogs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs pa la brten nas/sku bzhi 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhags pa'i mos pa shugs drag spro bya zhing / mthar bla ma rang gi nyi bo nas byon te/ rang gi khung dbus su bzhugs pa la/ dus rtag tu bka' drin chen gra'i sgo nas bdag rjes su 'dzin cing sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub yang dag par stsal du gsol/ zhes rtsegacig tu gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de lta bu'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung ba gnas bla ma tshul bzhin du bsten pa dang / de dag gi rtal 'byor zab mo nyams su lan pa'i tshul/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa la med du mi rung ba'i lam gyi srog shing lta bu yin la/ 'di dag gi dmigs skor sogs zhi ba par yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi tas stsal ba'i bla ma mchod pa'i khrid yigachechungasogasalasartogasapa bya'o/ /zhesapa yang dam
chos legs bshad kyi bzhed pa slong slad/ rong sprul pas g.yar khral du bris pa'o/༄༄༄/ /'phags ma la brten pa'i srung 'khor 'bri bsgrub sogs ji ltar bya tshul bzhugs so/༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru ār+ya tu ra yi/ dus gsum rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /'jigs pa kun skyob 'dod dgu kun/ /r+yā mdzad 'phags ma sprol ma la/ /'dud de byang chub de srid skyong / /'phrin las rab 'byams lha lam dang / /mnyam song dam pa'i man ngag las/ /'khor d+ku gsal byed dang bcas te/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gi pad+mo bzhad/ /'dir 'phags ma snyol ma'i las rim mtha' yas pa las/ mgon po klu yis snyol ma'i sgrub thabs nyi'i mngon par rtogs pa la brten nas gsal byed/ las rim gzhan las kha slong dang bcas 'chad pa la gnyis las/ de la dang po rtsaba'i sgrub thabs snyol dkar sngon sogs rigs gang yin yang chog mod/ /'dir gzhug gi dgongs pa ltar na/ thog ma skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i khung gar hwaX yig gis mtshan pa/ de las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs/ 'od zer gyi sne las rin bo che'i me rtog sogs mchod sprin mtha' yas pas mchod par gyur/o ār+ya tu rā sa pa ri gur badz+ra stse pra hwa ñcha hāX grwahwa/ yo ār+ya tu re dhu pe/ ā lo ka/ ga:/ni gibyu/ shap+ta pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhāX/ 'og ma med nas da lta'i bar/mi dge bcu dang tshams med lnga / /sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /bgyis pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /zhes sam/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wā sogs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid rwa de lasakha'il ste bar rtu yig gis mtshan par gyur/ yangarok+ṣal hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las
bdag nyid 'phags ma sku mdog ljang 13 g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon pas༄yal bsnams pa snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ dar dang rin 1 —3'i rgyan dang na bzas klubs pa/ cad phung gi slong na bzhugs pa/ mig gnyis su/ yo twa re swāhā/ rna ba gnyis su/ yo tu: re swāhā/ snar yo tu re swāhū/ lcer yo tu sruhwa/ snying gar yo re sruhwa/ rang gi thugs spur pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar ga las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rtu ljang khu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥgāX baX go dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyas dbu brgyan par gyur/ /mchod pa 'bul bar 'don na/ bya rgyud ltar nyin rlabs bya/ yo ar+ya twa rī sā pa ri bor a ༷ pra hwa ñcha hāX swāhā/ pa byaX nas/ shatsho bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba la sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ /au tu re tu: re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas/ bsnyen tshad bzhi 'bum mo/ lha las sbyor la bzlas dmigs ni/ snying gar 'khor lo kha dog ljang sngon rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte ba la/ mo bdag gi tshe dang bgo nams rgyas par gyur cig /hwa/zhes pas bsgor ba'i dbus su twa rtsibs rnams la tu re tu: re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa rnams lang stabs su gnas pa de las gu zer ser spro 'phros/ /rang ngam bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad gang bar bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'byung bzhi'i tshe bcud lha klu mi yi tshe bsod thams cad rang la thim par bsam la/ /yo tu re turgyu re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa/ mo twa re tut+ta re ma ma rdza yur pu h+ye dz+nyā na pu sto ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa bzla'o/ ༈ /srung ba ni 'khor lo'i lte bar/ yo bdag la rak+ṣa hwa/ zhes pa lta bu/ gzhan bsung na/ yo zhes pa'i mtshams su minang dgod la mthar rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes pa dang / rtsibs brgyad la tu ra sogs brgyad bkod/ mu khyud dang bcas pa/ kha dog lha'i sku mdog lta bu/ sgrol ma'i sku dang sngags dang ba'i 'khor lo las spros pa'i lho zer gyis rang ngam bsgrub bya'i lung gang ba
rang bsam/ bzla bya'i sdags ni/ phreng sdags zhes pa/ /yo twa re tu9 re tu re ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes pa dang / gzhan srung na/ ma ma'i tshab tu dā na pā 3 rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā zhes so/btson ra la sogs bsrung ba dang / nad rims sung ba sogs zhi ba dang / gzhan yang dbang du bsdu ba dang / tshe bsod sogs rgyas pa'i las dang / shes rab 'phel ba'i man ngag sogs mang du yod kyang btang snyoms su bzhag go /bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ yig brgya brjod/ gtang rag gi mchod k+ṣ+ṇā/ ma rnyed yongs su5 lhag pa dang ni chad pa5 ye shes chos dbyings su badz+ra māḥ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ bkra shis gang mos bya'o/ gnyis pa srung ba'i tsakra bye brag tu bshad pa la khungs 'god pa dang / lag len bya ba'i tshul/ rab gnas/ phan yon bstan pa'o/dang spro ni/ mgon bo klu sgrub kyi 'di'i gzhung las/ gzhan yang bh+yor ba bya ba ni/ /'di lta bur yang bstan pa yin/ /grogs la sogs bzhi la ni/ /'khor lo gong ma ltar bris nas/ /lus la bcang bar byas na yang / /de tsam gyis kyang bsrung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa lag len dngos bshad pa la sgyi dang bye brag gnyis/ dang spro nyi sung ba ni/ 'khri gzhi zo ga'i shun pa'am rgya shog /ma rnyed na'ang gtsang ma'i shog bu la/ rgya snag gis 'bri/ 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ rtu de'i mtha' nas g.yas stor du dbu phyir bstan gyi yo bdag 'chang ba bo la mi mthun pa kun las rak+ṣa twā/ zhes pa bri ma shong na sprul 'khyil pa ltar/ yo nang ma mtha' nas bsgor/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad las shar rtsibs la tu/ shar ṣ+yo la re/ ltor tu:/ bh+yo nub tu twa/nub tu re/ nub byang du tu/ byang du re/ byang shar du swā/ rnams g.yas stor du dbu phyir bstan/ de'i phyir rim mu khyud la ye dhar mthar 'dod gsol bris kyang chog /de'i phyir ril rje ra/ de'i phyir me ri bri/ gur gum gyis byug /gnyis pa bye brag gi sung ba la gsum las/ dang spro zhi ba la/ 'bri gzhi dar ras dkar bo'am ma rnyed na shog bu dkar bo la/ rab dngul dung sogs dang ma rnyed na snag tshas snga ma ltar bris te/ khyad par ni lte ba'iyo yig gi mthar 'chad ba spro'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad shāca ku ru hwa/
zhes pa la bzang drug gis byug /yang dmigs gsal byed pa spro na/ yo tshe ring don ldan gyi bad spun gyi nad gdon thams cad shuca ku ru swā/ zhes pa lta bu'i ming 'jug /ming ma shes na 'chang ba bo byas kyang chog /rjes la cong zhi bzang drug rnams bya zhing / de bzhin du rlung mkhrus dang / 'dus nad/ rims sogs ming gang dgos bsgyur/ rdzas bzang drug dang / nad so so'i gnyen gra'i sman sna sbyar ba bya/ yang rta la sung ba byed na/ o yig gi mthar 'di 'chang ba'i rta 'di nyid rta nad mche bcu las rak+ṣa hwa/ rdzas bzang drug /a ru bya'u/ dar sna lnga nor phyugs la/ yo mthar 'di 'chang ba'i g.yag gam 'bri khri'u la/ ton gro/ gor sogs gang dgos bri te/ mtha' rak+ṣa hwa/ rdzas dgu bh+yor dang / ga pur sogs bya/ yang lug sung na'ang / lug 'di nyid nad thams cad las rak+ṣa hwa/ rdzas dgu sbyor dang / ga pur bya/ de rnams kyi thum res dkar bo'am/ phyir dkar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa la gnyis las/ dang po tshe ring ba byed pa'i 'khor hra ni/ 'bri gzhi dar ras ser spro 'am/ ma rnyed na shog bu ser spro la/ rab gser/ tha ma mtshal snag tsha sogs nyis 'khor lo ni snga ma ltar la khyad par ni/ lta ba'iyo gyi mthar srung ba bya ba'i ming bris pa'am/ 'chang ba bo 'di nyid tshe mthar nyin cing b.rod nams legs tshogs thams cad puk+ṣa ku ru hwa/ ces bri/ rdzas la/ bdud rtsilnga yi ril bu/ gur gum/ rin chen phye ma sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ shes rab rgyas pa byed pa la/ sngags rnams g.yon skor dbu nang bstan/ mu khyud la rdza li kā li g.yon skor/ lte b.rayo dam chos legs bshad kyi shes rab che gsal myur zab thos 'dzin mi brjed pa'i gzungs sarba yo ku ru hwa/ zhes pa lta bu'i ming 'jug mu khyud kyi dbyangs gsal mthar dam chos legs bshad kyi shes rab nas pusto ku ru yo bar khri/rdzas gi wang / kha che gur gum shes rab ril bu sogs byin rten bzang ba bcug na legs 'dra'o/ /gsum pa dbang la/ dar ras dmar bo'am shog bu dmar bo la/ rgya skyegs mtshal gang rungagis sngaraltarakhri/ ltebarayo changabasprosasrid zhi'i legs tshogs
thams cad boshadu ngu ho hāX/ rdzas la spyir btang bzang drug sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa rab gnas ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ stegs kyi khang dar ras dkar yi steng 'bru dkar bkram pa'i steng du srung 'khor bzhag /mdun du mar pa sbyang chas rnams bsham/ gong gsal bdag skyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi thugs spu'i hāX las 'od zer 'phros sung bar rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcade pa'i bgegs thams cad bkugs par gyur pa bsam ga ka ro gsum gyis gtor ma nyin gyis rlabs/ /yo sarba yi:༷ dang / sum+bha ni sogs/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang / na mo ji btsun sogs nas/ khyad par 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa chen yi srung 'khor rab gnas bgyid pa la bar du gca pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la sogs nas/ sum+bha ni gu gul gyis bdug yungs spur gyis brab/ de nas/ swā lha lus sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shuX las srung ba'i 'khor la yis brgyad mu khyud ṇ+ṭha 'i rwa ba tsheri dang bcas pa'i stob dang / bka pa'i yig 'bru rnams pad zla'i gdan la/ rtswa las ut+pal tuX gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags ma sku mdog ljang sngon g.yas mi 'jigs pa sogs nas 'ode phung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i m+bhi borayo/ mgrin pa.āḥ thugs lngar hāX las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa dbu brgyan par gyur/ mgo pa byin rlabs bya/ yo ār+ya tu rī sa pa ri sgrur ar+ghaX nas shatsho bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ yo tsak+ṣa tsak+ṣa sa man tsak+ṣa ji sho rnyi ni swāhā/ srung 'khor gyi ming yig go du zhu ba las/ srung bya tshe dang bsod nams nam shes rab dad / dpal 'byor/ gzugs dang lang tsho legs tshogs kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi thugs spu'i hāX las go 'phros/ bsrung bya bkug te de nyid la thim/ 'phags ma'i thugs spur zla gdan la/ tuX yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bsgor ba las 'od phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam pa bkug ste sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim/ de las lho zer 'phros pas bsrung
bya la thim —pas mi mthun pa'i tshogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par/ ye shes do rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/ /mthun phyogs kyi yon tan thamase can rgyas par gyur par bsam la/ yi ge bcu pa dang phreng sngags ci 'grub bzla/ de nas/ 'khor lo'i sngags rnams spel tshig bcas brgya'am nyer gcig re/ mthar yig brgya tshar bdun sogs kyis brtan par bya/ yo.ār+ya ta re sā pa ri gara.a ༷ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba 'di 'byung ba'i gago pa sogs ma byung bar du brtan par bzhugs nas 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad cing / khyad par bsrung bya 'di nyid srung skyobs dang legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ yo su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ rje btsun ma gdan pad+ma sogs 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khor lo dang mtshan dpe rnams yig 'bru'i rnam paragyur/ ye pyā mang du brjod/ /nyin mo bde legs sogasashis brjod me tog gtor/ de nas/ lte ba ma chag par lte ba/ spro na tshon skud lngas dkris/ slar yang rab gnas shis brjod 'grub na legs/ 'dogs yul bgegs skrad byin rlabs byas te sung 'khor bsgom nas gdag /thun nyi dang zhi ba la dkar/ shes rab sogs ser/dbang dmar bor bya/ mi lag mi rgyud gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa de ltar bgyis pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhung nas sgrol ma las kyi sbyor ba yi/ las rnams yang dag bsgrub bya ste/ /nad sogs zhi ba'i las rnams ni/ zhes dang / las gzhan dag kyang bya bar nus/ /zhes dang / gong du smos pa ltar 'khor myo gong ma ltar bris nas/ zhes pa nas srung bar 'gyur zhes gsungs be+e/ gang ltar tshul bzhin/ rdzas bri sgrub sogs 'du bgyis pa lus la 'chang bas/ mi mthun pa kun las rgyal zhing / nad rims sogs srung zhing zhi ba dang / tshe dang basprod nams shes rab 'phel zhing rgyas la/ dbang du 'du bar 'gyur te/ gzhung las/ de ltar bsgom dang bzlas byas na/ /lbo dman rnams ni lbo ldan 'gyur/zhes dang / dbang dubyaba'iskyorabala'ang/ zhes rnams/ gong gi bris pa'i 'khor
lo'o lung gis dngos su 'di 'grub par bstan to/ /de ltar na the tshom spang nas 'chang na gong du bshad pa rnams kyi 'bras bu ji lta ba 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ bya grub ye shes mtshar ga rmo ma'i 'phrul/ /smin legs gzugs shar gang de'i las rab 'byams/mtha' yas 'di na smon 'dod dkar khra'i las/ /rab gsal mthong bas mngon 'dod 'grub par byas/ /'on te bdag khro.a raṇ+ḍa yi ljon/ /skye bar mngon goms shes rtsal 'bras kyis stong / /nyes par bshad kun dge ba'i ldog pa bcas/ /bla ma rje btsun drung du mthol lo bshags/ /legs byas mchis na 'gro 'dir bdag lta'i 'ching / /lu gu rgyud de sprel de 'grol byed rgyur/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyis rjes su slob phyir bsngo/ /las tshogs 'di yang rnam kun mthu ldan smon/ /zhes pa'ang sga k+ṣ+ṇā nya mtsho sha ru 'dus pa'i sde'i grwa bgres dge slong dam tshos legs bshad kyis 'di bzhin dgos tshul yodu mar yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /ci'ang mi shes pa'i can rmongs nyi brtol can/ dge slong lbo bzang chos 'byor lhun grub pas/ /rgya gzhung de nyid gzhir bzhag ste/ ris mthun las tshogs 'ga' las rigs pas blang khyal gsal zhing kha stong tshang bar/ ༈ /sa khyi'i bgrang gzhi'i char ldan dus kyi gong phyogs su dben gnas chos kyi pho brang du sbyar bas las rnams nus pa thogs med du gyur nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mtha' yas pa byed cing phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par rgyur gyur gi gu/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/༄༄rgya/ /rme btsun snyol ma zhi ba chen mo bka' bsung zhi ba'i lha mo lhadzo bcas pa la brten nas miphyugs kyi nad snyiparnyi sel zhing (srung ba'i bum pa bsgrub tshul kun snashā shā|r+sha sa so na bcud sa go༅༅/ /na mo gu ru ār+ya twa re ye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i snying rje'i chu gter las/
rab 'khrungs zhi ba'i lha mo ༄(da dkar can/ /rab bsil bdud rtsi'i char gyis dus ngan gyis/ /rab mang nad yams tsha gdung gzhil bar mdzod/ /'dir rgyal kun yum mchog rje btsun sgrol ma zhi ba chen mo bka' bsung zhi ba'i lha mo dang bcas pa'i sgo nas mi phyugs kyi nad yams sogs sel zhing bsung bar 'dod pas/ bshes gnyen dam pa tshul bzhin du bsten nas/ lam mthun mong bas rgyud sbyangs shing / bla med dkyil 'khor chen por dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ 'di lnga'i rjes gnang dang man ngag rnams kyang legs par nos te/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sgrub khang byi dor byas la/ /rje btsun ma zhi khro'i sku brnyan sogs legs par bkram/ de'i mdun du rin spro che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par rgyun babs kyi gtsang ma'i chus sum gnyis tsam bkang la bla med nas gsungs pa'i bum rdzas nyer lnga dang / lta grub kyi sel med pa'i byin rten ril bya ci rigs dang / nad gang gtso che ba sel ba'i sman dper na tsha ba'i nad zhi ba'i don du yin na ga bur sogs bsil sman btab pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su me rtog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du bzhag /bum pa'i khar dung chos dri bzang gi chusasne bkang ba dang / do 3 la me rtog gi phreng ba btags pa gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag la/bum pa'ig mdun du mar pa chu gnyis nyer r+sā tshar kha shas dang / yi dam chos skyong gdon bgegs gzhi bdag lo ༄gyo la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma rnams phyag len ltar bawo pas mdzes par bshams/ rang gi nye logs su nang mchod dang dor dril ḍā ma ru sogs yo byad rnams kyang 'tshogs par byas la/rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud da( los nges su bya zhing / spro na khyad par gyi sems bskyed kyang bsgom/ de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma zhi ba chen mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag 'phrin las chu 'dzin dkar khra'i bcud/ /rig sngags byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /yul khams nad yams btsa' than rab sbyangs shing / /bde skyid dbyar gyi lang tsho rtag rgyas shog /ces grub pa'i slob dpon chen yo nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi rje btsun sgol ma zhi ba chen mo bka' bsrung zhi ba'i lha mo dang bcas pa la brten nas mi phyugs kyi nad rims sel zhing bsrung ba'i bum pa bsgrub tshul kun phan bdud rtsi'i sprin bcud ces bya ba 'di ni/ yul dang dus kyi mtha' 'dir rang gzhan gyi nyams len du dgos gal che bar ma'ong nas/ mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi man ngag bzhin du btsun gzugasa.a sha ṣ+yo khus yi ge'i lam du spel ba dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅgal/
go༅/ /sgol bstod maXzhe patsho sbyo/rnyi ༷ tshol pa 'jigs med dpa' go༅tsho/ /bla ma dang rje btsun sgrol ma dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal so/ /brtseb chen spros rjes su bzung du gsol/ /shes rab snang bas mthar 'dzin mun pa dang / /gces 'dzin tsha gdung rjes brtses drung phyung nas/ /lus can phan bde'i kun+da rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma mchog dang grol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /smra ba'i nyi ma /lha sid+dhi yis/ /'gro la tshe dang ye shes mchog sgyul ba'i/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog yid bzhin 'arna lo mar/ /bstsa tshig me ga zhal sgo cung zad phye/ /de la 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ 'phags mchog phyas/ na pañca gus dus bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon du bsam bzhin du ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol ba bka' gdams bstan pa'i sgron me paṇa chenaXthams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun sgrub pa dpal bzang 1rtso nas mtshan snyan 'jig rten gsum na grags pa de nyid kyi mdzad pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor pho la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i gzhung mchog mkhyen brtsidri med ma zhes grags pa'i byin rlabs kyi gter chen bo 'di nyid yin la/ 'di 'chad par byed pa la gsum/klad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang spro ni/ na yo.ār+ya tu ra ye zhes pas 'chad/ 'di don 'gyur gyiXdabang du byas na/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo 3sa thob pa yin te/ na mo phyag 'tshal lo/ ar+ya 'phags ma/ /twa ra ye grol ma la zhes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yang mthong spang mi dge ba las ring du gyur cing / 'khor 'das kyi skyon las 'phags pas na 'phags ma/ lus can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las zhol zhing / ma rgan sems can thams cad la nye ring med par gang 'dul gyi don mnyam du mdzad pas na sgrol ma/ las ngan gyi sdig sgrib phyag pas na phyag sgo gsum gus par bgyid pas na 'tshal ces pa yin pas phyir/ 'di la sgra la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang
bos/ na mo ār+ya tu ra ye zhes bsgo na skyon go tshul dang / na ma ār+ya twa ra yi zhes brjod na skyon med pa yin tshul gsungs/ gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum/ yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas bsto pa/ yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub zhu ba/ re 'bras ji bzhin 'grub par smon pa'o/ /dang bo la gsum/ sku'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dran pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan gyi tshul gyis bgo pa/ sku'i cha shas so sor dran pa'i sgo nas rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis bstod pa/ bstod pa bo la dngos grub stsol ba'i sgo nas don bsdu'i tshul gyis bstod pa'o/ /dang bo la gnyis/ sku gzi 'od 'bar zhing lang tsho'i dpal dang /sra ༈sna gyi spya /pa /stod pa/ shin tu zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan tshul gyi sgo nas bgo pa'o//mkhyen brtsidri med rgyas pa'i rang bzhin gyi//pad dkar bsil zer can gyi gdan steng na//lhag pa'i lha mo gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog ma//rab mdzes lang tsho'i dpal yon can der 'dud/ces gsungs/ don ni/ 'dud ces pa bshad pa'i gzhir drangs pa gang la na/ mkhyen pa dri ma med pa don dam shes rab kyi cha rgyas pa'i rang bzhin pad+ma dkar bo dang / de'i steng du brtseb dri ma med pa kun rdzob kyi thabs kyi cha rgyas pa'i rang bzhin bsil zer can te zla ba nya yongs su gang ba brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng na/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen ba6nus mthu 'phrin las dang bcas pa lhag pa'i lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba sku mdog mchog tu dkar zhing gzi 'od rab tu 'bar bas gangs ri'i mdangs 'phrog ma ste/ gangs ri'i mdangs kyang mog mog bor byed pa/ gzugs dang lang m+mu dpal gyis smin legs stong gi rab tu mdzes pa 'phrog par byed pa'i lang m+mu dpal dang ldan pa yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid can gyi rje btsun ma de la zhes pa'o/ /'o na rje btsun ma 'di
yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i sgrub byed ji 'dra yod snyam na/ 'di nyid sh+ka bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol tu/ 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs go gu bya bar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgra zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i bstan pa la mchog tu gus pa'i rgyal khra'i bu mo ye shes zla ba zhes bya ba zhigalkugad de/ des sangs rgyas de'i 'khor nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun grangs mede pa dang bcas pa la lo bye ba brgya stong gi bar du mched pa byas be+e/ mthar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing /de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis khyed dge ba'i rtsab 'di nyid kyis lus 'di nyid la skyes par gyur te/ bstan pa la bya ba byed par spron lam btab na de bzhin du 'gyur ro shes bskul bas/ rgyal spro'i sras mos/ 'di na skyes pa med cing bud med med/ bdag med gang zag med cing rnam rig med/ /pha mar btags pa'i 'di ni ya ma rla/ /'jig rten bla ngan rnam par 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ skyes pa'i rten la byang chub 'go pa ni mang sga bu med kyi lus kyi 'gro ba'i don spyod pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /de bas na 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bud med kyi gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don bya'o/zhes dam bcas so/ /de nas lo bye ba rgya stong sga bar du rgyal spro'i pho brang du gnas shing /'go pa'i yon tan lnga la thabs mkhas pas go bzhin du ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa job cing / 'gro ba thams cad sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin grub pa na/ sngar gyi ming de 'gyur nas sgrol ma zhes bya bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnga sgras kyang / ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon du ma byas pa de srid ming lha mo sgrol mas mtshan pa 'ba' zhig tu sur bar lung bstan to/ de nas mi ring bar yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog brnyes nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad bzhin du bzhugs so/ gnyis pa shin tu zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan tshul gyi sgo nas bgo pa ni/ rtsab las/
/zhal gcig phyag gnyis 1— rje skyil kung bzhugs//bde chen rab rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can//shin tu sgeg cing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan//gzhon nu nu 'bur rgyas ma rma la 'dud/ces gsungs/ don ni/ gus pas 'dud do/ gang la na/ bden gnyis ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma zad par spangs pa mtshon pa'i zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sgrub pa bo mchog mthun dngos grub kyi dga' ston la 'bod par mdzad pa mtshon pa/ g.yo me rtog tsola'i yu ba thugs spur mtheb srin gyis bzung ba snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i yal ga gsum du gyes pa'i dbus ma kha shag gis bye ba g.yas spub nas 'bras bu yode pa/ g.yon kha ma bye ba/ de gsum gyis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa/ sems can gyi don la nam yang g.yo ba med pa mtshon pa'i zhabs gnyis 1— rje skyil kung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba chen spro rab tu rgyas pa mtshon pa'i zla ba'i rgyab yol canate zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la studrang bor brten pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi gzi bajid dang ldan pa'i 7shin tu smyo cing / spyan dkyus ring la dkar nag gi cha rnams ma 'dres par mdzes la cung zad zum pa/ zhi ba'i gzigs stangs kyis mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lho pa'i na m+wa can/ sh+ka mongs dang ma 'dres pa'i zag med kyi bde ba'i gter du gyur pa'i nu ma gnyis 'bur zhing / mtsho bo spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgyas pa'i grogs mdzad sno la zhes pa'o/ de yang rje btsun sgrol ma 'di la skye'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa las sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo 'di nyid kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba 'joms par mdzad cing / gsol ba btab nas gzungs sngags tshul bzhi/ du bzlas na 'chi med che'i dngos
grub stsal ba dang / chos ldan gyi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i gas nges par mdzad cing / de'i rgyu mtshan tshe sbyin bzhin 'khor lo 'di nyid nyis ri ro sa/ ta lar mgo spro spyan ras gzigs la/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen yos sems can gyi 6 mdzad pa'i grogs bdag gis bgyi'o/sems can gang dag bdag gi ming 'dzin pa de'i tshe bsring bar bgyi'o/ gzhan gyi gago pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi'o/ bdag yid la byed pa'i sems can de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub la nges par dgod par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsol te/ mgon bo spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i grogs dan mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes shing / /khyad par du 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la sras kyi mthu bo spyan ras gzigs/ rma kyi rjes 'brang kho mos skyong / kho zla gdams pa'i 'di long la/ /rjes su 'brang la bsten par gyis/ /zhes bka' gdams kyi rnam thar gtsang ma 'dzin pa rnams bu ltar skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes shing / de la brten nas mgon bo a rti sha dang chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen po dang / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa sogs bka' gdams gsar snying gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'di nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung nas gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pas thugs rgyud la yon tan thams gong nas kong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'ar+sā don rgya chen spro mdzad pa sha stag byung ba yin pas rang cag rnams kyi kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi rjes su 'brang nas rje btsun zhol ma 'di nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste/ /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mkho skyabs dang dpung gnyen zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas gsol ba tshul bzhin du btab na tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar ma zad/ thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyi ches cher 'phel ba nges par 'ong ba yin ko/ /gnyis pa sku'i cha shas 1༄ gyor dran pa'i sgo nas rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis bstod pa la bzhi/ phyag stabs mdzad tshul la bstod pa/ zhal mdangs gsal zhing 'od zer 'phro tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ rgyan gos kyis brgyan tshul gyi sgo nas bstode pa/ chen
spro rnams kyi maca tshul gyi sgo nas bstsa pa'o/ dang bo la gsum/ g.yas kyi phyag stabs mdzad tshul la blto pa/ g.yon gyi phyag stabs mdzad tshul la bstod pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil la spyan mnga' tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ da' spro ni/ cab las//phyag g.yas bsgrub lā mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis//zhi sogs rab 'byams las dang grub chen brgyad//rgyal ba'i ko 'phang mchog kyang bde blag tu//legs par sbyin mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes gsungs/ don ni/ phyag 'tshal lo 3sa pa nas bshad pa'i gzhir drangs/ gang la zhe na/ reg bya 'jam zhing gnyen lhug dang ldan pa'i phyag g.yas pa zhabs pus g.yas pa'i steng du phyag mthil gyen la bstan pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa yis/ /bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa'i bsgrub pa bo rab la mchog gi dngos grub dang / /'bring la grub pa chen bo brgyad dang / tha ma la zhi sogs rab 'byams kyi las rnams sgyuzla ba mtshon zhing / kyang gi sgras sgrib gnyis kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang mchog kyang bde blag tu legs par sbyin par mdzad na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i lha m+mu skur bstan nas skal ba bzang spro dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa sogs thabs la mkhas pa'i rje bag ma de la sgogasum gus pa'i sgonas zhes pa'o/ gnyis pa galho gyi phyag stabs mdzad tshul la bar+sā pa ni/ rtsab las//phyag g.yon sprakhul bsnams pa'i skyabs sbyin gyis//seṅge glang chen me dang dug sprul sogs//'jigs pa kun skyob dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi//yum gyur dge ma me+e la phyag 'tshal lo/
zhes gsungs/ don ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis :khrala'i yu ba bzung shing bsnams pa'i mdzub mo gung mo mthe'u chung gsum sgreng ba dkon mchog gsum 'du'age pa'i bdag nyid du mardza pa g.yon gyi nu ma'i thad du phyag mthil thur la bstan pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas 'khor ba'i sems can rnams seṅge/ glang chen/ me dang /dug sprul te dngos su bstan pa bzhi dang sogs khongs nas thon pa rkun po/ lcags sgrogchu bo/ sha za ste/ phyi'i 'jigs pa brgyad dang / /nga rgyal gnyi mug zhe sdang phrag dog lta ngan ser sna 'dod chags the tshom ste nang gi 'jigs pa chen bo brgyad de bcu drug gis mtshon/ 'jigs pa kun las skyob par mdzad cing / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum du gyur pa/ rang nyid dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi mthar phyin cing /sems can mtha' yas pa dge ba bcu'i lam la 'go par mdzad pa'i dge ba can ma skyode la zhes pa'o/ sngon yang sems can 'jigs pa de dag las bskyabs tshul gyi dpe rim bzhin bshad na/ nyi seṅge'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ can shing 'thu mkhan zhig nags su song ba seṅge mo bkres paXdang 'phrad nas khar thogs te za bar brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ bud med shing lo'i gos can zhig byung bas seṅge'i kha nas blangs te tshong dus su bzhag pa lta bu'o/ phyi glang spro'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang bu mo zhig me rtog 'thu ru song ba/ glang chen gtum r+yā snas bcings te mche ba bsnun par brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ ko ba'i stegs dang / tshong 'dus dang / 'dun khang dang / lha khang dang / rgyal dzo'i khang rnams su rim pa ltar bzhag ste sna shal gyis phyag byas pas bsod nams can du rig nas rgyal po'i btsun mor gyur pa lta bu'o/ /phyi me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang khyim tshang zhig la mtshan mo sha 'khon can gyi dgra bos me sbar ba na/ 'bros par rtsams kyang mthar ba'i ched/ zhol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ /khyim gyi steng du sprin rū zhing mdzes pa zhig byung ba las char
rgyun gnya' shing tsam babs pas me zhi ba lta bu'o/ /nyi dug sprul gyi 'gas pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang smad tshong ma zhig mu tig gi do shal lnga brgya ster ba'i tshong dpon zhig gi khyim du gas pa'i lam du shing la gnas pa'i dug sprul lus la 'khril ba'i tshe/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ sprul de me tog gi 'phreng bar gyur nas zhag bdun lus kyi rgyan du gyur pa lta bu'o/ phyi rkun yi 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang yul lha ra gcu'i tshong dbon longs spyod dang ldan pa zhig nga mong stong dang / khyu mchog lnga brgya la tshong zog bkal lte/ ma ru'i yul du chas pa'i lam gyi 'grog dgon par mi sha za ba'i chom rkun stong tsam gyis 'joms pa na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ slo bur du dpa' bo go mtshon thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ste/ chom kun rnams rgyang ring bor bskrad nas bde bar phyin mu cilta bu'o/ /phyi lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang rkun zla'i dgo zhig gis rgyal yi marga phyag stozhugs pas chang gi bum pa dang 'phrad pa 'thungs pas/ ba3 nas gnyid song ba bdag bos rig ste/ btson rar lcags sgrog gis bcings shing sdug pas btang ba na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ 'dab chags kha dog lnga ldan zhig byung nas lcags sgrog bkrol te ci bder btang zhing slar 'khor dang bcas pa chom kun sogs sdig sprong dge sgrub la sbyar ba lta bu'o/ phyi chu m+mu 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ /sngon yang tshong pa lnga stong tsam gyis gru bo che gsum dang bcas rin po che'i gling du phyin nas gya gzhan pa gnyis rin ca ce dang tsan+dan sa mchog gis bkang ste slar ldog pas/ rgya mtsho'i nor bdag khros nas mi mthun pa'i rlung gis nyam nga ba'i phyogs su 'khyer te/ rba klong drag tu 'khrugs pas gru thag chad nas rin bo che dang / tsan+danaXgyi gru stor/ gru bo che yang chur nub la khad pa na/ tshong pa rnams kyi 'jigs rten pa'i lha la gsol ba yun ring du btab kyang ma phan pa na/ dge bsnyen zhig gis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de ma thagatu mthun pa'i rlung byung tshegru gsum ga zhag gcig rang la 'dzam
gling du slebs pa lta bu'o/ phyi sha za'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa ni/ sngon yang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi gtsugo lag khang zhigatu nyan thos sen+ta pa'i dge 'dun mang du gnas pa las/ lan cig nub re bzhin phyi rol du song ba'i dge slong re re shi nas tshogs pa 'khri zhing / nub gzhan par dge tshul zhig gis phyi rol du phyin pas/ sha za mdog nag cing / mche ba gtsigs pa zhig gis mgo zung nas bzung ba na/ sgrol ma la gsol be btab pas/ lha mo nag mo ral gri thogs pa zhig gis sha za la bsdigs pas/ sha za des sa 'og nas lcags kyi bum pa mu tig gis gang ba phyungs nas dge tshul la phul te/ bgo par gsol ba lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir rje btsun 'di'i sku'i rnam pa yid la drin nas gsol ba tshul bzhin du btab na gong du bshad pa'i phyi nang gi 'jigs pa bcu drug dang gzhan yang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa yin te/ rgyud las/ dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster/ zhes dang / 'jigs pa kun las sgrol bar byed/dus min 'chi las sgrol bar byed/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gsum pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil la spyan mnga' tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ rtsab las//phyag zhabs mthil la mnga' ba'i stong nyid sogs//rnam thar sgo bzhi'i spyan gyis 'gro ba kun//bde chen thar pa'i gling du 'khrid mdzad ma//kun gyi skyabs gnas skyode la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes gsungs/ don ni/ phyag 'tshal lo/ gang la na/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis dang zhabs gnyis kyi mthil bzhi la mnga' ba'i ye shes kyi spyan bzhis dngos su bstan pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong ga nyid dang / sogs khongs nas thon pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo slon pa med pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo mngon par 'du byed pa med ḍi ste rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi mtshon la/ de ltar
na rnam thar sgo bzhi zhes pas gnas lugs zab shāka gang pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dngos su bstan cing / bde chen zhes pas thabs bde ba chen spro'i ye shes dngos su bstan pa yin pas thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i lam bzang nyams su len tshul gyis nam mkha' ma zad bar du 'gro ba sems can kun thar pa'i gling ngam sku gsum nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa la sogs paXgang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa la nam yang bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i bdag nyid chen mo lha mi kun gyi skyabs gnas khyod la zhes pa'o/ gnyis pa zhal mdangs gsal zhing go zer 'phro tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ rtsab las//yid 'ong ston lnga'i zla ba 'bum phrag gi/rab tu mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i zhal//'gro la dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar 'phro ba can//thugs rje'i spyan yangs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes gsungs/ don ni phyag 'tshal lo/ gang la na/ mthong na mi mthun pa med cing /shin tu yid du 'ong ba /la sprin khug na sogs dang bral ba'i ston spu'i dus kyi zla ba 'bum phrag gi rab tu mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa ste de lta bu'i zla ba 'bum phrag phyogs gcig tu spungs pa lta bur mchog tu dkar zhing mdzes pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'gro la dgyes pa'i 'dzum bag dang ldan pa las dri zhim go zer dkar 5 ༄7gas brgyar 'phro ba can/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes bya'i gnas tshul thams cad mngon sum gyis gzigs pa'i spyan yangs ma'am/ thugs rje'i spyan gyis gdul bya rnams mi 'dor bar rtagatu gdul bya'i don la gzigs pa'i spyan yangs ma la zhes pa'o/ gsum pa rgyan gos kyis brgyan tshul gyi sgo nas ba༄de pa la bzhi/ rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan gos kyis brgyan tshal gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ rin po ches dbu rgyan tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ sku'i cha shas gzhan yang rin spro che'i rgyan gyis brgyan tshul gyi

dbang drag bzhi las/ dang spro zhi ba'i dngos grub zhu ba ni/ rtsab las//bdag gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs//'jigs chen brgyad dang nad dang gdon la sogs//phyi dang nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba rnams//zhi ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod/ces gsungs/ don ni/ rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la gsol ba btab pa la brten nas bdag dang bdag go ba'i chos byed kyi skyes bu rnams kyi bla med byang chub bsgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs gong du bshad pa'i phyi nang sga 'jigs pa chen bo brgyad tshan gnyis dang / rlung mkhris bad spun 'dus pa'i nad la sogs pa dang /nyin gcig pa la sogs pa'i rims dang / gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs rnams dang / phyi'i nye bar 'tshe ba lus kyi sdug bsngal sogs dang / dngos su ma gsal yang shugs la bstan pa gsang ba'i bar gago rang rgyud kyi dug gsum la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa ste/ mdor na chags sdang la sogs 33 mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi lhong dang / de dag gi kun nas bslangs te byas pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga dang chos spong gi las sogs las ngan pa rnams dang / de dag gi 'bras bu tsha grang gi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i mi 'go pa mtha' dag lhag med du zhi ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mgu ces pa'o de la rgyal ba'i sras 5 ༄ngags med bzang bo dpal gyis/ /nad gdon chom rkun dgra sogs dam chos kyi/ /bar gcod yin zhes grags kyang rang gi lbo/ /las su rung na de kun grogs su 'gyur/ /lbo ngan 'di ni dam chos gegs su nges/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe 'am bar gcod gnyis ni rang rang gi lbo las su rung na chos bsgrub pa'i grogs su 'khyer shes la/ gsang ba'i bar gcod nyon mongs pa rnams bar gcod yin
par ma zad chos bsgrub pa la de las bar gcod che ba yong thabs med pas rang rgyud kyi nyon slongs zhi ba'i 'phrin las 'tshol ba gnad kyi don por bzung dgos so/ gnyis par rgyas pa'i dngos grub zhu ba ni/ rtsab las//tshe dang bgo nams dmigs med khung rje dang //thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab dri med dang //bslab pa gsum sogs legs pa'i yon tan rnams//rgyas pa'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod/ces gsungs/ don ni/ de ltar rje bag ma de la gsol ba btab pa la brten nas 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs zhi ba tsam du ma zad mthun rkyen 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang / rgyud pa 'joms shing chos ldan gyi bya ba lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bsod nams dang / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhung tshig la thogs rdugs med pa'i lung gi yon tan dang / de dag gi r+pā las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i lbo spangs pa'i dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes mtshon pa'i rgyu 'bras bdun dang / lung la brten pa thos byung gi shes rab/ rigs pa la brten pa bsam byung gi shes rab kyi bslab pa ste lhag pa'i bslab pa rin spro che rnam pa gsum dang / sogs khongs nas thon pa lam gyi gathe bang rnam pa gsum dang / lta sgom spyod gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang sa/sum dang / 'phags pa'i nor bdun la sogs pa mdor na legs pa'i yon tan thams cad yar yi zla ba dang / ngabyar gyi chu gter bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mgo cig pa'o/ des na dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas nas rje btsun ma 'di nyid gsol ba btab na dngos grub nges par sgyul ba yin te/ sngon yang sgrub pa spro zhig gis shing sim pa la'i cab zhig tu sgol ma'i sngags bzla zhing bsdad pas lan cig jo rangs kyi dus na rang gi mdun du sngon med pa'i lam srang zhig mthong

'os pa'i 'phags ma skyode kyis bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i mkha' mnyam gyi lus can rnams rlung la sogs pa'i nad dang / nyin gcig pa la sogs pa'i rims dang / gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad dang / gnyid dus kyi rmi lam ngan pa dang / sad dus kyi mtshan ma ngan pa sogs 'jigs pa chen po kun las myur du bskyab par mdzad du gsol ba'o/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la brgyad las/ dang bo nga rgyal dang seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob par gsol ba ni/ mab las//'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri sul gnas bcas te//gzhan las mchog tu 98dzin pas sems khongs shing //pha rol khyad du gago pa'i sbar khyim can//nga rgyal seng ge'i 'jigs sta bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ rang gi phung bo la dmigs nas nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri lo'i sul du gnas bcas swe/ dman pa 'di las bdag khyad par du 'phags so snyam du gzhan las rang nyid mchog tu 'dzin pas sems rgyud rab tu khongs shing / pha rol dman par bltasanas khyadadu gar pa'i sngar khyim mi bzad pa dang ldan pa'i nang rang rgyud kyi nga rgyal dang / nyi seng gi'i 'jigs pa las bskyab pa'i phyir du gsol ba 'debs pa ste/ sngon yang shing 'thun zhig nags su song ba seng ge ma bkres pa dang 'phrad nas khar 'ogs te za bar brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ bud med shing lo'i gos can zhig cung bas seng ge'i kha nas blangasate tshong dus subazhag pa ltar ro/ gnyis pa gnyi mug dang glang spro'i 'jigs pa las skyobo par gsol ba ni/ rtsab las//dran shes lcags kyu kon spros ma btul zhing //'do da yon myos chu 'thungs pas 'joms pa'i mthus/
/log pa'i lam zhugs gdod 'che'i marje ba gtsigs//gti mug glang spro'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ blang dor ma brjed pa'i dran pa dang / legs nyes gang la go shes pa'i shes bzhin gyi lcags kyu kon spros ma btab zhing / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i 'dod yon lnga dang / rang gi dpral ba'i myos byed kyi bum pa nas babs pa'i chu 'thungs pas mar+shazu nga 'joms pa'i 'thus/ phyin ci log gi lam du zhugs nas/ gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mche ba gtsigs par byed pa'i nang rang rgyud kyi chos kyi gnas lugs la rmongs pa'i gti mug dang / phyi glang khra'i 'jigs pa las bskyab par gsol ba ste/ sngon yang bu mo zhig me rtog 'thu ru song ba glang chen gtum pa'i snas bcings te mche ba bsnun par brtsams pa na/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rdo ba'i stegs dang / mong 'dus dang / 'dun khar dang / lha khang dang / rgyal yi sgo khang rnams su rim pa ltar bzhag ste sna shal gyis phyag byas pas basprod nams can du rig nas rgyal khra'i btsun mor gyur ༵ /ra ro/ gsum pa zhe sdang dang me'i 'jigs pa las skyob par gsol ba ni/ rtsab /tshul min yid byed rlung gis bskul ba las//nyes spyod dud sprin 'khrug pa'i krong dkyil nas//dge ba'i nags tshal bsreg pa'i nus pa can//zhe sdang me yi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa nyan mongs can gyi yid la byed pa'i rlung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ lus ngag gi nyes gu du ma'i dud pa sprin phung lta bur 'khrug pa'i rmong dkyil na 'bar bas bskal pa bgyo stong du bsags pa'i dge ba'i nags tshal yang skad cig la sreg pa'i nus pa can gyi nad rang rgyud kyi sdug bsngal dang de'i gnas la
dmigs nas khong snyu'i zhe sdang dang / phyi me'i 'jigs pa las bskyab par gsol ba ste/sngon yang khyim tshang zhig la mtshan mo sha 'khon can gyi dgra bos me spar ba na 'bros par brtsams kyang thar pa'i ched sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ khyim gyi steng du sprin sngo zhing mdzes pa zhig byung ba las char rgyun gnya' shing tsam babs pas me zhi ba lta bu'o/ bzhi pa phrag dog dang sprul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob par gsol ba ni/ rtsab las//ma rig 'thibs po'i khung du mngon zhen cing //gzhan 'byor phun tshogs mthong tshe mi bzod par//gdug pa'i dug gis myur du khyab byed pa'i//phra dog sprul gyi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ blang dor la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa nags 'thibs pa'i khung du mngon par zhen cing gang zag gzhan gyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa mthong pa'i tshe mi bzod cing sems 'khrug pa'i gdug pa'i dug gis myur du rang gzhan la khyab par byed pa'i nad rang rgyud kyi phrag dog dang / phyi dug sprul gyi 'jigs pa gas bskyab par gsol ba ste/ sngon yang smad tshong ma zhig mu tig do shal lnga brgya ltar ba'i tshong dbon zhig khyim du chas pa'i lam du shing la gnas pa dug sprul lus la 'khril pa'i tshe/ sgrol mar gsol ba btab pas/ sprul de me rtog gis 'phreng ba gyur nas zhag bdun lus kyi rgyan du gyur pa lta bu'o/lnga pa lta ngan dang rkun glu'i 'jigs pa las skyob par gsol ba ni/ cab las//brtul zhugs dman pa'i 'brog dgon 'jigs rung dang //rtag chad mya ngamathang la rab rgyu zhing //ridzin bde'i grong dang dkon pa kun 'joms pa'i//lta ngan rkun lo'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ me lnga bsten pa dang g.yang gzhi 'chad pa sogs brtul zhugs dman
pa'i grong las 'phags pa'i 'brog dgon pa 'jigs su rung ba dang / bdag la dmigs nas rtag pa ther zug dang / chad pa 'chi 'pho med par+sha lta ba'i chu dang bral ba'i mya ngam gyi thang la rab tu rgyu zhing / gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan bde'i grong sde dang / dgon gnas kun 'jomasi par bya ba'i 'jig lta/ mthar lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ rtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ log lta ste nad dang rgyud kyi lta ngan lnga dang / phyi rkun yi 'jigs pa las bskyab par gsol ba ste/ sngon yang yul lha ru gcu'i tshong dbon long spyod dang ldan pa zhig rnga mong stong dang / khyu mchog lnga brgya la tshong zog bkal te ma ru'i yul du gas pa'i lam gyi 'brog dgon par mi sha za ba'i chom rkun stong tsam gyis 'joms pa na/ sgrol mar gsol ba btab pas/ rmo bur du dpa' bo ko mtshon thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ste chom rkun rnams rgyang ring por bskrad nas bde bar byas pa lta bu'o/ drug pa ser sna dang lcags slog gi 'jigs pa las skyob par gsol ba ni/ rtsab las//mi bzad srid pa'i btson khang ra ba ru//lus can rang dbang med par 'ching byed cing //sred pa'i sgo lcags dbye dkas 'khyud pa yi//ser sna'i lcags sgrog 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol/zhes gsungs te/ ga bsngal drag cing mi bzad pa dang ldan pa'i srid pa 'khor ba'i bca khang gis ra ba ru lus can rnams rang la dbang med par dam du 'ching bar byed cing /'go chags sred pa'i sgo lcags dbye bar dka' bas 'khyud pa'i nad rang rgyud kyi yo byad gtong mi nus par 'dzin pa'i ser sna dang / phyi lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las bskyab par gsol ba ste/ sngon yang rkun spro'i dpon zhig gis rgyal khra'i mtshod phyag ste zhugs pas gang gi bum pa dang phrad pa 'thungs pas bzi nas gnyid du song ba bdag spros rig ste/ bcan rar lcags sgrog gis bcings shing sdug bsngal 'phrad pa na/ sgrol mar gsol
